import { CaseDecidedParams, CaseView, RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY, STANDING_RULES, StandingLists, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  complete,
  correctionChoices,
  correctionDraft,
  decisionParamsOf,
  markableItems,
  markedList,
  marksWithdrawable,
  newDraft,
  offeredDraft,
  previewOf,
  reportingControlState,
  reviewChoices,
  reviewDraft,
  withdrawMarksDraft,
  withMark,
  withReporting,
  type CaseDraft,
} from "../src/compose";
import { STANDING_WORDS } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { StandingView } from "../src/screens/Standing";
import { DECISION_MARKED, DECISION_WARNED, ITEM_MARKED, ITEM_NOTIFIER, ITEM_REPORTER, MARKED_REF, WARNED_REPORTING, markCase, markedCase, reportingCase, warnedCase } from "./case-fixtures";
import { HOSTILE } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * The console's part of the restriction of reporting (3e design, sections 8.3, 8.4, 8.6 and 8.7; Task 5): "Warn about
 * reporting" and "Restrict reporting" on an account case, each offered when the case answer says the database would
 * accept it and greyed with its sentence otherwise, under R6, with the facts drafted from the record in reports; the mark
 * "manifestly unfounded" beside the items a "No breach" decision answers and may mark, signed as the list `unfounded`;
 * "Withdraw this decision's marks", a kept correction that signs no list; the reversals of the two measures with
 * [review.warning]; and the reporting records of the Standing screen. Every number in the words is STANDING_RULES'.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: "cd".repeat(32), facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };
const W = STANDING_WORDS.reporting;
const M = STANDING_WORDS.mark;

const final = (view: CaseView, change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, MODERATOR), kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", ...change });
const written = (draft: CaseDraft): CaseDraft => ({ ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, facts: draft.written.facts || "The facts.", reason: "The reason." } });

function composer(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

function casePage(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) {
  const props: CaseScreenViewProps = {
    caseId: caseId(view.id),
    view,
    shownImage: null,
    busy: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    note: "",
    reveal: null,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onShowImage: noop,
    onShowClearly: noop,
    onHideImage: noop,
    onImageError: noop,
    onSnapshot: noop,
    onNoteChange: noop,
    onNoteSave: noop,
    onRevealOpen: noop,
    onRevealChange: noop,
    onRevealConfirm: noop,
    onRevealClose: noop,
    compose: {
      role,
      draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role),
      now: NOW,
      busy: false,
      error: null,
      textErrors: {},
      declining: null,
      onChange: noop,
      onTextBlur: noop,
      onSeal: noop,
      onConfirm: noop,
      onDeclineOpen: noop,
      onDeclineChange: noop,
      onDeclineSave: noop,
      onDeclineClose: noop,
      onCancelCorrection: noop,
      onCorrect: noop,
      onReview: noop,
      onAnswer: noop,
      onWithdraw: noop,
      onWithdrawMarks: noop,
    },
  };
  return html(<CaseScreenView {...props} />);
}

describe("3e Task 5: the warning about reporting and the restriction of it (design, section 8.3)", () => {
  test("the words are the design's, each number printed from STANDING_RULES", () => {
    expect(W.warnShort(4, 8)).toBe(
      `Not open: a warning needs at least ${STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks} marked reports among those the account sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days, and they must be at least half of its rule reports sent in that time. This account has 4 of 8. One report never reaches the number alone.`,
    );
    expect(W.warnStanding("2026-09-20")).toBe("Not open: the warning of 2026-09-20 still counts.");
    expect(W.warnWhat(5, 8)).toContain(`that 5 of the 8 reports it sent under the rules in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days were marked manifestly unfounded`);
    expect(W.warnWhat(5, 8)).toContain(`says that ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks} marked reports among those it sends after the warning may lead to a restriction`);
    expect(W.restrictWhat(7)).toContain(`for 7 days, from the moment you confirm`);
    expect(W.restrictWhat(1)).toContain("for 1 day, from the moment you confirm");
    expect(W.restrictWhat(7)).toContain(`At most ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays} days.`);
    expect(W.restrictNoWarning).toBe("Not open: the account has no warning that still counts. Warn first.");
    expect(W.restrictShort(2, "2026-09-20")).toBe(`Not open: 2 of the reports the account sent since the warning of 2026-09-20 were marked; a restriction needs ${STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks}.`);
    expect(W.restrictRunning("x")).toBe("Not open: a restriction runs until x.");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reviewWarning).toBe(
      "A restriction of this account's reports rests on this warning. If you lift the warning, the restriction ends when you confirm, and this decision's statement says so.",
    );
    expect(M.rule).toContain(`for ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days from the day it was sent`);
  });

  test("each control is open when the case answer says the database would accept it, and greyed with its reason otherwise", () => {
    const view = reportingCase();
    expect(reportingControlState(view, final(view), "warn")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(reportingControlState(view, final(view), "restrict")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "noWarning" });
    expect(reportingControlState(reportingCase({}, true), final(view), "warn")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(reportingControlState(reportingCase({ mayWarn: false, unfounded: 4 }), final(view), "warn")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "warnShort" });
    const warned = reportingCase(WARNED_REPORTING);
    expect(reportingControlState(warned, final(warned), "warn")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "warnStanding" });
    expect(reportingControlState(warned, final(warned), "restrict")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(reportingControlState(reportingCase({ ...WARNED_REPORTING, marksSince: 2, mayRestrict: false }), final(warned), "restrict")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "restrictShort" });
    expect(reportingControlState(reportingCase({ ...WARNED_REPORTING, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-20T09:00:00.000Z" }), final(warned), "restrict")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "running" });
    // Not shown while deciding, for an outcome that restricts nothing, on the law, or on a post case.
    expect(reportingControlState(view, final(view, { kind: "interim" }), "warn")).toBeNull();
    expect(reportingControlState(view, final(view, { outcome: "no_violation" }), "warn")).toBeNull();
    expect(reportingControlState(view, final(view, { ground: "illegal" }), "warn")).toBeNull();
    expect(reportingControlState(markCase(), final(markCase()), "warn")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the composer shows both controls, the warning open and the restriction greyed with [restrict.noWarning]; [reports.first] greys both while a report waits", () => {
    const view = reportingCase();
    const out = composer(view, final(view));
    expect(out).toContain(`<input type="checkbox"/> <span>${W.warnLabel}</span>`);
    expect(out).toContain(`<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>${W.restrictLabel}</span>`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(W.warnWhat(5, 8)));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(W.restrictNoWarning));
    const waiting = reportingCase({}, true);
    const greyed = composer(waiting, final(waiting));
    expect(greyed).toContain(`<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>${W.warnLabel}</span>`);
    expect(greyed).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst));
  });

  test("choosing the warning sets R6 and drafts the facts in reports from the record as read, each report once with its marked items; the params sign it; the preview words it", () => {
    const view = reportingCase();
    const draft = withReporting(view, final(view, { ruleId: "R1", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1 }), "warn", null, NOW);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "warn_reporting", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(draft.ruleId).toBe("R6");
    expect(draft.category).toBe(RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R6);
    expect(markedList(view.standing!.reporting.marked)).toBe(
      `report N-AAAAAAAAAA of 2026-09-01 (item 1); report ${MARKED_REF} of 2026-09-03 (items 1 and 3); report N-BBBBBBBBBB of 2026-09-06 (item 2); report N-CCCCCCCCCC of 2026-09-08 (item 1); report N-DDDDDDDDDD of 2026-09-10 (item 1)`,
    );
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe(
      `In the ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days up to 2026-10-12 the account sent 8 reports under korbat's rules. A moderator marked 5 of them as manifestly unfounded: ${markedList(view.standing!.reporting.marked)}.`,
    );
    // Facts already written stay as they are.
    expect(withReporting(view, { ...final(view), written: { ...final(view).written, facts: "Mine." } }, "warn", null, NOW).written.facts).toBe("Mine.");
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual(draft.actions);
    // Another rule than R6, or a report that waits, loses the measure.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, ruleId: "R1" }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(reportingCase({}, true), MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, written(draft), DIGESTS));
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", actions: [{ kind: "warn_reporting", mediaId: null }], unfounded: [] });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, written(draft), NOW));
    expect(told[0]).toContain("korbat warns you about your reports. Nothing is restricted.");
    expect(told).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.warn);
  });

  test("choosing the restriction drafts the facts from the reports sent since the warning, signs its days and announced false, and previews the warning it follows", () => {
    const view = reportingCase(WARNED_REPORTING);
    const draft = withReporting(view, final(view), "restrict", 7, NOW);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 7, announced: false }]);
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe(
      "Of the reports the account sent between korbat's warning of 2026-09-20 and 2026-10-12, a moderator marked 3 as manifestly unfounded: report N-EEEEEEEEEE of 2026-09-21 (item 1); report N-FFFFFFFFFF of 2026-09-23 (item 2); report N-GGGGGGGGGG of 2026-09-25 (item 1).",
    );
    // More days than the restriction's own number lose the measure; so does a warning that no longer counts.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays + 1, announced: false }] }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(reportingCase(), MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, written(draft), DIGESTS));
    expect(params.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", mediaId: null, days: 7, announced: false }]);
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, written(draft), NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain("korbat restricted your reports under its rules for 7 days, until 2026-10-19 09:30 UTC");
    expect(told).toContain("It follows korbat's warning of 2026-09-20 08:00 UTC");
    expect(composer(view, draft)).toContain(esc(W.restrictWhat(7)));
  });
});

describe("3e Task 5: the mark manifestly unfounded and its withdrawal (design, sections 8.4 and 8.7)", () => {
  test("a final No breach decision offers the mark on each item it answers that can be marked, says once why another cannot, and signs the ticked items, sorted", () => {
    const view = markCase();
    const noBreach = final(view, { outcome: "no_violation", ruleId: "R1" });
    expect(markableItems(view, noBreach).map((each) => each.id)).toEqual([ITEM_REPORTER]);
    expect(markableItems(view, { ...noBreach, outcome: "restricted" })).toEqual([]);
    expect(markableItems(view, { ...noBreach, kind: "interim" })).toEqual([]);
    const out = composer(view, noBreach);
    expect(out).toContain(`<legend>${M.legend}</legend>`);
    expect(out).toContain(`<input type="checkbox"/> <span>${M.label}: item 1</span>`);
    expect(out).not.toContain(`${M.label}: item 2`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(M.never));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(M.rule));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(M.undone));
    // Ticked, the item is signed; an item that cannot be marked never is, whatever the draft holds.
    const marked = { ...noBreach, unfounded: withMark(noBreach, ITEM_REPORTER, true) };
    expect(composer(view, marked)).toContain(`<input type="checkbox" checked=""/> <span>${M.label}: item 1</span>`);
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...marked, unfounded: [ITEM_NOTIFIER, ITEM_REPORTER] }, DIGESTS).unfounded).toEqual([ITEM_REPORTER]);
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, marked, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: [ITEM_REPORTER] });
    // A restriction signs no mark, and the draft the composer shows drops them.
    expect(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...marked, outcome: "restricted", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }], ruleId: "R1" }, DIGESTS).unfounded).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...marked, outcome: "restricted" }).unfounded).toEqual([]);
    expect(withMark(marked, ITEM_REPORTER, false)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the case page shows a mark that stands and one withdrawn, and offers Withdraw this decision's marks beside the decision while one stands", () => {
    const page = casePage(markedCase());
    expect(page).toContain(esc(M.marked));
    expect(page).toContain(`>${esc(M.withdrawLabel)}</button>`);
    const withdrawn = casePage(markedCase(true));
    expect(withdrawn).toContain(M.withdrawn);
    expect(withdrawn).not.toContain(`>${esc(M.withdrawLabel)}</button>`);
    expect(marksWithdrawable(markedCase(), markedCase().decisions[0]!, MODERATOR).map((each) => each.id)).toEqual([ITEM_MARKED]);
    // A decision that needed an admin is corrected by an admin.
    const admins = { ...markedCase().decisions[0]!, needsAdmin: true };
    expect(marksWithdrawable(markedCase(), admins, MODERATOR)).toEqual([]);
    expect(marksWithdrawable(markedCase(), admins, ADMIN)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  test("the withdrawal is a kept correction that lifts nothing and signs no list; the page says what it does and that no statement is sent", () => {
    const view = markedCase();
    const draft = withdrawMarksDraft(caseId(view.id), view, view.decisions[0]!, MODERATOR);
    expect(complete(view, draft)).toBe(false);
    const reasoned = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "The reports were arguable." } };
    expect(complete(view, reasoned)).toBe(true);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, reasoned, { ...DIGESTS, facts: null }));
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_MARKED, actions: [], unfounded: [], replaced: false });
    const out = composer(view, reasoned);
    expect(out).toContain(`>${esc(M.withdrawLabel)}</h3>`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(M.withdrawWhat));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(M.noStatement));
    expect(out).not.toContain("Preview: the statement");
    // Once no mark stands, nothing is left to withdraw.
    expect(composer(markedCase(true), reasoned)).toContain("No mark of that decision stands any more.");
  });

  test("a review or a correction of a warning names its lift as the warning's, with [review.warning] when a restriction rests on it; the preview says the warning no longer counts", () => {
    const view = warnedCase();
    const decision = view.decisions[0]!;
    const review = reviewDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decision, MODERATOR);
    expect(reviewChoices(view, review, MODERATOR).map((choice) => choice.reversal)).toEqual([{ kind: "lift_reporting", mediaId: null }]);
    const lifted = { ...review, review: "reversed" as const, actions: [{ kind: "lift_reporting" as const, mediaId: null }], written: { ...review.written, review_reason: "The marks were arguable." } };
    const out = composer(view, lifted);
    expect(out).toContain(W.liftWarning);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reviewWarning));
    expect(statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, lifted, NOW))).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.reportingLifted.warning);
    const correction = correctionDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decision, ADMIN);
    expect(correctionChoices(view, correction, ADMIN).map((choice) => choice.reversal.kind)).toEqual(["lift_reporting"]);
    expect(composer(view, correction, ADMIN)).toContain(W.liftWarning);
    expect(DECISION_WARNED).toBe(decision.id);
  });
});

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/**
 * The restriction of reporting (3e design, sections 6.3 and 7.9; section 12.1, invariants 16, 17 and 20 for the reporting
 * measures). The first part runs at the database's level, as korbat_api (or as the migrator where a release must be
 * written) inside transactions that are rolled back, deciding through the module's own decide (decideIn): the check of
 * every mark, its recheck at commit, the counts by report on both sides, the thresholds and the withdrawal of marks. The
 * second part is the flow through the routes' code, each decision confirmed with a staff key on the software
 * authenticator: from five marked reports to a warning, a restriction, a withdrawn mark and a lifted warning that ends its
 * restriction, read as staff, the person and a reporter read it. What the file commits is removed in the end, and its
 * last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the restriction of reporting", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let decider: RealStaff;
  let finder: RealStaff;
  let reviewer: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** The profiles the committed flow made, removed with everything they hold at the end. */
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    const repo = createAuthRepo(world.authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(world.authDb, world.migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(world.authDb, world.migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    decider = await world.staff("moderator");
    finder = await world.staff("admin");
    reviewer = await world.staff("moderator");
    // Read once the staff profiles exist: the world removes them when it closes, after the last test.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 240_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  }, 240_000);

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

  /** One test's world at the database's level: a transaction that is rolled back, with both staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>, db: Db = apiDb) =>
    rolledBack(db, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const profile = (db: Db | DbTx) => newProfile(db as Db);
  /** A signed-in person's report under R1 of these posts, one item a post: the report, its items and their cases. */
  async function reportOf(db: Db | DbTx, reporterId: string, postIds: readonly string[]) {
    const recorded = await intake(db, ground.rule(reporterId, "R1"), postIds.map((id, i) => aPost(id, i + 1)));
    return { intakeId: recorded.intakeId, items: recorded.items.map((item) => ({ id: item.id, caseId: item.caseId! })) };
  }
  /** A report of one new post of the author: its item and case. */
  async function reportedPost(db: Db | DbTx, reporterId: string, authorId: string) {
    const postId = await newPostRow(db, authorId);
    const { items } = await reportOf(db, reporterId, [postId]);
    return { postId, ...items[0]! };
  }
  /** A final decision that finds no breach and marks these items "manifestly unfounded". */
  const noBreach = (tx: DbTx, caseId: string, unfounded: readonly string[], staff: TestStaff = mod) => decideIn(tx, staff, caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded });
  /** The account's case, opened by a finding under R6 (or a user's report of it): the case. */
  async function accountCase(db: Db | DbTx, accountId: string, by: { finding: string } | { reporter: string }) {
    const g = "finding" in by ? ground.finding(by.finding, "R6") : ground.rule(by.reporter, "R6");
    return (await intake(db, g, anAccount(accountId, "named"))).items[0]!.caseId!;
  }
  /** What reporting_record says of the account: its rule reports in the frame and its marked reports among them. */
  const record = async (db: Db | DbTx, accountId: string) =>
    (await db.execute<{ reports: number; unfounded: number }>(sql`select reports, unfounded from reporting_record where account_id = ${accountId}::uuid`))[0] ?? { reports: 0, unfounded: 0 };
  /** A refusal's code and the detail the database gave, or null when it went through. */
  async function refused(promise: Promise<unknown>): Promise<{ code: string; detail: string | null } | null> {
    try {
      await promise;
      return null;
    } catch (err) {
      return { code: err instanceof ModerationError ? err.code : String((await refusal(Promise.reject(err))) ?? err), detail: (err as { detail?: string | null }).detail ?? (await refusalDetail(Promise.reject(err))) };
    }
  }
  /** A mark written as the API would write it, in a savepoint: the refusal's code and detail, or null. */
  const rawMark = (tx: DbTx, itemId: string, decisionId: string) => refused(tx.transaction((sp) => sp.execute(sql`insert into unfounded_marks (item_id, decision_id) values (${itemId}::uuid, ${decisionId}::uuid)`)));

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 16 at the database's level

  describe("invariant 16: a mark is a person's, signed, and only on a signed-in rule report", () => {
    test("the check refuses a mark on a notice of illegality, a finding, a signed-out notice, a report of child sexual abuse material and an item the decision did not answer; it forces the reporter, the report and the times", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter, other] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
        const rule = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        const illegal = (await intake(tx, ground.illegal(other.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        const finding = (await intake(tx, ground.finding(mod.id, "R1"), aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        const signedOut = (await intake(tx, { ...ground.rule(reporter.id, "R1"), channel: "signed_out", reporterId: null }, aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        const caseId = rule.caseId!;
        // The case answer says which items may be marked: a signed-in person's report under a rule, and nothing else.
        const listed = new Map((await caseItems(tx, caseId, mod.id)).map((item) => [item.id, item]));
        expect([rule, illegal, finding, signedOut].map((item) => listed.get(item.id)!.markable)).toEqual([true, false, false, false]);
        const elsewhere = await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id);

        const notMarkable = /signed-in person's report under a rule/;
        for (const item of [illegal, finding, signedOut]) {
          const answer = await refused(noBreach(tx, caseId, [item.id]));
          expect(answer?.code, item.id).toBe("invalid_decision");
          expect(answer?.detail, item.id).toMatch(notMarkable);
        }
        expect((await refused(noBreach(tx, caseId, [elsewhere.id])))?.detail).toMatch(/not one this decision answered/);

        // The path for child sexual abuse material stores no sender: its item is never marked, also by an admin.
        const csamPost = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
        const csam = (await intake(tx, ground.csam(), aPost(csamPost))).items[0]!;
        expect((await refused(noBreach(tx, csam.caseId!, [csam.id], admin)))?.detail).toMatch(notMarkable);

        // The mark the check takes: the reporter, the report and the time it was received are the database's.
        const decision = await noBreach(tx, caseId, [rule.id]);
        const [mark] = await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(
          sql`select m.decision_id, m.account_id, m.intake_id = i.intake_id as same_report, m.reported_at = n.received_at as sent_then, m.marked_at = now() as marked_now, m.withdrawn_by, m.withdrawn_at
                from unfounded_marks m join intake_items i on i.id = m.item_id join intakes n on n.id = i.intake_id where m.item_id = ${rule.id}::uuid`,
        );
        expect(mark).toEqual({ decision_id: decision, account_id: reporter.id, same_report: true, sent_then: true, marked_now: true, withdrawn_by: null, withdrawn_at: null });
        const after = new Map((await caseItems(tx, caseId, mod.id)).map((item) => [item.id, item]));
        expect(after.get(rule.id)).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
        expect(after.get(illegal.id)).toMatchObject({ unfounded: false, markWithdrawn: false });
      });
    });

    test("only a final decision that found no breach marks: a restriction and a decision taken while deciding are refused, whatever their transaction", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const first = await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id);
        const interim = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "interim", actions: [act("withhold")] });
        expect((await rawMark(tx, first.id, interim))?.detail).toMatch(/only a final decision that found no breach/);
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect((await rawMark(tx, first.id, removal))?.code).toBe("invalid_decision");
        expect((await rawMark(tx, first.id, removal))?.detail).toMatch(/only a final decision that found no breach/);
        // The params' schema refuses marks on any other decision before the database sees them.
        const other = await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id);
        await expect(decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")], unfounded: [other.id] })).rejects.toThrow(/unfounded/);
      });
    });

    test("the signed list is what the database holds at commit, also when a mark is added after the check was made to run early (unfounded_marks_recheck)", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, first, second] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
        const one = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(first.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        const two = (await intake(tx, ground.rule(second.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!;
        // decideIn ran the decision's check at once, inside its savepoint: the signed list held one mark.
        const decision = await noBreach(tx, one.caseId!, [one.id]);
        const late = await refused(
          tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
            await sp.execute(sql`insert into unfounded_marks (item_id, decision_id) values (${two.id}::uuid, ${decision}::uuid)`);
            await sp.execute(sql`set constraints all immediate`);
          }),
        );
        expect(late).toEqual({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: expect.stringMatching(/^unfounded:/) });
        expect((await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${decision}::uuid`)).length).toBe(1);
      });
    });

    test("a kept correction withdraws all of a decision's marks together and mails nobody; one of a decision with no mark left is refused; a withdrawn mark counts no more", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await profile(tx);
        const reporters = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const postId = await newPostRow(tx, author.id);
        const items = [];
        for (const reporter of reporters) items.push((await intake(tx, ground.rule(reporter.id), aPost(postId))).items[0]!);
        const caseId = items[0]!.caseId!;
        const decision = await noBreach(tx, caseId, items.map((item) => item.id).sort());
        for (const reporter of reporters) expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 1 });
        const correction = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decision, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
        const marks = await tx.execute<{ withdrawn_by: string; withdrawn: boolean }>(sql`select withdrawn_by, withdrawn_at = now() as withdrawn from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${decision}::uuid`);
        expect([...marks]).toEqual(items.map(() => ({ withdrawn_by: correction, withdrawn: true })));
        for (const reporter of reporters) expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 0 });
        // It concerns the people who reported, not the author: no statement goes for it.
        expect((await tx.execute<{ author_mail: string }>(sql`select author_mail::text from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid`))[0]!.author_mail).toBe("none");
        expect((await caseItems(tx, caseId, mod.id)).map((item) => [item.unfounded, item.markWithdrawn])).toEqual(items.map(() => [false, true]));
        // Nothing is left to withdraw, and a decision that set no mark has none either.
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decision, outcome: "kept", actions: [] })))?.code).toBe("invalid_decision");
        const plain = await reportedPost(tx, reporters[0]!.id, author.id);
        const unmarked = await noBreach(tx, plain.caseId, []);
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, plain.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: unmarked, outcome: "kept", actions: [] })))?.detail).toMatch(/no mark left/);
      });
    });

    test("a mark stops counting when a re-examination of its item ends in a restriction: a derivation, nothing is written", async () => {
      // The release is the dispatch job's to write: the migrator writes it here, in a transaction that is rolled back.
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const marked = await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id);
        await noBreach(tx, marked.caseId, [marked.id]);
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 1 });
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now(), shown_outcome = outcome where id = ${marked.id}::uuid`);
        const asked = (await reporterItem(tx, reporter.id, marked.id))!;
        const [again] = await recordReexamination(moderationDeps(tx), asked, null);
        await decideIn(tx, mod, again!.caseId!, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 0 });
        const [mark] = await tx.execute<{ withdrawn_by: string | null }>(sql`select withdrawn_by from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${marked.id}::uuid`);
        expect(mark).toEqual({ withdrawn_by: null });
      }, world.migrateDb);
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariant 17 at the database's level

  describe("invariant 17: the counts count reports, and the measures read them", () => {
    test("one report naming ten posts, all ten marked, is one marked report of one sent: it never reaches the warning alone", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const posts = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) posts.push(await newPostRow(tx, author.id));
        const { items } = await reportOf(tx, reporter.id, posts);
        expect(new Set(items.map((item) => item.caseId)).size).toBe(10);
        for (const item of items) await noBreach(tx, item.caseId, [item.id]);
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 1 });
        const caseId = await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id });
        expect((await caseStanding(tx, caseId, reporter.id)).reporting).toMatchObject({ reports: 1, unfounded: 1, mayWarn: false, marked: items.map(() => expect.objectContaining({ sinceWarning: false })) });
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] })))?.detail).toMatch(/below the threshold/);
      });
    });

    test("a warning is refused below either threshold, and a restriction without a warning that still counts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const sent = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks - 1; i++) sent.push(await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id));
        for (const report of sent) await noBreach(tx, report.caseId, [report.id]);
        const warn = async () => refused(decideIn(tx, mod, await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id }), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] }));
        expect((await warn())?.detail).toMatch(/below the threshold/);
        // Five marked, but of eleven sent: under half.
        for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) sent.push(await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id));
        await noBreach(tx, sent[STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks - 1]!.caseId, [sent[STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks - 1]!.id]);
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 11, unfounded: 5 });
        const caseId = await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id });
        expect((await caseStanding(tx, caseId, reporter.id)).reporting).toMatchObject({ reports: 11, unfounded: 5, warnedOn: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false });
        expect((await warn())?.detail).toMatch(/below the threshold/);
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [timed("restrict_reporting", 7, false)] })))?.detail).toMatch(/no warning that still counts/);
      });
    });

    test("a warning answers findings only, counts once, and when lifted because its marks were withdrawn cannot be given again on them", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const [author, reporter, other] = [await profile(tx), await profile(tx), await profile(tx)];
        const decisions: string[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks; i++) {
          const report = await reportedPost(tx, reporter.id, author.id);
          decisions.push(await noBreach(tx, report.caseId, [report.id]));
        }
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 5, unfounded: 5 });
        // A case that holds someone's report about the account is decided first: the warning gets a case of its own.
        const reported = await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { reporter: other.id });
        await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id });
        expect((await caseStanding(tx, reported, reporter.id)).reporting.mayWarn).toBe(true);
        expect(await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, reported, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] }))).toEqual({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: "open_reports" });
        await decideIn(tx, mod, reported, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const warningCase = await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id });
        const warning = await decideIn(tx, mod, warningCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] });
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ basis: string; frame: boolean; rests_on: string[] | null; needs_admin: boolean }>(
          sql`select a.basis, a.ends_at = now() + make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) as frame, a.rests_on::text[] as rests_on, d.needs_admin
                from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id where a.decision_id = ${warning}::uuid and a.kind = 'warn_reporting'`,
        );
        expect(row).toEqual({ basis: "reports", frame: true, rests_on: null, needs_admin: false });
        // It restricts nothing: no profile column moves.
        expect((await tx.execute<{ until: string | null }>(sql`select reports_restricted_until::text as until from profiles where id = ${reporter.id}::uuid`))[0]!.until).toBeNull();
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id }), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] })))?.detail).toMatch(/still counts/);
        // Lifted by a correction, and one decision's marks withdrawn: the same warning is not given again on them.
        await decideIn(tx, admin, warningCase, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: warning, outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("lift_reporting")] });
        const [firstCase] = await tx.execute<{ case_id: string }>(sql`select case_id from decisions where id = ${decisions[0]!}::uuid`);
        await decideIn(tx, mod, firstCase!.case_id, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: decisions[0]!, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
        expect(await record(tx, reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 5, unfounded: 4 });
        expect((await refused(decideIn(tx, mod, await accountCase(tx, reporter.id, { finding: mod.id }), { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] })))?.detail).toMatch(/below the threshold/);
      });
    });
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the flow through the routes

  describe("the flow: five marked reports, a warning, a restriction, a withdrawn mark and a lifted warning that ends its restriction", () => {
    const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
    /** The flow's people and decisions, filled in by its tests in order. */
    const flow = {
      reporter: { id: "", handle: "" },
      author: { id: "", handle: "" },
      other: { id: "", handle: "" },
      reports: [] as { postId: string; id: string; caseId: string }[],
      marking: [] as string[],
      warning: "",
      warningCase: "",
      warnedAt: "",
      restriction: "",
      otherIntake: "",
      otherLine: "",
    };
    async function account() {
      const made_ = await profile(apiDb);
      made.push(made_.id);
      return made_;
    }
    /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id, or a failure that says why none was recorded. */
    async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
      const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
      if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
      return outcome.decisionId;
    }
    const marked = (report: { id: string; caseId: string }) => decided(decider, report.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: [report.id] });
    const view = (caseId: string) => world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(finder.session, caseId);
    const reportingOf = async (caseId: string) => (await view(caseId)).standing!.reporting;
    const deps = () => world.moderation.deps;
    /** The module's interface to the auth module answers only whether report mails are stopped, which the reporter's list asks. */
    const listDeps = () => ({ ...deps(), auth: { ...deps().auth, accountReportMailStopped: async () => false } });
    /** The other person's line for their report about the account: every item as the status page and their list give it. */
    const otherLine = async () => JSON.stringify(await Promise.all((await noticeItems(apiDb, flow.otherIntake)).map((item) => itemStatus(deps(), item))));
    const restrictedUntil = async () => (await apiDb.execute<{ until: string | null }>(sql`select to_char(reports_restricted_until at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as until from profiles where id = ${flow.reporter.id}::uuid`))[0]!.until;
    const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const utc = (iso: string) => `${iso.slice(0, 10)} ${iso.slice(11, 16)} UTC`;

    test("five of eight reports marked open a warning; a report about the account in its case holds it back until it is decided; the warning answers a finding only, counts for the frame, and reads as sent", async () => {
      flow.reporter = await account();
      flow.author = await account();
      flow.other = await account();
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) flow.reports.push(await reportedPost(apiDb, flow.reporter.id, flow.author.id));
      for (const report of flow.reports.slice(0, 5)) flow.marking.push(await marked(report));
      // Each item says whether it can be marked, and whether its mark stands.
      const itemIn = async (report: { id: string; caseId: string }) => (await view(report.caseId)).items.find((item) => item.id === report.id)!;
      expect(await itemIn(flow.reports[0]!)).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
      expect(await itemIn(flow.reports[5]!)).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: false, markWithdrawn: false });

      // Someone reported the account itself, and an admin opened a finding in the same case: the report comes first.
      const reported = await accountCase(apiDb, flow.reporter.id, { reporter: flow.other.id });
      await accountCase(apiDb, flow.reporter.id, { finding: finder.id });
      const first = await view(reported);
      expect(first.standing).toMatchObject({ openReports: true, reporting: { reports: 8, unfounded: 5, warnedOn: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: true, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null } });
      expect(first.standing!.reporting.marked.map((mark) => mark.position)).toEqual([1, 1, 1, 1, 1]);
      expect(first.items.find((item) => item.source.kind === "staff")).toMatchObject({ markable: false });
      try {
        await world.decideAs(decider, reported, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] });
        throw new Error("the warning was recorded");
      } catch (err) {
        expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ModerationError);
        expect(err).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: "open_reports" });
      }
      await decided(decider, reported, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
      const [otherItem] = await apiDb.execute<{ intake_id: string }>(sql`select intake_id from intake_items where case_id = ${reported}::uuid and reporter_account_id = ${flow.other.id}::uuid`);
      flow.otherIntake = otherItem!.intake_id;
      await world.migrateDb.execute(sql`update intake_items set outcome_sent_at = now(), shown_outcome = outcome where intake_id = ${flow.otherIntake}::uuid`);
      flow.otherLine = await otherLine();

      flow.warningCase = await accountCase(apiDb, flow.reporter.id, { finding: finder.id });
      flow.warning = await decided(decider, flow.warningCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("warn_reporting")] });
      const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, flow.warning))!;
      flow.warnedAt = found.statement.decidedAt;
      const warning = found.statement.measures[0]!;
      expect(warning).toMatchObject({ kind: "warn_reporting", basis: "reports", endsAt: expect.any(String) });
      expect(Date.parse(warning.endsAt!) - Date.parse(flow.warnedAt)).toBe(STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays * 86_400_000);
      const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
      expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(`${W.warn(utc(warning.endsAt!))} ${"If 3 of the reports you send after this warning are marked that way while it counts, a moderator may restrict your reports under korbat's rules for up to 30 days."} ${W.reportingOpen}`);
      expect(paragraphs).toContain(W.scope.warn);
      expect(mailTemplateOf(found.statement, paragraphs)).toEqual({ template: "reporting_warned", paragraphs });
      // The person reads it in /me; it restricts nothing.
      expect(await world.moderation.standingFor(flow.reporter.id)).toMatchObject({ measure: null, reporting: { warning: { decisionId: flow.warning, countsUntil: warning.endsAt }, restriction: null } });
      expect(await restrictedUntil()).toBeNull();
      // The Standing screen lists the account by its handle, in reports.
      const lists = await world.moderation.forStaff.standing();
      expect(lists.reportingRecords.items.find((row) => row.handle === flow.reporter.handle)).toEqual({ handle: flow.reporter.handle, caseId: null, reports: 8, unfounded: 5, warnedOn: today(), marksSince: 0 });
      // Invariant 20: the line of the person who reported the account says nothing of it.
      expect(await otherLine()).toBe(flow.otherLine);

      expect(await refused(restrict())).toEqual({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: expect.stringMatching(/too few marked reports/) });
      for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {

        flow.reports.push(report);
        flow.marking.push(await marked(report));
      }
      expect(await reportingOf(restrictionCase)).toMatchObject({ reports: 10, unfounded: 10, marksSince: 2, mayRestrict: false });
      expect(await refused(restrict())).toEqual({ code: "invalid_decision", detail: expect.stringMatching(/too few marked reports/) });
      const third = await reportedPost(apiDb, flow.reporter.id, flow.author.id);
      flow.reports.push(third);
      flow.marking.push(await marked(third));
      const ready = await reportingOf(restrictionCase);
      expect(ready).toMatchObject({ reports: 11, unfounded: 11, marksSince: 3, mayRestrict: true });
      expect(ready.marked.filter((mark) => mark.sinceWarning)).toHaveLength(3);
      flow.restriction = await decided(decider, restrictionCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [timed("restrict_reporting", 7, false)] });

      const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, flow.restriction))!;
      const restriction = found.statement.measures[0]!;
      expect(restriction).toMatchObject({ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports", days: 7, warnedAt: flow.warnedAt });
      expect(Date.parse(restriction.endsAt!) - Date.parse(found.statement.decidedAt)).toBe(7 * 86_400_000);
      const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
      expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(`${W.restrict(7, utc(restriction.endsAt!), utc(flow.warnedAt))} ${W.reportingOpen}`);
      expect(mailTemplateOf(found.statement, paragraphs)).toEqual({ template: "reporting_restricted", days: 7, endsAt: restriction.endsAt, paragraphs });
      // It starts at once: standing_apply wrote its end, which /me and the decision's screen read.
      expect(await restrictedUntil()).toBe(restriction.endsAt);
      expect((await world.moderation.standingFor(flow.reporter.id))!.reporting).toEqual({ warning: { decisionId: flow.warning, countsUntil: expect.any(String) }, restriction: { decisionId: flow.restriction, until: restriction.endsAt } });
      expect((await authorDecisionView(deps(), flow.reporter.id, flow.restriction)).reportingStanding).toEqual({ state: "running", until: restriction.endsAt, endedAt: null, endedBy: null });
      // The warning's decision says that a restriction rests on it, for [review.warning].
      expect((await view(flow.warningCase)).decisions.find((decision) => decision.id === flow.warning)!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
      expect(await otherLine()).toBe(flow.otherLine);

    test("while it runs, the reporter's report under a rule is refused reporting_restricted and counts nothing; its notice of illegality, its report of child sexual abuse material and its request for a re-examination are taken", async () => {

      expect(await record(apiDb, flow.reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 11, unfounded: 11 });

      expect(listed.find((item) => item.id === first.id)).toMatchObject({ outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: true });
      expect(listed.find((item) => item.id === flow.reports[1]!.id)).toMatchObject({ outcome: null, unfounded: false });

      const first = flow.reports[0]!;
      const correction = await decided(decider, first.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: flow.marking[0]!, outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
      expect((await view(first.caseId)).items.find((item) => item.id === first.id)).toMatchObject({ unfounded: false, markWithdrawn: true });
      expect(await record(apiDb, flow.reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 11, unfounded: 10 });
      expect((await apiDb.execute<{ author_mail: string }>(sql`select author_mail::text from decisions where id = ${correction}::uuid`))[0]!.author_mail).toBe("none");
      const listed = (await reporterList(listDeps(), flow.reporter.id)).reports.flatMap((report) => report.items);
      expect(listed.find((item) => item.id === first.id)).toMatchObject({ outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: false });
      // A mark is added only in the transaction of its own decision.
      await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {

      });

    test("the warning lifted on appeal ends the restriction that rests on it in that review: the column clears, the review's statement says so, the restriction's screen reads it, and reports under the rules are taken again", async () => {
      await appealOf(apiDb, flow.warning, flow.reporter.id);
      const outcome = await world.reviewAs(reviewer, flow.warning, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("lift_reporting")] });
      if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
      const review = outcome.decisionId;
      expect(await restrictedUntil()).toBeNull();
      expect((await world.moderation.standingFor(flow.reporter.id))!.reporting).toBeNull();
      const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, review))!;
      const restrictionAt = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, flow.restriction))!.statement.decidedAt;
      expect(found.statement.reversals).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "lift_reporting", liftedKind: "warn_reporting", liftedDecidedAt: flow.warnedAt })]);
      expect(found.statement.endedStanding).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", decidedAt: restrictionAt, periodThen: { state: "running", startedAt: restrictionAt, endedAt: null }, seal: false, replyFiledAt: null }]);
      const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
      expect(paragraphs).toContain(W.reportingLifted.warning);
      expect(paragraphs).toContain(`${W.basisEndedReporting(utc(restrictionAt))} ${W.basisEndedReportingThen.running}`);
      // A lift of a reporting measure, also one that ends a restriction with its warning, rides on 3c's mail.
      expect(mailTemplateOf(found.statement, paragraphs)).toMatchObject({ template: "moderation_decision" });
      const ended = (await authorDecisionView(deps(), flow.reporter.id, flow.restriction)).reportingStanding;
      expect(ended).toMatchObject({ state: "basis_ended", endedBy: review, endedAt: expect.any(String) });
      // The person's list names the restriction's days and what the review ended.
      const rows = (await authorCases(deps(), flow.reporter.id)).decisions;
      expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === flow.restriction)).toMatchObject({ actions: ["restrict_reporting"], reportingDays: 7 });
      expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === review)).toMatchObject({ actions: ["lift_reporting"], endedStanding: ["restrict_reporting"] });
      expect(rows.find((row) => row.id === flow.warning)).not.toHaveProperty("endedStanding");
      // Reports under the rules are taken again, and counted.
      expect((await recordIntake(deps(), { ground: ground.rule(flow.reporter.id, "R1"), live: [aPost(await newPostRow(apiDb, flow.author.id))] })).items).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(await record(apiDb, flow.reporter.id)).toEqual({ reports: 12, unfounded: 10 });
      expect(await otherLine()).toBe(flow.otherLine);
    });

    test("a report sent before the frame and marked inside it counts on neither side", async () => {
      const [sender, author] = [await account(), await account()];
      const report = await reportedPost(apiDb, sender.id, author.id);
      expect(await record(apiDb, sender.id)).toEqual({ reports: 1, unfounded: 0 });
      await ageStandingForTest(world.migrateDb, sender.id, `${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays + 1} days`);
      expect(await record(apiDb, sender.id)).toEqual({ reports: 0, unfounded: 0 });
      const decision = await marked(report);
      expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, decision)).length).toBe(0);
      expect((await apiDb.execute(sql`select 1 from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${report.id}::uuid`)).length).toBe(1);
      expect(await record(apiDb, sender.id)).toEqual({ reports: 0, unfounded: 0 });
    });
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the tables it writes hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});

  markup
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .split(" ")
    .filter((part) => part !== "")
    .join(" ");

The decision is under Settings, Cases, where you can appeal it. You can still report illegal content: choose "It is illegal". For the sexual abuse or exploitation of a child, choose the third answer.`,
    );

    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.cases.warned(COUNTS)).toBe(`A warning about your reports counts until ${standingTime(COUNTS)}.`);
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.reports.marked).toBe("A moderator marked this report as manifestly unfounded (Terms, Reporting in bad faith). You can ask for a re-examination.");
    expect(STANDING_TEXTS.reporting.warningGone(UNTIL)).toBe(`Ended on ${standingDay(UNTIL)} with the warning it rested on, which korbat lifted.`);
    expect(CASE_ROW_WORDS.restricted(30)).toBe("your reports under the rules restricted for 30 days");
    expect(CASE_ROW_WORDS.restricted(1)).toBe("your reports under the rules restricted for 1 day");
    // A refusal's own words are the restricted sentence without its date, which /me adds on the form.

    expect(page([item({})])).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.reports.marked);
    expect(page([item({ unfounded: false })])).not.toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.reports.marked);

});

  const view = (reportingStanding: DecisionView["reportingStanding"]): DecisionView => ({

 * answer says the database would accept it and greyed with its sentence otherwise ([reports.first] among them); the
 * queue's Replies to answer, which never carry a reply's words; the reply's block on the case page and its answer, Keep
 * or Reverse; "Withdraw it for another measure"; the Standing screen's four lists; the home screen's two lines; and the
 * appeals' order. Pure parts are tested as functions, screens server-rendered.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-12T09:30:00.000Z");
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const DIGESTS = { snapshot: "cd".repeat(32), facts: "aa".repeat(32), reason: "bb".repeat(32), legalReference: null };

const final = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], change: Partial<CaseDraft> = {}): CaseDraft => ({ ...newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role), kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", ...change });
const withStandingOf = (view: CaseView, change: Partial<NonNullable<CaseView["standing"]>>): CaseView => ({ ...view, standing: { ...view.standing!, ...change } });

function composer(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft) {
  const props: ComposerViewProps = { view, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop };
  return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
}

/** The case page as a person of this role sees it, with the controls beside each decision. */
function casePage(view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"]) {
  const base: CaseScreenViewProps = {
    caseId: caseId(view.id),
    view,
    shownImage: null,
    busy: null,
    notice: null,
    error: null,
    note: "",
    reveal: null,
    onOpenCase: noop,
    onShowImage: noop,
    onShowClearly: noop,
    onHideImage: noop,
    onImageError: noop,
    onSnapshot: noop,
    onNoteChange: noop,
    onNoteSave: noop,
    onRevealOpen: noop,
    onRevealChange: noop,
    onRevealConfirm: noop,
    onRevealClose: noop,
    compose: {
      role,
      draft: newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role),
      now: NOW,
      busy: false,
      error: null,
      textErrors: {},
      declining: null,
      onChange: noop,
      onTextBlur: noop,
      onSeal: noop,
      onConfirm: noop,
      onDeclineOpen: noop,
      onDeclineChange: noop,
      onDeclineSave: noop,
      onDeclineClose: noop,
      onCancelCorrection: noop,
      onCorrect: noop,
      onReview: noop,
      onAnswer: noop,
      onWithdraw: noop,
      onWithdrawMarks: noop,
    },
  };
  return html(<CaseScreenView {...base} />);
}

/** The decision of a fixture case that holds the measure. */
const decisionOf = (view: CaseView, id: string): CaseDecision => view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === id)!;

/** The replied decision with its measure's reply or period changed. */
function repliedWith(change: { reply?: Partial<NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["reply"]>>; period?: NonNullable<CaseDecision["actions"][number]["period"]>; needsAdmin?: boolean }): CaseDecision {
  const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
  const measure = decided.actions[0]!;
  return {
    ...decided,
    needsAdmin: change.needsAdmin ?? decided.needsAdmin,
    actions: [{ ...measure, reply: { ...measure.reply!, ...change.reply }, period: change.period ?? measure.period }],
  };
}

describe("3e Task 4: the announced measures in the composer of an account case (design, section 8.3)", () => {
  test("the words are the design's, each number printed from STANDING_RULES or REPLY_AIM_HOURS", () => {
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.label).toBe("Announce a suspension");
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.short(2)).toBe(`Not open: an announced suspension needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} active strikes. This account has 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.notYet).toContain(`needs ${STANDING_RULES.ladderDays.length} suspensions under the ladder decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.noRepeat).toContain(`a final R5 decision at most ${STANDING_RULES.basisAgeDays} days old`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim).toBe(`waiting more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.lists.reportingRow("someone", 5, 8)).toBe(`@someone: 5 of the 8 rule reports sent in the last ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays} days hold a mark manifestly unfounded.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.home.strikes(2)).toBe(`Accounts at ${STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes} strikes: 2.`);
    expect(STANDING_WORDS.appealsOrder).toBe("Appeals of a running suspension or of a termination come first.");
  });

  test("each control is open when the case answer says the database would accept it, and greyed with its reason otherwise", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { live: true }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "conflict" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { activeStrikes: 2 }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "short" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { maxDays: null }), MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "stale" });
    // A termination is an admin's: announced at the ladder's end, at once on a second direct threat.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "admin" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "notYet" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { mayTerminate: true, openReports: true }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN), "announceTerminate")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "reportsFirst" });
    expect(standingControlState(view, ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "noRepeat" });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R5" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: true });
    expect(standingControlState(withStandingOf(view, { atOnce: ["threat_repeat"] }), ADMIN, final(view, ADMIN, { ruleId: "R2" }), "terminateAtOnce")).toEqual({ open: false, why: "r2" });
    // Not shown at all while deciding, or for an outcome that restricts nothing.
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { kind: "interim" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
    expect(standingControlState(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR, { outcome: "no_violation" }), "announce")).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the composer shows the announce control with the rung's days and the newest strike's rule, and greys it with [reports.first] while a report waits", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const open = composer(view, MODERATOR, final(view, MODERATOR));
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox"/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.rule("R1")));
    // A moderator is offered no termination: both are greyed with [terminate.admin].
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a termination</span>');
    expect(open).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Terminate at once</span>');
    expect(open).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.terminate.admin));
    const waiting = ladderCase(true);
    const greyed = composer(waiting, MODERATOR, final(waiting, MODERATOR));
    expect(greyed).toContain('<input type="checkbox" disabled=""/> <span>Announce a suspension</span>');
    expect(greyed).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reportsFirst));
    expect(greyed).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.suspend.days(3, 1)));
  });

  test("choosing it adds the announced suspension under the newest strike's rule with the drafted facts; the params sign its days and announced true; the preview says nothing is restricted yet", () => {
    const view = ladderCase();
    const draft = withStanding(view, final(view, MODERATOR), "announce", 2);
    expect(draft.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }]);
    expect(draft.ruleId).toBe("R1");
    expect(draft.category).toBe(RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1);
    expect(draft.written.facts).toBe(
      "When this was written the account had 3 active strikes. Each was given by a decision that found a breach of a korbat rule in a post, and each of those decisions was sent to the account with its reasons.",
    );
    expect(draft.written.reason).toBe("");
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual(draft.actions);
    // More days than the rung, another rule than the newest strike's, or a report that waits, lose the measure.
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 4, announced: true }] }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(view, MODERATOR, { ...draft, ruleId: "R3" }).actions).toEqual([]);
    expect(offeredDraft(ladderCase(true), MODERATOR, draft).actions).toEqual([]);
    // At most one measure of the four: a termination chosen after it puts the suspension away.
    expect(withStanding(view, draft, "announceTerminate", null).actions).toEqual([{ kind: "terminate", mediaId: null, days: null, announced: true }]);
    const params = CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, reason: "Three strikes in two weeks." } }, DIGESTS));
    expect(params).toMatchObject({ kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, days: 2, announced: true }], replaced: false });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, draft, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.suspendAnnounced(2)} It rests on the active strikes of your account:`);
    expect(told).not.toContain("It breaks korbat rule");
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: replies, their answer and the withdrawal (design, sections 8.5 and 8.7)", () => {
  test("where a reply stands, and who may answer it", () => {
    const decided = decisionOf(repliedCase(), DECISION_REPLIED);
    const found = replyOf(decided)!;
    expect(found.reply.text).toBe(REPLY_TEXT);
    expect(replyState(found.measure, found.reply)).toBe("onTime");
    expect(answerable(decided, MODERATOR)).toBe(true);
    const late = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-06T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-09T09:00:00.000Z", state: "ended" } });
    expect(replyState(late.actions[0]!, late.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("lateEnded");
    const running = repliedWith({ reply: { onTime: false }, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-14T09:00:00.000Z", state: "running" } });
    expect(replyState(running.actions[0]!, running.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("late");
    const answered = repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } });
    expect(replyState(answered.actions[0]!, answered.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("answered");
    expect(answerable(answered, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    const gone = repliedWith({ period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "basis_ended" } });
    expect(replyState(gone.actions[0]!, gone.actions[0]!.reply!)).toBe("basisGone");
    expect(answerable(gone, ADMIN)).toBe(false);
    // [reply.admin]: a reply to a measure that needed an admin is answered by an admin.
    const admins = repliedWith({ needsAdmin: true });
    expect(answerable(admins, MODERATOR)).toBe(false);
    expect(answerable(admins, ADMIN)).toBe(true);
    expect(replyOf(decisionOf(withdrawCase(), DECISION_WITHDRAW))).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the queue's Replies to answer: how long each waited, before or after the start, what it is against, over the aim; never its words", () => {
    const replies: QueueReply[] = [
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, kind: "suspend", days: 3, filedAt: "2026-10-12T08:00:00.000Z", onTime: true, endsAt: null },
      { caseId: CASE_REPLIED, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "suspend", days: 5, filedAt: "2026-10-10T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: "2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z" },
      { caseId: CASE_LADDER, decisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, kind: "terminate", days: null, filedAt: "2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z", onTime: false, endsAt: null },
    ];
    expect(replyWords(replies[0]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.before, STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(3)]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[1]!, NOW.getTime())).toEqual([STANDING_WORDS.reply.afterEnded(dateTime("2026-10-11T09:00:00.000Z")), STANDING_WORDS.reply.suspension(5), STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim]);
    expect(replyWords(replies[2]!, NOW.getTime())[1]).toBe(STANDING_WORDS.reply.termination);
    const props: QueueViewProps = {
      rows: { state: "ready", value: [] },
      replies,
      more: false,
      loadingMore: false,
      now: NOW.getTime(),
      finding: { link: "", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", busy: false, error: null },
      onLoadMore: noop,
      onOpenCase: noop,
      onFindingChange: noop,
      onFindingSubmit: noop,
    };
    const out = html(<QueueView {...props} />);
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.title}</h3>`);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_REPLIED}`, `/cases/${CASE_LADDER}`]);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.overAim));
    expect(out).not.toContain("film");
    expect(html(<QueueView {...props} replies={[]} />)).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.none);
  });

  test("the case page shows the reply's text as text with [reply.onTime], and Answer this reply; once answered, the day it was answered and no control", () => {
    const out = casePage(repliedCase(), MODERATOR);
    expect(out).toContain(`aria-label="${STANDING_WORDS.reply.blockTitle}"`);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    expect(out).not.toContain(HOSTILE.script);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.onTime));
    expect(out).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    const view = repliedCase();
    view.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { answeredAt: "2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: DECISION_WITHDRAW } })];
    const answered = casePage(view, MODERATOR);
    expect(answered).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.answered(dateTime("2026-10-07T09:00:00.000Z"))));
    expect(answered).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.reply.answerLabel}</button>`);
    // A reply with no text asks for a second look.
    const empty = repliedCase();
    empty.decisions = [repliedWith({ reply: { text: null } })];
    expect(casePage(empty, MODERATOR)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.empty));
  });

  test("the answer: Keep lifts nothing and Reverse lifts the measure, each said by when the reply came; the params are a correction; the preview answers the reply", () => {
    const view = repliedCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_REPLIED);
    const draft = answerDraft(caseId(view.id), view, decided, MODERATOR);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, answer: "kept", actions: [] });
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.keepLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(STANDING_WORDS.reply.reverseLabel);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.keep.onTime(dateTime("2026-10-12T09:00:00.000Z"), 3)));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reply.same));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(REPLY_TEXT));
    const kept = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "Your reply did not change the strikes." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, kept, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "kept", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_REPLIED, actions: [], replaced: false });
    const keptTold = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, kept, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(keptTold).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.replyKept("2026-10-05 09:00 UTC"));
    expect(keptTold).toContain("The suspension of 3 days starts at");
    const reversed = withAnswer(kept, decided, "reversed");
    expect(reversed.actions).toEqual([{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }]);
    expect(composer(view, MODERATOR, reversed)).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.reverse.onTime));
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, reversed, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: false });
    expect(withAnswer(reversed, decided, "kept").actions).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("Withdraw it for another measure: an admin's, while the account's measure is live, for an announced measure that has not started; signed replaced", () => {
    const view = withdrawCase();
    const decided = decisionOf(view, DECISION_WITHDRAW);
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, ADMIN)?.kind).toBe("suspend");
    expect(withdrawable(view, decided, MODERATOR)).toBeNull();
    expect(withdrawable(withStandingOf(view, { live: false }), decided, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    const started = { ...decided, actions: [{ ...decided.actions[0]!, period: { startsAt: "2026-10-12T09:05:00.000Z", endsAt: "2026-10-15T09:05:00.000Z", state: "running" as const } }] };
    expect(withdrawable(view, started, ADMIN)).toBeNull();
    expect(casePage(view, ADMIN)).toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    expect(casePage(view, MODERATOR)).not.toContain(`>${STANDING_WORDS.replace.label}</button>`);
    const draft = withdrawDraft(caseId(CASE_WITHDRAW), view, decided, ADMIN);
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: DECISION_WITHDRAW, replaced: true, actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }] });
    const out = composer(view, ADMIN, draft);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.replace.what));
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(STANDING_WORDS.replace.reply));
    const written = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "A threat since needs a suspension at once." } };
    expect(CaseDecidedParams.parse(decisionParamsOf(view, written, DIGESTS))).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "lift_suspension", mediaId: null }], replaced: true });
    const told = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, written, NOW)).join(" | ");
    expect(told).toContain("because it is taking another measure on your account.");
    expect(told).not.toContain("korbat corrected its decision");
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the Standing screen, the home screen's lines and the appeals' order (design, sections 8.5, 8.6 and 8.8)", () => {
