import { AppealsPage, AppealsReviewedParams, CaseView, MEASURES, StaffOverview, textDigest, type AppealRow, type CaseAppeal, type CaseDecision, type StaffMe } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { App } from "../src/App";
import { createStaffApi } from "../src/api";
import { COMPOSER, complete, confirmDecision, newDraft, previewOf, reviewChoices, reviewDraft, reviewOutcomeOf, reviewParamsOf, reviewable, shownSnapshotDigest, textsOffered, type CaseDraft } from "../src/compose";
import { APPEAL_WORDS, CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES, MODERATION_MESSAGES, REVIEW_OUTCOMES, messageFor } from "../src/messages";
import { parseCaseId } from "../src/router";
import { AppealsView, readAppeals } from "../src/screens/Appeals";
import { CaseScreenView, type CaseScreenViewProps } from "../src/screens/Case";
import { ComposerView, ReviewControl, type ComposerViewProps } from "../src/screens/Composer";
import { appealsLine, OverviewView } from "../src/screens/Home";
import { reviewAction } from "../src/step-up";
import { createConsoleStore } from "../src/store";
import { dateTime } from "../src/ui";
import { CASE_FROZEN, CASE_POST, decision, frozenCase, IMAGE_ONE, item, ITEM_REEXAMINATION, overview, postCase } from "./case-fixtures";
import { envelope, FakeClock, fakeCredentials, fakeFetch, hrefs, makeMe, SESSION_HANDLE, stepUpChallenge, stepUpOptions } from "./fixtures";

/**
 * Appeals in the console (3c design, sections 7.7 and 8): the home screen's line, the appeals screen, the appeal's marks
 * on the case page, and the review composer with its params, its preview and its confirmation by the key. The pure parts
 * are tested as functions, the screens server-rendered.
 */
const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const esc = (text: string): string => text.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#x27;");
const noop = () => undefined;
const caseId = (id: string) => parseCaseId(id)!;
const NOW = new Date("2026-10-09T09:30:00.000Z");
const MODERATOR: StaffMe["role"] = "moderator";
const ADMIN: StaffMe["role"] = "admin";
const HEX = "cd".repeat(32);
const APPEAL_ID = "d1e2f304-1526-4738-99a4-cfd0e1f20314";
const REMOVAL_ID = "9daebfc0-d1e2-43f4-9560-8b9cadbecfd0";
const SEAL_FOR_GOOD =
  "A seal for good is lifted only on the authority's answer that the images are not child sexual abuse material. Say in the reason that the authority has answered, and the date of its answer. Never write its reference or anything that names a person: the reference stays in the operator's records, off the server.";

/** A final removal of the post and of one image, decided by someone else, under the first rulebook. */
const removal: CaseDecision = decision({
  id: REMOVAL_ID,
  kind: "final",
  rulesVersion: 1,
  category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
  staffHandle: "mod_anna",
  throughSeq: 2,
  answersFromSeq: 1,
  actions: [
    { ...decision().actions[0]!, kind: "remove" },
    { ...decision().actions[0]!, id: "c0d1e2f3-0415-4627-8893-becfd0e1f203", kind: "remove_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
  ],
});
const appeal = (more: Partial<CaseAppeal> = {}): CaseAppeal => ({
  id: APPEAL_ID,
  decisionId: REMOVAL_ID,
  filedAt: "2026-10-05T10:00:00.000Z",
  statement: "The post quotes a film.",
  answeredAt: null,
  result: null,
  answeredBy: null,
  reviewer: "available",
  needsAdmin: false,
  mayReview: true,
  ...more,
});
/** A closed case whose final removal its author appealed. */
const appealed = (more: Partial<CaseAppeal> = {}, decided: CaseDecision = removal) => postCase({ closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z", answeredSeq: 2, decisions: [decided], appeals: [appeal({ decisionId: decided.id, ...more })] });

describe("the home screen's appeals line", () => {
  test("says how many wait, how many this person may review, and how many nobody may review now, then who a reviewer is", () => {
    expect(appealsLine({ appealsWaiting: 3, appealsYouMayReview: 1, appealsWithoutReviewer: 1 })).toBe("3 appeals wait; you may review 1; 1 has no possible reviewer now.");
    expect(appealsLine({ appealsWaiting: 1, appealsYouMayReview: 0, appealsWithoutReviewer: 0 })).toBe("1 appeal waits; you may review none.");
    expect(appealsLine({ appealsWaiting: 5, appealsYouMayReview: 5, appealsWithoutReviewer: 2 })).toBe("5 appeals wait; you may review 5; 2 have no possible reviewer now.");
    expect(appealsLine({ appealsWaiting: 0, appealsYouMayReview: 0, appealsWithoutReviewer: 0 })).toBe("No appeal waits.");
    const seen = overview({ appealsWaiting: 3, appealsYouMayReview: 1, appealsWithoutReviewer: 1 });
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(seen).success).toBe(true);
    const out = html(<OverviewView overview={seen} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(out).toContain("3 appeals wait; you may review 1; 1 has no possible reviewer now.");
    expect(out).toContain(esc("Appeals need a reviewer who made none of the case's decisions and opened no finding in it."));
    // With nothing waiting the rule is not repeated.
    const quiet = html(<OverviewView overview={overview({ appealsWaiting: 0, appealsYouMayReview: 0, appealsWithoutReviewer: 0 })} now={NOW.getTime()} onOpenCase={noop} />);
    expect(quiet).toContain("No appeal waits.");
    expect(quiet).not.toContain("Appeals need a reviewer");
  });
});

describe("the appeals screen", () => {
  const row = (more: Partial<AppealRow> = {}): AppealRow => ({
    id: APPEAL_ID,
    caseId: CASE_POST,
    decisionId: REMOVAL_ID,
    filedAt: "2026-10-05T10:00:00.000Z",
    decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    deadline: "2027-04-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    actions: ["remove", "remove_media"],
    reviewer: "available",
    needsAdmin: false,
    mayReview: true,
    standingFirst: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const view = (rows: AppealRow[], more = false) => html(<AppealsView rows={{ state: "ready", value: rows }} more={more} loadingMore={false} onLoadMore={noop} onOpenCase={noop} />);

  test("lists the pending appeals with their case link, the decision, the end of its appeal window, and whether this person may review", () => {
    const rows = [row(), row({ id: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425", caseId: CASE_FROZEN, ruleId: null, legal: true, actions: ["seal_media"], reviewer: "none_single_staff", needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false })];
    expect(AppealsPage.safeParse({ appeals: rows, nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(true);
    const out = view(rows);
    expect(out).toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>Appeals</);
    // Each row's only link leads to its case in the console, built from a checked id.
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual([`/cases/${CASE_POST}`, `/cases/${CASE_FROZEN}`]);
    expect(out).toContain("under R3");
    expect(out).toContain("on the law");
    expect(out).toContain(`${MEASURES.remove.label}, ${MEASURES.remove_media.label}`);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.seal_media.label);
    // Times are drawn in the browser's zone, as everywhere in the console.
    expect(out).toContain(`<time dateTime="2027-04-01T09:00:00.000Z">${dateTime("2027-04-01T09:00:00.000Z")}</time>`);
    expect(out).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.mayReview);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview));
    expect(out).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin));
    expect(out).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer.none_single_staff);
    // The statement is read on the case page: the list says so, and holds none.
    expect(out).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.statementOnCase));
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script");
    expect(view([])).toContain("No appeal waits.");
    expect(view(rows, true)).toContain(">Load more</button>");
    expect(view(rows)).not.toContain("Load more");
  });

  test("a row whose case id is no lower-case uuid gets no link, and each reviewer state has its words", () => {
    expect(hrefs(view([row({ caseId: CASE_POST.toUpperCase() })]))).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.keys(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer).sort()).toEqual(["available", "none_eligible", "none_single_staff"]);
  });

  test("the screen reads the list from its start, page after page, each read its person's own", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({
      "GET /api/staff/appeals": { status: 200, body: { appeals: [row()], nextCursor: "abc" } },
      "GET /api/staff/appeals?cursor=abc": { status: 200, body: { appeals: [row({ id: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425" })], nextCursor: null } },
    });
    const api = createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    expect(await readAppeals(api, 1)).toEqual({ rows: [row()], next: "abc" });
    const both = await readAppeals(api, 2);
    expect(both.rows.map((found) => found.id)).toEqual([APPEAL_ID, "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425"]);
    expect(both.next).toBeNull();
    expect(fake.requests.every((request) => request.headers["x-staff-activity"] === "1")).toBe(true);
    // An answer that is no page of appeals is refused, never shown.
    const broken = createStaffApi({ fetch: fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/appeals": { status: 200, body: { appeals: [{ ...row(), reviewer: "everyone" }], nextCursor: null } } }).fetch, cookie: () => "" });
    await expect(broken.appeals(null)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_answer" });
  });

  test("the address /appeals shows the screen", async () => {
    const fake = fakeFetch({ "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: makeMe() } });
    const store = createConsoleStore({ api: createStaffApi({ fetch: fake.fetch, cookie: () => "" }), clock: new FakeClock(), path: "/appeals", history: { pushState: noop, replaceState: noop } });
    await store.start();
    const out = html(<App store={store} credentials={fakeCredentials()} signal={undefined} />);
    expect(out).toMatch(/<h2[^>]*>Appeals</);
    expect(out).not.toContain("arrive later");
    store.dispose();
  });
});

describe("an appeal on the case page", () => {
  const page = (view: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) => {
    const draft = newDraft(caseId(view.id), view, role);
    const compose: CaseScreenViewProps["compose"] = { role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, onCorrect: noop, onReview: noop, onAnswer: noop, onWithdraw: noop, onWithdrawMarks: noop };
    const props: CaseScreenViewProps = { caseId: caseId(view.id), view, compose, shownImage: null, busy: null, notice: null, error: null, note: "", reveal: null, onOpenCase: noop, onShowImage: noop, onShowClearly: noop, onHideImage: noop, onImageError: noop, onSnapshot: noop, onNoteChange: noop, onNoteSave: noop, onRevealOpen: noop, onRevealChange: noop, onRevealConfirm: noop, onRevealClose: noop };
    return html(<CaseScreenView {...props} />);
  };

  test("a pending appeal shows its statement as text, who may review it, and Review this appeal for the person who may", () => {
    const view = appealed({ statement: "<script>alert(1)</script>" });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(view).success).toBe(true);
    const out = page(view);
    expect(out).toContain("&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;");
    expect(out).not.toContain("<script>");
    expect(out).toContain("not answered yet");
    expect(out).toContain(">Review this appeal</button>");
    // Someone who took part in the case reads why there is no button, in words that name nobody.
    const mine = page(appealed({ mayReview: false }));
    expect(mine).not.toContain("Review this appeal</button>");
    expect(mine).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview));
    // A review that is an admin's, and an appeal nobody can review now, say so.
    const needsAdmin = page(appealed({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false, reviewer: "none_single_staff" }));
    expect(needsAdmin).toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.needsAdmin));
    expect(needsAdmin).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer.none_single_staff);
    expect(page(appealed({ reviewer: "none_eligible", mayReview: false }))).toContain(APPEAL_WORDS.reviewer.none_eligible);
  });

  test("an answered appeal shows its result and offers no review", () => {
    const out = page(appealed({ answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", result: "partly_reversed", answeredBy: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }));
    expect(out).toContain("answered: partly reversed");
    expect(out).not.toContain("Review this appeal");
    expect(out).not.toContain(esc(APPEAL_WORDS.mayNotReview));
  });

  test("a re-examination is marked on its item, and for whoever decided the item it re-examines", () => {
    const view = postCase({ items: [item({ id: ITEM_REEXAMINATION, seq: 3, reexaminesPosition: 2, reexaminesYourDecision: true, statement: "Look at the second image." })] });
    const out = page(view);
    expect(out).toContain("Re-examination of item 2 of its notice");
    expect(out).toContain("You decided the item this re-examines. Leave it to another staff member when there is one.");
    expect(out).toContain("Look at the second image.");
    expect(page(postCase({ items: [item({ id: ITEM_REEXAMINATION, seq: 3, reexaminesPosition: 2, reexaminesYourDecision: false })] }))).not.toContain("You decided the item this re-examines");
  });
});

describe("the review composer", () => {
  const view = appealed();
  const draftOf = (shown: CaseView = view, decided: CaseDecision = removal, role: StaffMe["role"] = MODERATOR) => reviewDraft(caseId(shown.id), shown, decided, role);
  const composer = (shown: CaseView, role: StaffMe["role"], draft: CaseDraft, extra: Partial<ComposerViewProps> = {}) => {
    const props: ComposerViewProps = { view: shown, role, draft, now: NOW, busy: false, error: null, textErrors: {}, declining: null, onChange: noop, onTextBlur: noop, onSeal: noop, onConfirm: noop, onDeclineOpen: noop, onDeclineChange: noop, onDeclineSave: noop, onDeclineClose: noop, onCancelCorrection: noop, ...extra };
    return html(<ComposerView {...props} />);
  };
  const reasoned = (draft: CaseDraft): CaseDraft => ({ ...draft, written: { ...draft.written, review_reason: "The rule does not cover a quotation." } });

  test("a decision's pending appeal is reviewed by the person the API marked, and by nobody else", () => {
    expect(reviewable(view, removal)).toMatchObject({ appeal: { id: APPEAL_ID }, measures: [{ kind: "remove" }, { kind: "remove_media" }] });
    expect(reviewable(appealed({ mayReview: false }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(reviewable(appealed({ result: "kept", answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(reviewable(postCase({ decisions: [removal], appeals: [] }), removal)).toBeNull();
    expect(html(<ReviewControl view={view} decision={removal} disabled={false} onReview={noop} />)).toContain(">Review this appeal</button>");
    expect(html(<ReviewControl view={appealed({ mayReview: false })} decision={removal} disabled={false} onReview={noop} />)).toBe("");
  });

  test("Keep, Reverse in part and Reverse: the outcome follows what is lifted, and each is complete only as its name says", () => {
    const draft = draftOf();
    expect(draft).toMatchObject({ kind: "review", reviewsDecisionId: REMOVAL_ID, review: "kept", actions: [], category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" });
    expect(textsOffered(draft)).toEqual(["review_reason"]);
    expect(reviewChoices(view, draft, MODERATOR).map((choice) => choice.reversal)).toEqual([
      { kind: "restore", mediaId: null },
      { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
    ]);
    // Nothing is complete without its reason.
    expect(complete(view, draft)).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned(draft))).toBe(true);
    // Keep lifts nothing; Reverse lifts everything still in force; Reverse in part lifts something and leaves something.
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }))).toBe(false);
    const all = [{ kind: "restore" as const, mediaId: null }, { kind: "restore_media" as const, mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }];
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "reversed", actions: all }))).toBe(true);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "reversed", actions: [all[0]!] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [all[0]!] }))).toBe(true);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: all }))).toBe(false);
    expect(complete(view, reasoned({ ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(reviewOutcomeOf(view, { ...draft, review: "partly_reversed", actions: [all[0]!] })).toBe("partly_reversed");
    expect(REVIEW_OUTCOMES).toEqual({ kept: "Keep", partly_reversed: "Reverse in part", reversed: "Reverse" });
  });

  test("the composer shows the three choices, the reversals of what is still in force, the reason with the sentence on personal data, and the preview of the review's statement", () => {
    const out = composer(view, MODERATOR, reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }));
    expect(out).toMatch(/<h3[^>]*>Review the appeal</);
    for (const label of ["Keep", "Reverse in part", "Reverse"]) expect(out).toContain(`<span>${label}</span>`);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.restore_media.label);
    expect(out).toContain(`<code>${IMAGE_ONE}</code>`);
    expect(out).toContain("Reason of the review");
    expect(out).toContain(esc(COMPOSER.personalData));
    // The preview is the statement its author gets: the review's lead, the reviewed decision's rule in its own version, the reason.
    const preview = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] }), NOW));
    expect(preview[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "partly_reversed"));
    expect(preview).toContain(`That decision rested on korbat rule R1, "${getRule("R1", 1)!.title}": ${getRule("R1", 1)!.text}`);
    expect(preview).toContain("Why korbat changed it: The rule does not cover a quotation.");
    for (const paragraph of preview) expect(out, paragraph).toContain(esc(paragraph));
    expect(out).toContain(">Confirm with your staff key</button>");
    // A kept review tells its author so, and lists no reversal as chosen.
    const kept = statementParagraphs(previewOf(view, reasoned(draftOf()), NOW));
    expect(kept[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "kept"));
    expect(kept).toContain("Why korbat kept it: The rule does not cover a quotation.");
    // The appeal that was open when the composer opened is answered meanwhile: nothing is left to review.
    const gone = composer(appealed({ result: "kept", answeredAt: "2026-10-08T10:00:00.000Z", reviewer: null, mayReview: false }), MODERATOR, reasoned(draftOf()));
    expect(gone).toContain("This appeal is answered, or is not yours to review.");
    expect(gone).not.toContain("Confirm with your staff key");
  });

  test("Lift the seal stands in an admin's review alone, with the sentence on when a seal for good is lifted; a moderator is offered no review of such a decision", () => {
    const sealAction = frozenCase().decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const sealed: CaseDecision = decision({ id: REMOVAL_ID, kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", suspect: true, needsAdmin: true, throughSeq: 2, answersFromSeq: 1, staffHandle: "admin_ben", actions: [sealAction] });
    const forAdmin = appealed({ needsAdmin: true }, sealed);
    expect(reviewChoices(forAdmin, draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, ADMIN), ADMIN).map((choice) => choice.reversal.kind)).toEqual(["unseal_media"]);
    const out = composer(forAdmin, ADMIN, reasoned({ ...draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, ADMIN), review: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "unseal_media", mediaId: null }] }));
    expect(out).toContain(MEASURES.unseal_media.label);
    expect(out).toContain(esc(SEAL_FOR_GOOD));
    // The API marks such an appeal as not a moderator's to review: no control, and a composer opened all the same shows nothing to confirm.
    const forModerator = appealed({ needsAdmin: true, mayReview: false }, sealed);
    expect(reviewable(forModerator, sealed)).toBeNull();
    expect(composer(forModerator, MODERATOR, reasoned(draftOf(forModerator, sealed, MODERATOR)))).not.toContain("Confirm with your staff key");
    expect(reviewChoices(forAdmin, draftOf(forAdmin, sealed, MODERATOR), MODERATOR)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the review's params: the appeal, the reviewed decision's category and rules version, the reversals in their one order, and the outcome as chosen", () => {
    const draft = reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE }, { kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] });
    const params = reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) });
    expect(params).toEqual({
      stateVersion: view.stateVersion,
      appealId: APPEAL_ID,
      snapshotId: view.snapshots[0]!.id,
      snapshotDigest: HEX,
      outcome: "reversed",
      rulesVersion: 1,
      redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
      category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
      actions: [
        { kind: "restore", mediaId: null },
        { kind: "restore_media", mediaId: IMAGE_ONE },
      ],
      reasonDigest: "bb".repeat(32),
    });
    expect(AppealsReviewedParams.safeParse(params).success).toBe(true);
    expect(reviewAction(REMOVAL_ID, params)).toEqual({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: REMOVAL_ID }, params });
    expect(reviewParamsOf(view, reasoned(draftOf()), { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) })).toMatchObject({ outcome: "kept", actions: [] });
    // Without a pending appeal there is nothing to build.
    expect(() => reviewParamsOf(postCase({ decisions: [removal], appeals: [] }), draft, { snapshot: HEX, reason: "bb".repeat(32) })).toThrow();
  });

  describe("confirmed by the key", () => {
    const draft = reasoned({ ...draftOf(), review: "partly_reversed", actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }] });
    const after = postCase({ closedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z", stateVersion: 4, decisions: [removal], appeals: [appeal({ result: "partly_reversed", answeredAt: "2026-10-09T09:30:00.000Z", answeredBy: "e2f30415-2637-4849-8ab5-d0e1f2031425", reviewer: null, mayReview: false })] });

    async function run(options: { review?: { status: number; body: unknown }; bind?: (action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => object } = {}) {
      const saves: { kind: string; text: string; salt: string; digest: string }[] = [];
      let action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction> | null = null;
      const fake = fakeFetch({
        "GET /api/staff/me": { status: 200, body: makeMe() },
        [`POST /api/staff/decisions/${REMOVAL_ID}/review`]: options.review ?? { status: 201, body: after },
      });
      const fetch: typeof fake.fetch = async (input, init) => {
        const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? (JSON.parse(init.body) as Record<string, unknown>) : undefined;
        if (input === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}/texts` && init?.method === "POST") {
          await fake.fetch(input, init);
          saves.push(body as (typeof saves)[number]);
          return new Response(JSON.stringify({ id: "bfc0d1e2-f304-4516-b782-adbecfd0e1f2", digest: body!.digest }), { status: 201, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
        }
        if (input === "/api/staff/step-up/options") {
          await fake.fetch(input, init);
          action = body as ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>;
          return new Response(JSON.stringify(stepUpOptions(await stepUpChallenge(SESSION_HANDLE, (options.bind ? options.bind(action) : action) as never))), { status: 200, headers: { "content-type": "application/json" } });
        }
        return fake.fetch(input, init);
      };
      const credentials = fakeCredentials();
      const api = createStaffApi({ fetch, cookie: () => "__Host-korbat_staff_csrf=t" });
      const outcome = await confirmDecision({ api, credentials, random: (length) => new Uint8Array(length).fill(7) }, caseId(CASE_POST), view, draft);
      return { outcome, credentials, requests: fake.requests, saves, action: action as ReturnType<typeof reviewAction> | null };
    }

    test("the reason is saved as a review reason, the key confirms the review of exactly that decision, and the answer is the case as it now stands", async () => {
      const done = await run();
      expect(done.outcome).toEqual({ view: after });
      expect(done.credentials.calls).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(done.saves.map((save) => save.kind)).toEqual(["review_reason"]);
      const shown = view.snapshots[0]!;
      if (shown.withheld) throw new Error("the fixture's newest snapshot shows its content");
      const reason = await textDigest("07".repeat(32), "The rule does not cover a quotation.");
      expect(done.action).toEqual({ action: "appeals_reviewed", target: { type: "decision", id: REMOVAL_ID }, params: reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: await shownSnapshotDigest(shown), reason }) });
      const sent = done.requests.at(-1)!;
      expect(`${sent.method} ${sent.url} ${sent.headers["x-staff-activity"]}`).toBe(`POST /api/staff/decisions/${REMOVAL_ID}/review 1`);
      expect(sent.body).toMatchObject({ ...done.action!.params, stepUp: { type: "public-key" } });
    });

    test("options that bind another decision or another outcome are refused before the key is asked, and no review is sent", async () => {
      for (const bind of [(action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => ({ ...action, target: { ...action.target, id: CASE_FROZEN } }), (action: ReturnType<typeof reviewAction>) => ({ ...action, params: { ...action.params, outcome: "kept" } })]) {
        const done = await run({ bind });
        expect(done.outcome).toMatchObject({ code: "step_up_mismatch" });

        expect(done.requests.some((request) => request.url.endsWith("/review"))).toBe(false);
      }

    test("an answer that carries another case is no answer, and each refusal is worded by the console, never by the server", async () => {
      expect((await run({ review: { status: 201, body: frozenCase() } })).outcome).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_answer" });
      for (const code of ["reviewer_conflict", "admin_required", "case_changed", "snapshot_erased", "staff_recused"] as const) {
        const done = await run({ review: { status: code === "case_changed" || code === "snapshot_erased" ? 409 : 403, body: envelope(code) } });
        expect(done.outcome, code).toEqual({ error: MODERATION_MESSAGES[code], code });

      expect(messageFor("snapshot_erased")).toBe(MODERATION_MESSAGES.snapshot_erased);
      expect(CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES).toContain("reviewer_conflict");
      expect(MODERATION_MESSAGES.reviewer_conflict).toBe("You cannot review this appeal: you made a decision in its case, or opened a finding in it. Another staff member must review it.");
    });
  });
});

/** The headers each static file was served with, by path. */

/** The text of every element holding a person-written string or an action, kept in `seen`. */
async function texts(): Promise<string[]> {
  const found = await userTexts(page);
  for (const text of found) seen.add(text);
  return found;
}

/** Waits for a locator to show, failing with what it looked for. */
async function shown(locator: Locator, timeout = 15_000): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await locator.first().waitFor({ state: "visible", timeout });
  } catch {
    throw new Error(`not shown within ${timeout} ms: ${locator.toString()}`);
  }
}

/** A virtual CTAP2 authenticator that verifies its user: a security key on USB, or a platform one whose passkeys sync. */
async function addAuthenticator(kind: "device-bound security key" | "synced platform passkey"): Promise<string> {
  const synced = kind === "synced platform passkey";
  const { authenticatorId } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator", {
    options: {
      protocol: "ctap2",
      transport: synced ? "internal" : "usb",
      hasResidentKey: true,
      hasUserVerification: true,
      isUserVerified: true,
      automaticPresenceSimulation: true,
      // The flags a password manager's passkey reports, and a security key never does.
      defaultBackupEligibility: synced,
      defaultBackupState: synced,
    },
  });
  return authenticatorId;
}

/** How many times an authenticator's keys have signed: the virtual authenticator counts every signature. */
async function signaturesOf(authenticatorId: string): Promise<number> {
  const { credentials } = await watcher.cdp.send("WebAuthn.getCredentials", { authenticatorId });
  return credentials.reduce((sum, credential) => sum + credential.signCount, 0);
}

/** How many times every staff key of the walk has signed. */
async function signatures(): Promise<number> {
  let sum = 0;
  for (const id of staffAuthenticators) sum += await signaturesOf(id);
  return sum;
}

/**
 * Waits until an expression is true in the page. The expression is plain text, sent as page.evaluate sends it: nothing
 * of the test runner's is put into the page, and nothing in the page evaluates it under the page's policy.
 */
async function until(expression: string, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150; tries++) {
    if (await page.evaluate(expression)) return;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/**
 * Waits until the fixtures have seen something. A text is saved when its field loses focus, and the request arrives a
 * moment after the key press that moved the focus.
 */
async function arrived(check: () => boolean, what: string): Promise<void> {
  for (let tries = 0; tries < 150 && !check(); tries++) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  if (!check()) throw new Error(`not within 15 s: ${what}`);
}

/** The one image of the page: whether it is there, loaded as a real image of 2 by 2 pixels, from this address, drawn with this class. */
const imageIs = (src: string, className: string) =>

/** The end of every step: no report, error or dialog on any channel, nothing in the page the console never writes, and no request the fixtures refused for the page's fault. */

  test("an image the API refuses says so in its place, in the console's words, and the case is read again", async () => {

  test("a reveal: nothing to confirm until a reason is chosen and written; the reason saved first, the key confirming its digest; the name in a frame of its own, kept when the case cannot be read again and gone once the dialog is closed; options that bind another item are refused before the key is asked", async () => {

    await shown(dialog);

    await why.selectOption("abuse_of_reporting");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);

    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await written.fill("The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);

    fixtures.state.recuseNextCaseRead = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(dialog.getByText("Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member"));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);

    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, text: "The same account reported forty posts of one author in an hour." });
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toEqual([{ itemId: ITEM_REPORTER, reasonDigest: reason.digest }]);
    // The name alone in its frame, under the console's own line that says what it is, with its hidden characters to show.
    await shown(dialog.getByText("The reporter's handle:", { exact: true }));
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    await shown(dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Show hidden characters" }));
    // The refused read left the case on the page and says why on the page's error line; the name is still there.
    await shown(page.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("staff_recused") }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_POST}`).at(-1)!.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await dialog.locator(".frame p.frame-text").textContent()).toBe(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    // Shown once: with the dialog closed the page holds the name nowhere.

    expect(await userTexts(page)).not.toContain(REVEALED_HANDLE);
    expect(await page.locator("#root").innerText()).not.toContain("a_reporter");
    await clean();

    // The server asks the key to confirm the reveal of another item: the key is never asked, and nothing is revealed.
    const reveals = fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length;
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;

    await why.selectOption("impersonation_claim");
    await written.fill("The notifier claims to be impersonated.");

    await shown(page.getByText(messageFor("step_up_mismatch")));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.path.endsWith("/reveal")).length).toBe(reveals);
    expect(fixtures.state.reveals).toHaveLength(1);
    await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }).click();
    await clean();
  });

  test("a decision whose step-up options bind other params is refused before the key is asked; the draft stays, and confirmed again it is recorded without its texts being saved twice", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();
    const sent = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path.endsWith("/decisions")).length;
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome this person may decide on the case; the page opens on a restriction.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.restricted, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    // A restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason before anything can be confirmed.
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.previewNeedsMeasure));
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus: the facts when the reason was begun, the reason now.
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "reason", text: "It sells followers, which the rule names." });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    // Under both fields of a restriction: the rule on personal data, and that the author receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.personalData, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.done.remove("2026-09-30 12:00 UTC"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`The facts: ${TYPED_FACTS}`);
    expect(await preview.last().textContent()).toMatch(/^You can appeal this decision once, free of charge, within six months of being told, until /);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);

    // The API asks the key to confirm another decision than the one the page built: the key is never asked.
    const [options, posted] = [fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed, sent()];
    fixtures.state.mismatchNextStepUp = true;
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("step_up_mismatch") }));
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options + 1);
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    // The confirmation saved nothing more: both texts were on the server before it. What was chosen and written is still there.
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_FACTS);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await clean();

    // Confirmed again, with options that bind the decision itself: the saved texts are used as they are.
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(sent()).toBe(posted + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    const [facts, reason] = fixtures.state.texts.slice(-2);
    expect(facts).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_POST, kind: "facts", text: TYPED_FACTS });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions[1]).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_POST,
      // 3e: the case answer says a strike is due, so the key confirmed it with the removal.
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 4, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: facts!.digest, reasonDigest: reason!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The answer is the case as it now stands: closed, with nothing more to decide on it.
    await shown(page.getByText("; closed ", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" }).getByText(COMPOSER.closed));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).count()).toBe(0);
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

  test("an admin's composer on a case with an unanswered report of child sexual abuse material: every outcome listed first, the choice not to seal only while deciding, and an answer without a measure that needs its facts, tells its author nothing and leaves the later report open", async () => {
    const [asked, before] = [fixtures.state.imageRequests.length, await signatures()];
    fixtures.state.role = "admin";

    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    const confirm = composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // The outcome comes first, with every outcome an admin may decide; beside them, that an answer now is given unseen.
    expect(await composer.locator("fieldset legend").first().textContent()).toBe("Outcome");
    for (const outcome of Object.values(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES)) expect(await composer.getByLabel(outcome, { exact: true }).count(), outcome).toBe(1);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.adminFinal).count()).toBe(0);
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.unseen));
    // While deciding, the seal and the choice not to seal stand side by side.
    expect(await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.interim).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }));
    // Deciding the case, an admin seals for good or answers without a seal: the choice not to seal is not offered.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_KINDS.final).check();
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.endsFreeze));
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER.admin.unseen));
    await shown(composer.getByRole("button", { name: MEASURES.seal_media.label }));
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);

    // An answer without a measure: no kind is asked, the category the key will confirm is shown, and the facts are needed.
    await composer.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "When" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.locator("legend", { hasText: "Measures" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Ground").count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByRole("button", { name: "Do not seal now" }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Category").inputValue()).toBe("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC");
    await composer.getByLabel("Category").selectOption("STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // Under both fields: never to say what the images are, and that the author never receives the text.
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(`${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.staysInRecord}`, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(2);
    expect(await composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor, { exact: false }).count()).toBe(0);
    // Nothing was done while deciding on this case, so the answer is told to nobody, and the page says so in the preview's place.
    await shown(composer.getByText(COMPOSER_WORDS.noStatement));
    expect(await composer.locator(".frame.preview").count()).toBe(0);
    const saved = fixtures.state.texts.length;
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("Nothing in the report or in the post supports it.");
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // Each text is saved, without the key, when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.length === saved + 2, "the reason and the facts saved when their fields lost focus");
    const written = (kind: string) => fixtures.state.texts.slice(saved).find((text) => text.kind === kind)!;
    expect(written("facts")).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_ADMIN, text: TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS });
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    await clean();

    await confirm.click();
    // The answer reaches the newest report of child sexual abuse material: the rule report that arrived after it stays open.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${COMPOSER.recorded} ${COMPOSER.leftForLater(1)}`));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(fixtures.state.texts).toHaveLength(saved + 2);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_ADMIN,
      params: { kind: "final", stateVersion: 3, throughSeq: 2, reviewsDecisionId: null, outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS", categoryKeyword: null, actions: [], factsDigest: written("facts").digest, reasonDigest: written("reason").digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the answer with its facts, for staff, and a composer for the report left open.
    await shown(page.getByText("; version 4", { exact: false }));
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_ADMIN_FACTS);
    const after = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    expect(await after.getByText(COMPOSER.neverWrite, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.no_violation, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(1);
    expect(await after.getByLabel(COMPOSER_OUTCOMES.not_evident, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(fixtures.state.imageRequests).toHaveLength(asked);
    expect(await page.locator("img").count()).toBe(0);
    // The steps that follow are a moderator's again: each opens its page anew, and reads who is signed in.
    fixtures.state.role = "moderator";
    await clean();
  });

  test("a case that another staff member decided meanwhile: a save that failed is worded under its field and made again by the confirmation, the refusal is worded in place, the case is read again with the draft kept, and confirmed again the decision is recorded without a text saved twice", async () => {

    // The page read the case again, once: the other decision is on it, and the composer follows the case as it now stands.

    // The refusal's words stay, the reason's own refusal is gone now that it is saved, and the draft is as its person left it.

    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);

    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold_media.label, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(requests("GET", "")).toHaveLength(read + 1);

    // Confirmed again, on the version the page now shows: the texts are used as they were saved.

    expect(requests("POST", "/texts")).toEqual([201, 429, 201]);
    expect(requests("POST", "/decisions")).toEqual([409, 201]);
    const mine = fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_CHANGED);

    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_CHANGED_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a draft's texts come back after a reload: each was saved when its field lost focus, a refused save is worded under its field with the text kept, a saved text is restored with its digest, one answered with other words under its digest is dropped, and the decision names the text saved before the reload", async () => {
    const [before, options] = [await signatures(), fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed];
    const QUOTING = 'The reporter wrote "this account spams one link everywhere".';
    const REASON = "The post repeats one link, which the rule names.";
    const saves = () => fixtures.state.requests.filter((r) => r.method === "POST" && r.path === `/api/staff/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}/texts`).map((r) => r.status);
    const mine = () => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_DRAFTS);
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 1, "the facts saved when their field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[0]).toMatchObject({ kind: "facts", text: TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS });
    // A text that quotes what someone wrote about the case is refused where it was written, and nothing of it is lost.
    fixtures.state.refuseNextSave = "text_quotes_user";
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(QUOTING);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await shown(composer.getByRole("alert").filter({ hasText: messageFor("text_quotes_user") }));
    expect(await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe(QUOTING);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422]);
    expect(mine()).toHaveLength(1);
    // Written again in the person's own words, the refusal's words go, and the text is saved when its field loses focus.
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await composer.getByRole("alert").waitFor({ state: "detached" });
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => mine().length === 2, "the reason saved when its field lost focus");
    expect(mine()[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: "reason", text: REASON });
    // No key was asked for any of it.
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before);
    expect(fixtures.state.stepUpOptionsServed).toBe(options);
    await clean();

    // A reload before any confirmation: the case's answer brings the saved texts back. This one answers the reason with
    // other words under the digest of what was saved: the page holds each text to its digest, and drops that one.
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = { caseId: CASE_DRAFTS, kind: "reason" };
    await page.goto(`${origin}/cases/${CASE_DRAFTS}`);
    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    const again = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });
    await shown(again);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Facts").inputValue()).toBe(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    expect(await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).inputValue()).toBe("");
    expect(await page.content()).not.toContain(FORGED_DRAFT);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201]);
    await clean();

    // A measure and a reason later the key confirms the decision. The click that confirms takes the focus from the
    // reason's field: that save ends first, the confirmation saves nothing, and the facts are the ones saved before the reload.
    await again.getByLabel(MEASURES.withhold.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await again.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill(REASON);
    await again.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" }).click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    expect(saves()).toEqual([201, 422, 201, 201]);
    expect(mine().map((text) => text.kind)).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "reason"]);
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_DRAFTS,
      params: { kind: "interim", stateVersion: 1, throughSeq: 0, outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null }], factsDigest: mine()[0]!.digest, reasonDigest: mine()[2]!.digest, legalReferenceDigest: null },
    });
    fixtures.state.forgedDraft = null;
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_DRAFT_FACTS);
    await clean();
  });

    await shown(page.getByRole("heading", { name: "Case about a post" }));
    await shown(page.getByText("not answered yet", { exact: false }));
    // What the appellant wrote is text in a frame of its own.
    expect(await texts()).toContain(HOSTILE.img);
    const before = await signatures();
    const decisionsBefore = fixtures.state.decisions.length;
    await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).click();
    const review = page.getByRole("region", { name: COMPOSER.reviewLabel });
    await shown(review);
    const confirm = review.getByRole("button", { name: "Confirm with your staff key" });
    // "Keep" is chosen and lifts nothing; nothing is confirmed without a reason.
    expect(await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.kept, { exact: true }).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel("Reason of the review").fill(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // A decision with one measure cannot be reversed in part: whatever is ticked, the answer does not stand.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.partly_reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).check();
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(true);
    // "Reverse" lifts everything that is still in force, and says so by its ticked box.
    await review.getByLabel(REVIEW_OUTCOMES.reversed, { exact: true }).check();
    expect(await review.getByLabel(MEASURES.restore.label).isChecked()).toBe(true);
    expect(await confirm.isDisabled()).toBe(false);
    // The preview is the statement its author will receive: the review's lead, and what was typed as its reason.
    const preview = review.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    expect(await preview.first().textContent()).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.reviewed("2026-10-01 09:00 UTC", "reversed"));
    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(`Why korbat changed it: ${TYPED_REVIEW_REASON}`);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.reviewed));
    expect(await signatures()).toBe(before + 1);
    const reason = fixtures.state.texts.at(-1)!;
    expect(reason).toMatchObject({ caseId: CASE_APPEALED, kind: "review_reason", text: TYPED_REVIEW_REASON });
    // What the key confirmed is the review the page showed: of that decision, answering that appeal, with that reversal
    // and the digest of the saved reason. No decision on the case was sent in its place.
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fixtures.state.reviews[0]).toMatchObject({
      decisionId: DECISION_APPEALED,
      params: { stateVersion: 3, appealId: APPEAL_ONE, outcome: "reversed", rulesVersion: 2, actions: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], reasonDigest: reason.digest },
    });
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions).toHaveLength(decisionsBefore);
    // The case as the answer gave it: the next version, the removal lifted, the appeal answered, and nothing left to review.
    await shown(page.getByText("version 4", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText("answered: reversed", { exact: false }));
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.remove.label}: lifted by the decision of`, { exact: false }));
    expect(await page.getByRole("button", { name: APPEAL_WORDS.reviewLabel }).count()).toBe(0);
    expect(await texts()).toContain(TYPED_REVIEW_REASON);
    // The appeals screen no longer lists it.
    await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Appeals" }).click();
    await shown(page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").first());
    expect(await page.locator("table.queue tbody tr").count()).toBe(1);
    await clean();
  });

  test("a post decision signs the strike the case answer says is due: the author's standing in bands above the evidence, the strike line under Restrict, the preview's strike, and the key confirming the removal with its strike", async () => {
    const before = await signatures();

    const composer = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Decide" });

    await shown(composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.none.interim, { exact: true }));

    await shown(composer.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.strike.due, { exact: true }));

    expect(await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.strike.label, { exact: true }).count()).toBe(0);
    await composer.getByLabel(MEASURES.remove.label, { exact: true }).check();
    await composer.getByLabel("Facts").fill(STRIKE_FACTS);
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).fill("It sells followers, which the rule names.");
    await composer.getByLabel("Reason", { exact: true }).press("Tab");
    await arrived(() => fixtures.state.texts.filter((text) => text.caseId === CASE_STRIKE).length === 2, "both texts saved when their fields lost focus");
    // The preview tells the strike as its author will read it: the third active strike, the band's two and this one.
    const preview = composer.locator(".frame.preview p.frame-text");
    const told = (await preview.allTextContents()).join(" ");
    expect(told).toContain("This decision gives your account a strike.");

    expect(await preview.allTextContents()).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationStrike);
    expect(await inspect(page)).toEqual([]);
    await confirm.click();
    await shown(page.getByText(COMPOSER.recorded));

    // What the key confirmed: the removal and the strike, which the page added because the answer said it was due.
    expect(fixtures.state.decisions.at(-1)).toMatchObject({
      caseId: CASE_STRIKE,
      params: { kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", actions: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null }], unfounded: [], replaced: false },
    });
    // The case as the answer gave it: the strike in force with the day it stops counting, and the band one higher.
    await shown(page.getByText(`${MEASURES.strike.label}: in force; counts until`, { exact: false }));
    await shown(standing.getByText(STANDING_WORDS.bands.activeStrikes["3_or_more"], { exact: true }));
    await texts();
    await clean();
  });

/** The authenticator data inside a CBOR attestation object: the byte string under the text key "authData". */
function authDataOf(attestationObject: Buffer): Buffer | null {
  // A CBOR text string of 8 bytes (0x68) spelling authData, then the byte string (major type 2) it maps to.
  const key = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x68]), Buffer.from("authData")]);
  const at = attestationObject.indexOf(key);
  if (at === -1) return null;
  let i = at + key.length;
  const head = attestationObject[i];
  if (head === undefined || head >> 5 !== 2) return null;
  let length = head & 0x1f;
  i += 1;
  // The length is in the head itself, or in the 1, 2 or 4 bytes after it.
  if (length === 24) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt8(i);
    i += 1;
  } else if (length === 25) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt16BE(i);
    i += 2;
  } else if (length === 26) {
    length = attestationObject.readUInt32BE(i);
    i += 4;
  } else if (length > 23) {
    return null;
  }
  return attestationObject.subarray(i, i + length);
}

  if (flags === null) return "staff_key_refused";
  if ((flags & FLAG_UV) === 0) return "staff_key_not_user_verified";
  if ((flags & (FLAG_BE | FLAG_BS)) !== 0) return "staff_key_not_device_bound";

}
