```ts
        await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
        // What is left of these notices names nothing live: their items have no case. 3e Task 5: a signed-in report under a
        // rule among them was counted in its sender's tally of the day, which goes with it.
        await untally(tx, sql`array(select id from intakes where ref = any(${`{${refs.join(",")}}`}::text[]))`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from intake_items where intake_id in (select id from intakes where ref = any(${`{${refs.join(",")}}`}::text[]))`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from intakes where ref = any(${`{${refs.join(",")}}`}::text[])`);
      });
      refs.length = 0;
    }
    if (contacts.length > 0) await authDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_contacts where id = any(${uuids(contacts.map((row) => row.contact_id))})`);
    if (addresses.length > 0) {
      const hashes = `{${addresses.splice(0).map((email) => emailHash(auth.deps.config.authHmacKey, email)).join(",")}}`;
      await authDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_confirmations where email_hash = any(${hashes}::text[])`);
      await authDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.notifier_suppressions where email_hash = any(${hashes}::text[])`);
    }
  }

  return {
    config,
    apiDb,
    authDb,
    migrateDb,
    repo,
    mailer,
    ahead,
    auth,
    authForModeration,
    moderation,
    deps: moderation.deps,
    app,
    profileIds,
    account,
    address,
    sender,
    notice,
    items,
    remember,
    counts,
    cleanUp,
    close: () => Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]),
  };
}

export type NoticesWorld = ReturnType<typeof noticesWorld>;

/** The three grounds as a signed-out sender words them, each about the targets given. */
export const notices = {
  rule: (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", targets, turnstileToken: HUMAN, ...extra }) as NoticeRequest,
  illegal: (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
    ({ ground: "illegal", targets, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH", explanation: "It is a threat under section 241.", bonaFide: true, turnstileToken: HUMAN, ...extra }) as NoticeRequest,
  csam: (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({ ground: "csam", targets, keyword: "csam", turnstileToken: HUMAN, ...extra }) as NoticeRequest,
};

export const postTarget = (id: string, mediaId?: string) => ({ kind: "post" as const, id, ...(mediaId === undefined ? {} : { mediaId }) });
export const accountTarget = (handle: string) => ({ kind: "account" as const, handle });
export const linkTarget = (url: string) => ({ kind: "link" as const, url });
```

```ts
import { createHash, randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE, ACTION_KINDS, OUTCOME_PHRASES, itemOutcomeWords } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { STATEMENT_WORDS, statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { closeDb, createDb } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { ROUTE_KINDS } from "../../src/moderation/decide";
import { updateLine } from "../../src/moderation/dispatch";
import { itemStatus } from "../../src/moderation/intake";
import { dueRedactions, insertAction, insertDecision, lateErasures, noticeItems, pendingOutcomeLines } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { decisionStatement } from "../../src/moderation/statement";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { changeHandle } from "../../src/social/flows/profile-edit";
import { closeDecisions, deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, actionsOf, anAccount, appealOf, decisionParams, ground, intake, refusal, removeFixtures, rowCounts, type DecisionInput } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rejection, socialHarness, type SocialHarness } from "./social-harness";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

// Every test commits decisions confirmed with a real key, each a round of the step-up flow: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/** A handle nobody holds: lower-case, as the flows store a chosen one. */
const newHandle = () => `rh_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
/** The placeholder decision_actions_apply gives: the prefix and the first 12 hex digits of the sha256 of the measure's id as text. */
const placeholderOf = (actionId: string) => `retired_${createHash("sha256").update(actionId, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 12)}`;

/**
 * The retirement of a handle and its reversal through the routes (3e design, sections 6.2, 7.10 and 7.11; section 12.1,
 * invariant 15 and row 24 for a retirement). Each decision is confirmed as the console confirms one, with a staff key on
 * the software authenticator, and recorded by the moderation module's own decide and review, which the staff routes
 * run. The handle change and onboarding are the social module's flow and the profile store, on the API's pool, so a
 * refusal is the one a person meets; a write that skips them is made as korbat_api, which the trigger refuses. What the
 * file commits is removed in the end, and its last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the retirement of a handle and its reversal", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let s: SocialHarness;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let reviewer: RealStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  /** The profiles this file made, removed with everything they hold at the end. */
  const made: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    apiDb = createDb(loadConfig().DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    world = deciderWorld(apiDb);
    s = socialHarness(apiDb);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    reviewer = await world.staff("moderator");
    // Read once the staff profiles exist: the world removes them when it closes, after the last test.
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 240_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await closeDecisions();
      await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      await world.close();
    } finally {
      await closeDb(apiDb);
    }
  }, 240_000);

  const store = () => createProfileStore(apiDb);
  async function account() {
    const profile = await newProfile(apiDb);
    made.push(profile.id);
    return profile;
  }
  /** The account's case, opened by a signed-in report under R4 that names it by this handle: the case and the report. */
  async function reportedAccount(subjectId: string, named: string) {
    const reporter = await account();
    const recorded = await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R4"), anAccount(subjectId, named));
    return { caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, intakeId: recorded.intakeId };
  }
  /** A confirmed decision through the route's code: its id. */
  async function decided(member: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: DecisionInput): Promise<string> {
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(member, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  }
  /** A final retirement under R4 by the moderator, with what else the decision holds. */
  const retire = (caseId: string, also: DecisionInput["actions"] = [], more: Partial<DecisionInput> = {}) =>
    decided(moderator, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("retire_handle"), ...(also ?? [])], ...more });
  const profileRow = async (id: string) =>
    (await apiDb.execute<{ handle: string; display_name: string; handle_changed_at: string | null }>(sql`select handle, display_name, handle_changed_at::text from profiles where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]!;
  const historyRow = async (handle: string) =>
    (await apiDb.execute<{ profile_id: string; retired: boolean }>(sql`select profile_id, retired_at is not null as retired from handle_history where handle_lower = ${handle.toLowerCase()}`))[0] ?? null;
  const retirementRow = async (decisionId: string) => (await actionsOf(apiDb, decisionId)).find((a) => a.kind === "retire_handle")!;

  test("the routes take the retirement and its reversal, and since Task 5 every kind of the ledger (7.1 item 2)", () => {
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("retire_handle")).toBe(true);
    expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has("unretire_handle")).toBe(true);
    // Task 3 opened a suspension at once and its lift, Task 4 a termination, Task 5 the reporting kinds: the list holds
    // every kind of the ledger now.
    for (const kind of ["suspend", "lift_suspension", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting", "lift_reporting"] as const) expect(ROUTE_KINDS.has(kind), kind).toBe(true);
    expect([...ACTION_KINDS].filter((kind) => !ROUTE_KINDS.has(kind))).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("invariant 15: a retirement swaps the handle for the placeholder made from the measure's id and clears the change time; the handle is refused to everyone, its former holder included, and the new handle is chosen at once", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    // The account changed its handle once, so the ordinary wait would apply, and the handle it holds now has no row in
    // handle_history yet: the retirement writes it first.
    const judged = newHandle();
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: judged })).handle).toBe(judged);
    expect(await historyRow(judged)).toBeNull();
    const { caseId, intakeId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, judged);
    // A signed-in notice of illegal content about the same account joins the case: its sender is mailed the outcome.
    const noticer = await account();
    const notice = await intake(apiDb, ground.illegal(noticer.id), anAccount(subject.id, judged));
    expect(notice.items[0]!.caseId).toBe(caseId);
    const caseRead = () => world.moderation.forStaff.caseView(admin.session, caseId);
    expect((await caseRead()).standing).toMatchObject({ snapshotHandleRetired: false });
    const decisionId = await retire(caseId);
    const row = await retirementRow(decisionId);
    // The case answer names the handle on the retirement's row, and says that a retirement now would change nothing.
    const after = await caseRead();
    expect(after.decisions.find((d) => d.id === decisionId)!.actions).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ kind: "retire_handle", handle: judged, inForce: true, noEffect: null })]);
    expect(after.standing).toMatchObject({ snapshotHandleRetired: true });
    expect(row.no_effect).toBeNull();
    const placeholder = placeholderOf(row.id);
    expect(placeholder).toHaveLength(20);
    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: placeholder, handle_changed_at: null });
    expect(await historyRow(judged)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: true });
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: false });

    // Refused to everyone, its former holder included, by the flows' own check: handle_retired, 409.
    const stranger = await account();
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: judged }))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: judged.toUpperCase() }))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged, displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: judged.toUpperCase(), displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    // The placeholder's prefix is reserved in the handle rule: handle_reserved, 400.
    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: placeholder }))).toBe("handle_reserved");
    // The repository and the store answer the trigger's codes where a caller skipped the handle rule.
    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(stranger.id, "retired_0123456789ab", new Date())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_reserved" });
    expect(await s.repo.changeHandle(subject.id, judged, new Date())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_retired" });
    expect(await store().create({ id: randomUUID(), handle: "retired_0123456789ab", displayName: "Late" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "handle_reserved" });
    // A direct write as korbat_api meets the trigger, for every role but the migrator.
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${judged} where id = ${stranger.id}::uuid`))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = 'retired_0123456789ab' where id = ${stranger.id}::uuid`))).toBe("handle_reserved");
    expect(await refusal(apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${randomUUID()}::uuid, ${judged.toUpperCase()}, 'Late')`))).toBe("handle_retired");
    expect((await profileRow(stranger.id)).handle).toBe(stranger.handle);

    // The statement names the handle and the placeholder, and the end that fits the decision's own measures.
    const found = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, decisionId))!;
    expect(found.statement.measures).toEqual([{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, handle: judged, placeholder }]);
    const paragraphs = statementParagraphs(found.statement);
    expect(paragraphs[0]).toBe(STATEMENT_WORDS.retire(judged, placeholder, "at_once"));
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);

    // The reporter reads 3c's restricted outcome with the retired phrase in place of the display name's.
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
    const [item] = await noticeItems(apiDb, intakeId);
    const status = await itemStatus(world.moderation.deps, item!);
    expect(status.scope).toBe("account_retired");
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(status)!.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired}`)).toBe(true);
    expect(itemOutcomeWords(status)!.startsWith("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R4")).toBe(true);
    // The notice's sender is mailed the same line by the dispatch job.
    const mailed = (await pendingOutcomeLines(apiDb)).find((line) => line.intakeId === notice.intakeId)!;
    expect(mailed).toMatchObject({ targetType: "account", retired: true });
    expect(updateLine(world.moderation.deps, mailed).outcome).toBe(itemOutcomeWords(status));

    // A new handle at once: the swap cleared the change time, so the change made minutes ago sets no wait.
    const next = newHandle();
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: next })).handle).toBe(next);
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle_changed_at).not.toBeNull();
  });

  test("the retirement is stored first beside a reset of the display name, which then copies the placeholder; a retirement that is not its decision's first row is refused", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const { caseId } = await reportedAccount(subject.id, subject.handle);
    // The signed list is in its one order, the reset first; the decide route inserts the retirement before it.

    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: placeholder, display_name: placeholder });
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, decisionId)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([
      ["reset_display_name", null],
      ["retire_handle", null],

    await rolledBack(apiDb, async (tx) => {
      const other = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
      const recorded = await intake(tx, ground.finding(moderator.id, "R4"), anAccount(other.id, other.handle));
      const params = await decisionParams(tx, moderator, recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("reset_display_name"), act("retire_handle")] });
      const rows = (order: ("reset_display_name" | "retire_handle")[]) =>
        refusal(
          tx.transaction(async (sp) => {
            const id = randomUUID();
            await insertDecision(sp, { id, caseId: recorded.items[0]!.caseId!, decidedBy: moderator.id, params });
            for (const kind of order) await insertAction(sp, id, { kind, mediaId: null });

        );
      expect(await rows(["reset_display_name", "retire_handle"])).toBe("invalid_decision");
      expect(await rows(["retire_handle", "reset_display_name"])).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("the reversal, while the profile holds the placeholder: a review of the appeal gives the handle back, clears the retirement and the change time", async () => {
    const subject = await account();

    expect(found.statement.reversals).toEqual([{ kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, handle: subject.handle }]);

  });

  test("the reversal, once the holder moved on: a correction keeps the new handle, clears the change time, and the old handle can be taken back at once", async () => {
    const subject = await account();

    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle_changed_at).not.toBeNull();

    expect(await profileRow(subject.id)).toMatchObject({ handle: moved, handle_changed_at: null });
    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: false });

    // Another account still cannot take it; its former holder takes it back at once, without the wait.

    expect(await rejection(changeHandle(s.deps, stranger.id, { handle: subject.handle }))).toBe("handle_taken");
    expect((await changeHandle(s.deps, subject.id, { handle: subject.handle })).handle).toBe(subject.handle);

  });

  test("no_effect: already when the snapshot's handle is retired, deleted for a deleted account; neither touches the profile", async () => {
    // Two reports in one open case, the second arriving before anything changed: one snapshot. The first retirement answers
    // only the first report, so the case stays open, and the second answers the other with the same snapshot.
    const subject = await account();

    const placeholder = placeholderOf((await retirementRow(retiring)).id);
    const again = await retire(first.caseId);
    expect((await retirementRow(again)).no_effect).toBe("already");
    expect((await profileRow(subject.id)).handle).toBe(placeholder);
    const already = (await decisionStatement(apiDb, again))!.statement;
    expect(already.measures[0]).toMatchObject({ handle: subject.handle, noEffect: "already", placeholder: null });
    expect(statementParagraphs(already)[0]).toBe(`${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireLead(subject.handle)} ${STATEMENT_WORDS.retireAlready}`);

    const gone = await account();
    const goneCase = await reportedAccount(gone.id, gone.handle);
    await apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone.id}::uuid`);
    const onDeleted = await retire(goneCase.caseId);

    expect((await profileRow(gone.id)).handle).toBe(gone.handle);
    expect(await historyRow(gone.handle)).toBeNull();

  test("row 24: a retirement that cites R4 is final for months and never meets the R4 redaction: no candidate, no erasure, never counted as late", async () => {
    // The built text of the retention job and of the overview: REDACTABLE names exactly 3c's four kinds.

    expect(redactable).toContain("m.kind in ('remove', 'remove_media', 'reset_bio', 'reset_display_name')");

      // Final for its author long ago, as only the migrator can make it here.

    expect(await historyRow(subject.handle)).toEqual({ profile_id: subject.id, retired: true });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
```

```ts
    expect(paragraphs[1]).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[2].strikeNext);
    expect(paragraphs).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automationStrike);
    expect((await exportFor(deps(), author.id)).strikes).toEqual([{ decisionId: removal, postId: post.postId, ruleId: "R1", givenAt: expect.any(String), countsUntil, overruledAt: null }]);

    // Reversed whole by a correction, with the overruling the console adds: the strike no longer counts, and says when.
    const correction = await decided(admin, post.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore")] });
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, correction)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["overrule", "restore"]);
    const overruled = (await authorDecisionView(deps(), author.id, removal)).strike!;
    expect(overruled).toEqual({ countsUntil, state: "overruled", overruledAt: expect.any(String) });
    expect((await authorCases(deps(), author.id)).activeStrikes).toBe(0);
    expect((await exportFor(deps(), author.id)).strikes[0]!.overruledAt).toBe(overruled.overruledAt);
    expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(apiDb, correction))!.statement)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.overruled);
    // The post is visible again: no chip.
    expect((await authorFacts(deps(), author.id, [post.postId])).get(post.postId)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  test("a review that reverses the removal overrules its strike; one that would leave the strike is refused", async () => {
    const author = await account();
    const post = await reportedPost(author.id);
    const removal = await decided(admin, post.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await appealOf(apiDb, removal, author.id);
    expect(await refusedWith(world.reviewAs(reviewer, removal, { actions: [act("restore")], overrule: false }))).toBe("invalid_decision");
    const outcome = await world.reviewAs(reviewer, removal, { actions: [act("restore")] });
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, outcome.decisionId)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["overrule", "restore"]);
    expect((await authorDecisionView(deps(), author.id, removal)).strike!.state).toBe("overruled");
  });

  test("a reporter's line is the same with and without a strike, also when the post was already deleted (invariant 20, T43)", async () => {
    // X has no strike, so the removal of X's post gives one; Y was told of a strike after writing the post, so its removal gives none.
    const [x, y] = [await account(), await account()];
    const xPost = await reportedPost(x.id);
    const yPost = await reportedPost(y.id, false);
    await decided(admin, (await reportedPost(y.id)).caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const xRemoval = await decided(admin, xPost.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const yRemoval = await decided(admin, yPost.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    // X's next post is made after X was told of that strike, so its removal gives another; Y's again before.
    const xDeleted = await reportedPost(x.id);
    const yDeleted = await reportedPost(y.id, false);
    for (const deleted of [xDeleted, yDeleted]) await apiDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${deleted.postId}::uuid`);
    const xGone = await decided(admin, xDeleted.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const yGone = await decided(admin, yDeleted.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, xRemoval)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["remove", "strike"]);
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, yRemoval)).map((a) => a.kind)).toEqual(["remove"]);
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, xGone)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([
      ["remove", "deleted"],
      ["strike", null],
    ]);
    expect((await actionsOf(apiDb, yGone)).map((a) => [a.kind, a.no_effect])).toEqual([["remove", "deleted"]]);
    // The daily release shows each sender the outcome; the line's facts are compared without the ids and the times.
    await apiDb.execute(sql`select public.release_outcomes(now())`);
    const line = async (intakeId: string) => (await noticeItems(apiDb, intakeId)).map(({ id: _id, targetId: _t, decidedOn: _d, until: _u, ...rest }) => rest);
    expect(await line(xPost.intakeId)).toEqual(await line(yPost.intakeId));
    expect(await line(xDeleted.intakeId)).toEqual(await line(yDeleted.intakeId));
    // The removal of a deleted post changed nothing anyone saw, and the line says so with the strike as without it.
    expect((await line(xDeleted.intakeId))[0]).toMatchObject({ shownOutcome: "restricted_rule", noEffect: true });
  });

  test("an account case's answer carries the account's standing: its strikes, the rung, and the report that holds the ladder back", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const strikes = await strikeForTest(apiDb, subject.id, 3, "R3");
    const reporter = await account();
    const caseId = (await intake(apiDb, ground.rule(reporter.id, "R3"), anAccount(subject.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    const view = await caseRead(caseId);
    expect(view.strikeDue).toBeNull();
    expect(view.authorStanding).toBeNull();
    expect(view.standing).toMatchObject({
      activeStrikes: 3,
      ladderRule: "R3",
      suspensionsInYear: 0,
      lastSuspendedOn: null,
      maxDays: 3,
      mayTerminate: false,
      live: false,
      openReports: true,
      atOnce: [],
      seal: null,
    });
    expect(view.standing!.strikes.map((s) => s.decisionId)).toEqual(strikes);
    expect(view.standing!.flood.posts).toBe(3);
  });

  test("a strike's row in its post case names the standing measures that rest on its decision, so that a review says so before the key is asked", async () => {
    const subject = await account();
    const strikes = await strikeForTest(apiDb, subject.id, 3, "R1");
    const caseOf = async (decisionId: string) =>
      (await apiDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select case_id as id from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`))[0]!.id;
    const strikeRow = async (decisionId: string) =>
      (await caseRead(await caseOf(decisionId))).decisions.find((d) => d.id === decisionId)!.actions.find((a) => a.kind === "strike")!;
    expect((await strikeRow(strikes[0]!)).restedOnBy).toEqual([]);
    // A suspension announced on the ladder rests on the three strikes (the routes take it from Task 4 on; here the module's own decide).
    const accountCase = (await intake(apiDb, ground.finding(admin.id, "R1"), anAccount(subject.id))).items[0]!.caseId!;
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, accountCase, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [timed("suspend", 3, true)] }, { allKinds: true });
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the suspension was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    for (const strike of strikes) expect((await strikeRow(strike)).restedOnBy).toEqual(["suspend"]);
    // Every other row carries null.
    const removal = (await caseRead(await caseOf(strikes[0]!))).decisions.find((d) => d.id === strikes[0])!.actions.find((a) => a.kind === "remove")!;
    expect(removal.restedOnBy).toBeNull();
  });

  test("this file left no row behind", async () => {
    await closeDecisions();
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
  }, 120_000);
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, REPLY_AIM_HOURS, STANDING_RULES, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, outcomeWords } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { noticeTime } from "../../src/auth/flows/notify";
import type { MailMessage, NoticeUpdateData, NoticeUpdateLine, TemplateName } from "../../src/mail/mailer";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { DECISION_MAIL_SUBJECTS, renderMail, renderNoticeUpdate, renderTemplate } from "../../src/mail/templates";

/**
 * The mails of deciding and of the dispatch (3c design, section 7.15): the author's statement, the staff alerts for a
 * burst of decisions, for a decision that lifted the protection of reported images and for cases that wait too long, and
 * the one structured mail, the daily update of decisions on a person's reports. Each is pinned word for word.
 */
const LAST_USER = "korbat staff never ask for your password or a code, and korbat does not read replies to this email.";
const LAST_STAFF = "korbat never puts a link in a staff email.";
const paragraphs = (text: string) => text.trimEnd().split("\n\n");
const TIME = "2026-10-04 06:59 UTC";

/** No link of any kind, and the staff mails' last sentence. */
function linkless(r: { text: string; html: string }) {
  expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|:[/][/]/);
  expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=|https?:/);
  expect(paragraphs(r.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_STAFF);
}

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import type { DecisionStatement } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { mailTemplateOf } from "../src/moderation/statement";

/**
 * Which template a decision's statement is mailed under (3e design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6): the first row of 7.15's
 * table that fits, in its order, and moderation_decision otherwise. The statement's data alone decides, so a test builds
 * the data and reads the template.
 */
const DECIDED = "2026-10-04T09:30:15.250Z";
const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11T09:30:15.250Z";
const PARAGRAPHS = ["one", "two"];

function statement(more: Partial<DecisionStatement> = {}): DecisionStatement {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 3,
    redressVersion: 2,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: null,
    reason: null,
    source: "own_initiative",
    decidedAt: DECIDED,
    post: null,
    measures: [],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}
const standing = (kind: "suspend" | "terminate", announced: boolean): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: null,
  announced,
  days: kind === "suspend" ? 3 : null,
  basis: announced ? (kind === "suspend" ? "strikes" : "ladder_end") : "threat",
  earliestStart: announced ? EARLIEST : DECIDED,
  endsAt: announced || kind === "terminate" ? null : EARLIEST,
  restsOn: [],
});
const reviewed = { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R1" as const, rulesVersion: 3, legalReference: null, decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z" };
const lift = (more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind: "lift_suspension",
  mediaId: null,
  resetDecisionId: null,
  oldValueKept: false,
  resetRuleId: null,
  liftedKind: "suspend",
  liftedDecidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z",
  periodThen: { state: "not_started", startedAt: null, endedAt: null },
  replaced: false,
  replyFiledAt: null,
  ...more,
});
const answer = (kind: "correction" | "review", outcome: "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed", more: Partial<DecisionStatement> = {}) =>
  statement({
    kind,
    outcome,
    ground: null,
    ruleId: null,
    reviewed,
    repliedTo: { filedAt: DECIDED, onTime: true, kind: "suspend", days: 3, periodThen: { state: "not_started", startedAt: null, endedAt: null }, startsAt: EARLIEST, endsAt: EARLIEST, appealUntil: EARLIEST },
    ...more,
  });

describe("mailTemplateOf, row by row in the order of 7.15", () => {
  test("1: an announced suspension or termination is suspension_announced, with its days, the window in hours and the earliest start", () => {
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ measures: [standing("suspend", true)] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toEqual({
      template: "suspension_announced",
      measure: "suspend",
      days: 3,
      window: 168,
      earliestStart: EARLIEST,
      paragraphs: PARAGRAPHS,
    });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ measures: [standing("terminate", true)] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "suspension_announced", measure: "terminate", days: null });
  });

  test("2: a suspension or termination taken at once is suspension_started_at_once", () => {
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ measures: [standing("suspend", false)] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure: "suspend", days: 3, endsAt: EARLIEST });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ measures: [standing("terminate", false)] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure: "terminate", days: null, endsAt: null });
  });

  test("3: a correction or review whose statement has repliedTo is reply_answered: kept when it leaves the measure in force, reversed when it lifts it", () => {
    expect(mailTemplateOf(answer("correction", "kept"), PARAGRAPHS)).toEqual({ template: "reply_answered", outcome: "kept", paragraphs: PARAGRAPHS });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(answer("review", "kept"), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "reply_answered", outcome: "kept" });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(answer("review", "partly_reversed"), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "reply_answered", outcome: "kept" });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(answer("correction", "reversed", { reversals: [lift()] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "reply_answered", outcome: "reversed" });
  });

  test("4: a lift with no repliedTo is suspension_lifted: a withdrawal signed replaced under its own lead, never as an answer to the reply; a lift by its period; a broken basis by its period", () => {
    const withdrawal = statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, reviewed, reversals: [lift({ replaced: true, replyFiledAt: DECIDED })] });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(withdrawal, PARAGRAPHS)).toEqual({ template: "suspension_lifted", measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-01T09:00:00.000Z", replied: true, paragraphs: PARAGRAPHS });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ ...withdrawal, reversals: [lift({ replaced: true })] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ why: "replaced", replied: false });
    for (const state of ["not_started", "running", "ended"] as const) {
      const lifted = statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, reviewed, reversals: [lift({ periodThen: { state, startedAt: null, endedAt: null } })] });
      expect(mailTemplateOf(lifted, PARAGRAPHS), state).toMatchObject({ template: "suspension_lifted", why: "lifted", period: state });
    }
    const broken = statement({
      kind: "correction",
      outcome: "reversed",
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      reviewed,
      endedStanding: [{ kind: "terminate", decidedAt: DECIDED, periodThen: { state: "running", startedAt: DECIDED, endedAt: null }, seal: false, replyFiledAt: null }],
    });
    expect(mailTemplateOf(broken, PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({ template: "suspension_lifted", measure: "terminate", why: "basis", period: "running" });
  });

  test("5: a final warning about reporting is reporting_warned", () => {
    const warning = { kind: "warn_reporting" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, basis: "reports" as const, endsAt: EARLIEST };
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ ruleId: "R6", measures: [warning] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toEqual({ template: "reporting_warned", paragraphs: PARAGRAPHS });
  });

  test("6: a final restriction of reporting is reporting_restricted, with its days and its end; one without them is no mail", () => {

      subject: "reversed",

  test("otherwise moderation_decision: a strike, a retirement and every decision of 3c", () => {
    expect(mailTemplateOf(statement({ measures: [{ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, handle: "ada", placeholder: "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f" }] }), PARAGRAPHS)).toMatchObject({
      template: "moderation_decision",
      subject: "profile_restricted",

  });
});
```
