```tsx
/**
 * The notice status page, the cases screens and the decision screen, the chips and the labels in the web app (3c design,
 * section 9). An outcome's words come from the contracts and a statement's from the rulebook's package, so the tests hold
 * the screens to those functions and pin only the screens' own words. The components are server-rendered with made-up
 * answers in each state; what a static render cannot show (a request, where a token travels) is read from the source.
 */
const SRC = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "src");
const read = (...parts: string[]): string => readFileSync(path.join(SRC, ...parts), "utf8");

const route = vi.hoisted(() => ({ params: {} as Record<string, string> }));
const session = vi.hoisted(() => ({ state: { status: "signed-out" } as unknown }));

vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  Redirect: () => null,
  router: { push: () => undefined, replace: () => undefined },
  useLocalSearchParams: () => route.params,
  usePathname: () => "/settings/cases",
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ state: session.state, refresh: async () => session.state }) }));
vi.mock("expo-image", async () => {
  const { createElement } = await import("react");
  return { Image: ({ source, accessibilityLabel }: { source: { uri: string }; accessibilityLabel: string }) => createElement("img", { "data-uri": source.uri, alt: accessibilityLabel }) };
});
vi.mock("react-native-reanimated", () => ({ useReducedMotion: () => false }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const textOf = (markup: string): string =>
  markup
    .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ")
    .replace(/&#x27;/g, "'")
    .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
    .replace(/&amp;/g, "&")
    .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
    .trim();
const hrefs = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/<a\b[^>]*\bhref="([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]!.replace(/&amp;/g, "&"));
const loaded = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/data-uri="([^"]+)"/g)].map((match) => match[1]!);
/** The text of every button in the markup. */
const buttons = (markup: string): string[] => [...markup.matchAll(/<(?:div|button)\b[^>]*\brole="button"[^>]*>(.*?)<\/(?:div|button)>/g)].map((match) => textOf(match[1]!));
const count = (whole: string, part: string): number => whole.split(part).length - 1;

const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const APP = "http://localhost:8081";
const TIME = "2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z";

const waiting: NoticeItemStatus = { position: 1, link: `${APP}/post/${id(1)}`, scope: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, quotedBy: null, outcome: null, decidedOn: null, changed: false, reexamines: false, reexamination: null };
const item = (extra: Partial<NoticeItemStatus>): NoticeItemStatus => ({ ...waiting, decidedOn: "2026-10-05", ...extra });
const status = (items: NoticeItemStatus[], contact: NoticeStatus["contact"] = null): NoticeStatus => ({ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items, contact });
const page = (items: NoticeItemStatus[], contact?: NoticeStatus["contact"]) => html(<NoticeStatusView status={status(items, contact)} />);
const UNTIL = "2027-04-05T07:00:00.000Z";

describe("the words", () => {
  test("the status page's own sentences are the design's", () => {
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.added(2, `${APP}/post/${id(9)}`)).toBe(`The post that item 2 quotes (${APP}/post/${id(9)}), added by korbat`);
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel).toBe("Re-examination");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen("2027-04-05")).toBe("A moderator decides it again as a new report. You can ask once for each item, within six months of being told, until 2027-04-05.");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.final).toBe("This is final within korbat. You can also go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live.");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.courts).toBe("You can go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live.");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.confirm).toBe("Yes, I sent this: keep me informed");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.stop).toBe("I did not send this: stop korbat's report emails to this address");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.stopHint).toBe(
      "This also stops korbat's emails about reports you send yourself from this address, signed in or not, until you undo it on this page or, if a korbat account uses this address, under Settings, Cases, Your reports.",
    );
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.stopped).toBe("korbat's report emails to this address are stopped.");
    expect(STATUS_WORDS.undo).toBe("Undo: email this address about reports again");
  });

  test("the cases screens' and the decision screen's own sentences are the design's", () => {
    expect(CASES_WORDS.tabs).toEqual({ about: "About you", reports: "Your reports" });
    expect(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped).toBe("korbat does not email you about your reports, because someone using your email address asked it to stop. Their outcomes are listed here.");
    expect(CASES_WORDS.resume).toBe("Email me about my reports again");
    expect(CASES_WORDS.resumeHint).toBe("korbat may then also email this address about reports sent without an account that give it.");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-10-04 10:00 UTC")).toBe("Your post of 2026-10-04 10:00 UTC");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted).toBe("Content erased when the R4 decision became final");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2026-10-05")).toBe("korbat's copy of the content this decision was made on was erased on 2026-10-05 under its retention rules (Terms, Your data).");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.postKept).toBe("The post itself stays in your profile while you keep it.");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.deleted).toBe("You deleted this post. korbat keeps this copy for the case for the periods in its terms.");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages).toBe("Images kept for the case, not shown");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision).toBe("The decision that reset it");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.appeal).toBe("Appeal");
    expect(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06")).toBe("Reversed in full on 2026-10-06: nothing of this decision is in force, so there is nothing to appeal.");
    expect(SEALED_IMAGE).toBe("Sealed: not shown to anyone, you included");
    expect(HIDDEN_IMAGE).toBe("Image hidden by korbat moderation");
  });
});

describe("the notice status page", () => {
  test("shows the reference, when korbat received it, and each item with its link; an undecided item says so and nothing more", () => {
    const out = page([waiting, { ...waiting, position: 2, link: `${APP}/u/ada`, scope: "account" }]);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.received(utcMinute(TIME)));
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/post/${id(1)}`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/u/ada`);
    expect(count(text, STATUS_WORDS.waiting)).toBe(2);
    for (const words of [STATUS_WORDS.final, STATUS_WORDS.courts, STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel, "This answer concerns"]) expect(text).not.toContain(words);
    // Opened from the link shown on screen: no contact buttons.
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a decided item reads the words the mail reads: the contracts' one composition from the item's own facts", () => {
    const rule = { id: "R3" as const, title: getRule("R3")!.title };
    const items = [
      item({ outcome: "restricted_rule", rule }),
      item({ position: 2, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      item({ position: 3, outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }),
      item({ position: 4, link: `${APP}/u/ada`, scope: "account", outcome: "not_available" }),
    ];
    const text = textOf(page(items));
    for (const one of items) expect(text).toContain(itemOutcomeWords(one)!);
    expect(text).toContain(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.decided("2026-10-05"));
    // A link that named nothing reads no scope sentence, though the answer keeps the item's scope.
    expect(text).not.toContain("This answer concerns the account's display name and bio.");
  });

  test("a report on the anonymous path reads the phrases of that path, each of them, and after an account's outcome that the answer concerns the images on its posts", () => {
    const sealed = textOf(page([item({ suspect: true, sealed: true, outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: { id: "R2", title: getRule("R2")!.title } })]));
    expect(sealed).toContain(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(sealed).not.toContain("it breaks korbat rule");
    const dismissed = textOf(page([item({ suspect: true, outcome: "no_violation" })]));
    expect(dismissed).toContain(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(dismissed).not.toContain(OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation);
    const onText = textOf(page([item({ suspect: true, outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: { id: "R5", title: getRule("R5")!.title } })]));
    expect(onText).toContain(SUSPECT_NO_SEAL);
    const account = textOf(page([item({ link: `${APP}/u/ada`, suspect: true, scope: "account_suspect", outcome: "not_evident" })]));
    expect(account).toContain(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
    // A rule report about an account that the sealing decision answered too: the sealed phrase, then the same scope.
    const beside = textOf(page([item({ link: `${APP}/u/ada`, sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect", outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: { id: "R2", title: getRule("R2")!.title } })]));
    expect(beside).toContain(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("an answer given while nobody could open the post's images reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION with the re-examination still open beside it, also when it answers a re-examination, and is never called final", () => {
    const unseen = item({ outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true, reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } });
    for (const one of [unseen, { ...unseen, reexamines: true }]) {
      const text = textOf(page([one]));
      expect(text).toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
      expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
      expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
      expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.courts);
      expect(itemRedress(one)).toBe("reexamination");
    }
    // The re-examination's own answer is labelled as one.
    expect(textOf(page([{ ...unseen, reexamines: true }]))).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel);
  });

  test("beside an outcome: that it can still be examined again while that is open; that it is final within korbat when it was changed or answers a re-examination; the courts for any other", () => {
    const open = item({ outcome: "not_evident", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } });
    const asked = item({ outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: false, until: UNTIL } });
    const answer = item({ outcome: "no_violation", reexamines: true });
    const changed = item({ outcome: "reversed", changed: true });
    const restricted = item({ outcome: "restricted_legal" });
    expect([open, asked, answer, changed, restricted, waiting].map(itemRedress)).toEqual(["reexamination", "courts", "final", "final", "courts", "waiting"]);
    // A restriction answered while the images were out of sight is no "no action for now": changed, it is final.
    expect(itemRedress(item({ outcome: "restricted_rule", unseen: true, reexamines: true }))).toBe("final");

    const openText = textOf(page([open]));
    expect(openText).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
    expect(openText).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.courts);
    for (const one of [asked, restricted]) {
      const text = textOf(page([one]));
      expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.courts);
      expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
      expect(text).not.toContain("A moderator decides it again");
    }
    for (const one of [answer, changed]) {
      const text = textOf(page([one]));
      expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
      expect(count(text, "go to court")).toBe(1);
    }
    expect(textOf(page([answer]))).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel);
    expect(textOf(page([changed]))).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel);
  });

  test("an item korbat added for a quoted post is headed as such, after the item it was added for, with an outcome of its own", () => {
    const origin = item({ position: 2, suspect: true, outcome: "no_violation" });
    const added = item({ position: 12, link: `${APP}/post/${id(9)}`, suspect: true, sealed: true, quotedBy: 2, outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: { id: "R2", title: getRule("R2")!.title } });
    const text = textOf(page([origin, added]));
    const heading = STATUS_WORDS.added(2, `${APP}/post/${id(9)}`);
    expect(text).toContain(heading);
    expect(text.indexOf(heading)).toBeGreaterThan(text.indexOf(STATUS_WORDS.item(2)));
    expect(text).toContain(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.item(12));
  });

  test("opened from a mail's link, the page shows the contact's state with its two buttons and what a stop also stops; opened from the on-screen link, none", () => {
    const fromMail = page([waiting], { given: true, confirmed: false, stopped: false });
    expect(buttons(fromMail)).toEqual([STATUS_WORDS.confirm, STATUS_WORDS.stop]);
    expect(textOf(fromMail)).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.stopHint);
    expect(textOf(fromMail)).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.unconfirmed);
    expect(textOf(page([waiting], { given: true, confirmed: true, stopped: false }))).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.confirmed);
    for (const contact of [{ given: true, confirmed: null, stopped: null }, { given: false, confirmed: null, stopped: null }, null]) {
      const out = page([waiting], contact);
      expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
      expect(textOf(out)).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.stopHint);
    }
  });

  test("a stopped address reads that the emails are stopped, with the one button that undoes it", () => {
    const out = page([waiting], { given: true, confirmed: false, stopped: true });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.stopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([STATUS_WORDS.undo]);
    expect(textOf(out)).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.confirm);
    // The undo is the confirm choice, which lifts the stop; the other two send their own.
    const view = read("components", "moderation", "NoticeStatusView.tsx");
    expect(view).toContain('<Button label={STATUS_WORDS.undo} onPress={() => onContact?.("confirm")}');
    expect(view).toContain('<Button label={STATUS_WORDS.confirm} onPress={() => onContact?.("confirm")}');
    expect(view).toContain('<Button label={STATUS_WORDS.stop} onPress={() => onContact?.("stop")}');
  });

  test("a wrong reference or token is one sentence, whatever was wrong", () => {
    expect(textOf(html(<NoticeNotFound />))).toContain("We could not find a report with this link.");
  });

  test("the token is read from the address's fragment and sent in the body of a POST, never in a query", () => {
    const token = "A".repeat(20) + "b_-".repeat(7) + "zz";
    expect(fragmentToken(`#t=${token}`)).toBe(token);
    for (const hash of ["", "#", `#t=${token}x`, `#t=${token.slice(1)}`, `#x=${token}`, `?t=${token}`, `#t=${token}&u=1`]) expect(fragmentToken(hash), hash).toBeNull();
    const screen = read("app", "notice", "[ref].tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain("fragmentToken(location.hash)");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.status(ref, token)");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.contact(ref, token, choice)");
    expect(screen).not.toMatch(/useLocalSearchParams<[^>]*\btoken\b/);
    const client = read("lib", "moderation.ts");
    expect(client).toContain('status: (ref: string, token: string) => api("/api/notices/status", { json: { ref, token }, schema: NoticeStatus })');
    expect(client).toContain('contact: (ref: string, token: string, choice: "confirm" | "stop") => api("/api/notices/contact", { json: { ref, token, choice } })');
    // Before the fragment is read, and without one, the page says the link is no report's: it asks the API nothing.
    route.params = { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23" };
    expect(textOf(html(<NoticePage />))).not.toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    // The page is outside the settings, whose layout would send a signed-out reader to sign in.
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "notice"))).toEqual(["[ref].tsx"]);
  });
});

describe("Cases, under Settings", () => {
  test("the settings row has Cases, whose screens live in a folder of their own inside the settings layout", () => {
    const out = html(<SettingsNav current="cases" />);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(["/settings/security", "/settings/privacy", "/settings/profile", "/settings/account", "/settings/cases"]);
    const current = (out.match(/<a\b[^>]*>/g) ?? []).filter((tag) => tag.includes('aria-current="page"'));
    expect(current).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(current[0]).toContain('href="/settings/cases"');
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain("Cases");
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "settings", "cases")).sort()).toEqual(["[id]", "[id].tsx", "index.tsx"]);
    // 3e Task 4: the reply screen sits beside the decision's screen, at /settings/cases/<id>/reply.
    expect(readdirSync(path.join(SRC, "app", "settings", "cases", "[id]")).sort()).toEqual(["reply.tsx"]);
    for (const file of ["index.tsx", "[id].tsx"]) expect(read("app", "settings", "cases", file), file).toContain('<SettingsNav current="cases" />');
    // Two tabs, and the list each shows.
    const screen = read("app", "settings", "cases", "index.tsx");
    expect(screen).toContain('accessibilityRole="tablist"');
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.cases(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.reports(");
    expect(screen).toContain("moderation.resumeReportMail()");
  });

  const row = (extra: Partial<AuthorCaseRow> = {}): AuthorCaseRow => ({
    id: id(3),
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    decidedOn: "2026-10-05",
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: TIME },
    actions: ["remove"],
    endedInterim: false,
    ruleId: "R3",
    legal: false,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("About you lists each decision with its day, what was done, the post's time, the rule or the law and where its appeal stands, each a link to its screen", () => {
    const rows = [
      row(),
      row({ id: id(4), kind: "interim", actions: ["seal_media", "withhold"], ruleId: null, legal: true, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(5), post: null, actions: ["reset_bio"], ruleId: "R6", appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }),
      row({ id: id(6), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], endedInterim: true, ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
      row({ id: id(7), kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null }),
    ];
    const out = html(<DecisionsList decisions={rows} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toEqual(rows.map((one) => `/settings/cases/${one.id}`));
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.decidedOn("2026-10-05"))).toBe(5);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(TIME)));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.profile);
    // What was done, in the measures' own labels.
    for (const label of ["Remove", "Seal the images this case reaches", "Withhold the post", "Reset bio", "Lift the restriction of the post"]) expect(text, label).toContain(label);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.rule("R3"));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.law);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.ended);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.correction);
    expect(count(text, "You can appeal until")).toBe(1);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute("2027-04-05T10:00:00.000Z")));
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noDecisions);
  });

  test("the answer to an appeal that kept the decision reads as a kept decision, never as No action; a reversal by what it lifted", () => {
    const kept = row({ id: id(8), kind: "review", outcome: "kept", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const reversed = row({ id: id(9), kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", actions: ["restore"], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null });
    const text = textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[kept, reversed, row()]} />));
    expect(CASES_WORDS.keptDecision).toBe("korbat kept its decision");
    expect(count(text, CASES_WORDS.keptDecision)).toBe(1);
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
    expect(text).toContain(MEASURES.restore.label);
    // A final decision without a measure that ended nothing still reads No action.
    expect(textOf(html(<DecisionsList decisions={[row({ id: id(10), outcome: "no_violation", actions: [], ruleId: null, appealUntil: null })]} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noAction);
  });

  const reports = (extra: Partial<ReportsPage> = {}): ReportsPage => ({
    reports: [
      { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ link: `${APP}/u/old_handle`, scope: "account", outcome: "no_violation", reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(21), unfounded: false }, { ...waiting, position: 2, id: id(22), unfounded: false }] },
      { ref: "N-BCDEFGH234", receivedAt: TIME, items: [{ ...item({ outcome: "not_evident", unseen: true, reexamination: { open: true, until: UNTIL } }), id: id(23), unfounded: false }] },
    ],
    nextCursor: null,
    reportMailStopped: false,
    ...extra,
  });

  test("Your reports lists each report with its items as the status page words them: the account under the handle the report named, the outcome once released, and whether it can still be examined again", () => {
    const answer = reports();
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={answer} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("N-ABCDEFGH23");
    expect(text).toContain(`${APP}/u/old_handle`);
    expect(text).toContain(itemOutcomeWords(answer.reports[0]!.items[0]!)!);
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(UNTIL)));
    expect(text).toContain(STATUS_WORDS.waiting);
    expect(text).toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(text).not.toContain(STATUS_WORDS.final);
    // Without a stop there is no notice and no button.
    expect(text).not.toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(textOf(html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reports: [] })} />))).toContain(CASES_WORDS.noReports);
  });

  test("when the account's address stopped korbat's report mails, the tab says so above the list, with the button that resumes them and what that also allows", () => {
    const out = html(<ReportsList page={reports({ reportMailStopped: true })} />);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped);
    expect(buttons(out)).toEqual([CASES_WORDS.resume]);
    expect(text).toContain(CASES_WORDS.resumeHint);
    expect(text.indexOf(CASES_WORDS.mailStopped)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("N-ABCDEFGH23"));
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain('resumeReportMail: () => api("/api/moderation/report-mail/resume", { method: "POST" })');
  });
});

describe("a decision's screen", () => {
  const statement = {
    kind: "final" as const,
    outcome: "restricted" as const,
    ground: "incompatible" as const,
    ruleId: "R3" as const,
    rulesVersion: 2,
    redressVersion: 1,
    legalReference: null,
    facts: "The post attacks a group for its religion.",
    reason: "That is an attack on people, not on an idea.",
    source: "report" as const,
    decidedAt: TIME,
    post: { id: id(1), createdAt: "2026-09-01T08:30:00.000Z" },
    measures: [{ kind: "remove" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
  };
  const image = (n: number) => ({ id: id(n), alt: `picture ${n}`, width: 800, height: 600, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp` });
  const view = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}): DecisionView => ({
    id: id(3),
    ...statement,
    appealUntil: "2027-04-04T10:00:00.000Z",
    reversedOn: null,
    content: { kind: "post", body: "the words that were judged", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [image(7)], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: null },
    appeal: null,
    strike: null,
    standing: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const screen = (extra: Partial<DecisionView> = {}) => html(<DecisionDetail view={view(extra)} />);

  test("a final restriction: the statement as the mail rendered it, the post's time, the content it was made on, and Appeal with its deadline", () => {
    const out = screen();
    const text = textOf(out);
    for (const paragraph of statementParagraphs(view())) expect(text).toContain(paragraph);
    expect(text).toContain(`"${getRule("R3", 2)!.title}"`);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.automation);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
    expect(text).toContain("the words that were judged");
    // The image comes from the app's own image route, with its description.
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining(`/api/media/${id(7)}/small.webp`)]);
    expect(out).toContain('alt="picture 7"');
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appeal);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.appealUntil("2027-04-04 10:00 UTC"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a decision taken while korbat decides: the interim redress, and no Appeal", () => {
    const interim = { kind: "interim" as const, measures: [{ kind: "withhold" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }], appealUntil: null };
    const text = textOf(screen(interim));
    expect(text).toContain(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.scope.interim);
    // Neither the section nor its sentence: the interim redress never says the word.
    expect(text).not.toContain("Appeal");
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Reversed in full");
  });

  test("a restriction reversed in full says on which day, in place of Appeal", () => {
    const text = textOf(screen({ appealUntil: null, reversedOn: "2026-10-06" }));
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.reversed("2026-10-06"));
    expect(text).not.toContain("You can appeal this decision until");
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed keeps its text: each sealed image is drawn as its placeholder, and nothing is loaded for it", () => {
    const sealed = {
      kind: "interim" as const,
      ruleId: "R2" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } }],
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "post" as const, body: "text beside the images", deletedByAuthor: false, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "sealed" as const },
    };
    const out = screen(sealed);
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain("text beside the images");
    expect(count(text, SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    expect(text).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.sealPost("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC", 2));
  });

  test("a post its author deleted: korbat's copy of the text under its own heading, and its images kept and not shown", () => {
    const out = screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 2, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } });
    const text = textOf(out);
    expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deleted);
    expect(text.indexOf(DECISION_WORDS.deleted)).toBeLessThan(text.indexOf("deleted since"));
    expect(count(text, DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages)).toBe(1);
    expect(loaded(out)).toEqual([]);
    // A deleted post without images says nothing of images.
    expect(textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "post", body: "deleted since", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 0, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" } }))).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.deletedImages);
  });

  test("content korbat no longer holds: erased under the retention rules on its day, with the profile sentence only for a post its author kept; or erased by the R4 decision", () => {
    const kept = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: true } }));
    expect(kept).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06")} ${DECISION_WORDS.postKept}`);
    const gone = textOf(screen({ content: { kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: "2027-04-06", postKept: false } }));
    expect(gone).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.erased("2027-04-06"));
    expect(gone).not.toContain(DECISION_WORDS.postKept);
    const redacted = textOf(screen({ ruleId: "R4", content: { kind: "r4_redacted" } }));
    expect(redacted).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.r4Redacted);
    expect(redacted).not.toContain("was erased on");
    // The post's time stays on the screen whatever became of the content.
    for (const text of [kept, gone, redacted]) expect(text).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.post("2026-09-01 08:30 UTC"));
  });

  test("a decision about the account shows the fields as korbat copied them, and links the decision that reset a field while its value is still kept", () => {
    const reset = {
      post: null,
      ruleId: "R6" as const,
      measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio" as const, mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null }],
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const text = textOf(screen(reset));
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.bio} what the bio said`);
    expect(text).toContain(`${DECISION_WORDS.displayName} Ada`);
    expect(text).not.toContain("Your post of");
    // A later decision that lifts the reset: its statement says where the old value can be read, and the screen links there.
    const lifted = {
      kind: "correction" as const,
      outcome: "reversed" as const,
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      facts: null,
      post: null,
      measures: [],
      reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio" as const, mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: id(3), oldValueKept: true, resetRuleId: "R6" as const }],
      reviewed: { kind: "final" as const, ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R6" as const, rulesVersion: 2, legalReference: null, decidedAt: TIME },
      appealUntil: null,
      content: { kind: "account" as const, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "what the bio said" },
    };
    const out = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted });
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.oldValueKept);
    expect(textOf(out)).toContain(DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision);
    expect(hrefs(out)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    // Once the old value is gone, nothing links there.
    const erased = screen({ id: id(8), ...lifted, reversals: [{ ...lifted.reversals[0]!, oldValueKept: false }] });
    expect(hrefs(erased)).not.toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
  });

  test("the screen asks for the decision by the id in its address and says when there is none for this account", () => {
    const source = read("app", "settings", "cases", "[id].tsx");
    expect(source).toContain("moderation.decision(id)");
    expect(source).toContain("DECISION_WORDS.notFound");
    expect(read("lib", "moderation.ts")).toContain("decision: (id: string) => api(`/api/moderation/decisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { schema: DecisionView })");
  });
});

describe("the chips and the labels", () => {
  const post = (extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView => ({
    id: id(1),
    author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
    body: "my own post",
    createdAt: TIME,
    state: "removed",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    ...extra,
  });
  const me = (userId: string) => ({ status: "signed-in", me: { user: { id: userId, onboarded: true }, profile: { handle: "ada" } } });
  const image = (n: number, moderation?: MediaView["moderation"]): MediaView => ({ id: id(n), width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "LEHV6nWB2yk8", alt: `picture ${n}`, small: `/api/media/${id(n)}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${id(n)}/large.webp`, ...(moderation ? { moderation } : {}) });

  test("the chip's four texts: under review or removed, under a rule or as illegal content", () => {
    expect(CHIP_WORDS).toEqual({ underReview: "Under review", removed: "Removed", illegal: "illegal content" });
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R4" as const, legal: false, interim: true, strikeUntil: null };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe("Under review: R4");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true })).toBe("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: "R3", interim: false })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: false })).toBe("Removed: illegal content");
  });

  test("3e: a removed post's chip names its strike while the strike stands and counts, with the day it stops counting", () => {
    const until = "2027-01-10T09:00:00.000Z";
    const decision = { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3" as const, legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: until };
    expect(chipText(decision)).toBe(`Removed: R3, strike until ${standingDay(until)}`);
    expect(chipText({ ...decision, strikeUntil: null })).toBe("Removed: R3");
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = textOf(html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: decision })} />));
    expect(removed).toContain(STANDING_TEXTS.chip("Removed: R3", until));
  });

  test("the author's own withheld or removed post shows the chip as a link to the decision's statement, amber while korbat decides and red once removed", () => {
    session.state = me(id(900));
    const removed = html(<PostCard post={post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(3), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(removed)).toContain("Removed: R3");
    expect(hrefs(removed)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(3)}`);
    const held = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "withheld", moderation: { decisionId: id(4), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } })} />);
    expect(textOf(held)).toContain("Under review: illegal content");
    expect(hrefs(held)).toContain(`/settings/cases/${id(4)}`);
    // The colours are class names, which a render without the style compiler does not carry: they are read from the source.
    const card = read("components", "social", "PostCard.tsx");
    expect(card).toContain('const amber = decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld";');
    expect(card).toContain('const surface = `self-start rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 ${amber ? "bg-amber-500/15" : "bg-red-500/15"}`;');
    // Without the decision's facts the chip still says the state, and links nowhere.
    const bare = html(<PostCard post={post()} />);
    expect(textOf(bare)).toContain("Removed");
    expect(hrefs(bare).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    // A post whose images are sealed keeps its text and its place, without a chip: the post itself is visible.
    const sealedMedia: HiddenMedia[] = [{ id: id(21), hidden: true, sealed: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true, sealed: true }];
    const sealed = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: sealedMedia })} />);
    expect(textOf(sealed)).toContain("my own post");
    expect(count(textOf(sealed), SEALED_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(hrefs(sealed).filter((href) => href.startsWith("/settings/cases"))).toEqual([]);
    session.state = { status: "signed-out" };
    // Anyone else reads the placeholder of a hidden image for each of them.
    const others = html(<PostCard post={post({ state: "visible", media: [{ id: id(21), hidden: true }, { id: id(22), hidden: true }] })} />);
    expect(count(textOf(others), HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(textOf(others)).not.toContain(SEALED_IMAGE);
  });

  test("the author's own withheld image says Under review on itself and a removed one Removed, in the post and in the viewer; anyone else gets one placeholder for both", () => {
    const own = html(<MediaGrid media={[image(1, "withheld"), image(2, "removed"), image(3)]} postId={id(1)} own />);
    const text = textOf(own);
    expect(count(text, "Under review")).toBe(1);
    expect(count(text, "Removed")).toBe(1);
    // The author still sees their own images.
    expect(loaded(own)).toHaveLength(3);
    const noop = () => undefined;
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(1, "withheld")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Under review");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(2, "removed")]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).toContain("Removed");
    expect(textOf(html(<MediaViewerContent media={[image(3)]} index={0} onIndex={noop} onClose={noop} />))).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
    // For anyone else the API sends the same hidden image for a withheld and a removed one: one placeholder, which does not say which.
    const hidden: HiddenMedia = { id: id(1), hidden: true };
    const others = textOf(html(<MediaGrid media={[hidden, { ...hidden, id: id(2) }]} postId={id(1)} />));
    expect(count(others, HIDDEN_IMAGE)).toBe(2);
    expect(others).not.toMatch(/Under review|Removed/);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE,
  ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN,
  AuthorCasesPage,
  AuthorCasesQuery,
  DecisionAppeal,
  DecisionView,
  NoticeItemStatus,
  OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  PostView,
  QuotedPost,
  REPORTS_PAGE_SIZE,
  REVIEWER_STATES,
  ReportItem,
  ReportsPage,
  ReportsQuery,
  SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  UNSEEN_NO_ACTION,
  itemOutcomeWords,
  outcomeWords,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * What the app reads of moderation (3c design, sections 7.6 and 10): the chip's facts on the author's own post, the
 * author's list of decisions and one decision's view, and the reporter's list. Each shape is what its route answers and
 * what the app parses, so this file pins what each may carry.
 */
const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const TIME = "2026-10-04T10:00:00.000Z";

const post = (extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  id: id(1),
  author: { id: id(900), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false },
  body: "a post",
  createdAt: TIME,
  state: "removed",
  replyTo: null,
  counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
  media: [],
  quoteOf: null,
  ...extra,
});

describe("the chip's facts on a post", () => {
  test("a post may carry the decision behind its state: its id, the rule or the law, and whether korbat is still deciding", () => {
    const chip = { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null };
    expect(PostView.parse(post({ moderation: chip })).moderation).toEqual(chip);
    expect(PostView.parse(post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null } })).moderation).toEqual({ decisionId: id(2), ruleId: null, legal: true, interim: true, strikeUntil: null });
    expect(PostView.parse(post()).moderation).toBeUndefined();
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(PostView.safeParse(post({ moderation: { ...chip, ruleId } })).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
  });

  test("anything else in its place is refused", () => {
    const chip = { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null };
    for (const moderation of [{ ...chip, ruleId: "R7" }, { ...chip, decisionId: "no id" }, { ...chip, legal: "yes" }, { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false }, null]) {
      expect(PostView.safeParse(post({ moderation })).success, JSON.stringify(moderation)).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a quoted embed carries none: the chip belongs to the card of the post itself", () => {
    const quoted = QuotedPost.parse(post({ moderation: { decisionId: id(2), ruleId: "R3", legal: false, interim: false, strikeUntil: null } }));
    expect("moderation" in quoted).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The console's requests and answers on cases (3c design, section 10): what a moderator's own finding may say, what a
 * saved text must be, and the shapes the queue, the case and the home screen are parsed with.
 */

const CASE = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const POST = "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36";

const HEX = "ab".repeat(32);
const TIME = "2026-10-04T08:15:30.123Z";
/** The seven members of 3e on a ledger row of 3c, where each is null. */
const NO_STANDING_COLUMNS = { days: null, announced: null, basis: null, restsOn: null, earliestStart: null, countsUntil: null, period: null, restedOnBy: null, reply: null } as const;

describe("FindingRequest", () => {
  const finding = { target: { kind: "post", id: POST }, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R1", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" };

  test("a moderator's finding cites a korbat rule, R2 among them, about a post, an account or a korbat link", () => {
    for (const ruleId of ["R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6"]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId }).success, ruleId).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(FindingRequest.parse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "account", handle: "@Some_one" } }).target).toEqual({ kind: "account", handle: "some_one" });
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, target: { kind: "link", url: "https://korbat.example/post/" + POST } }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("it has no other ground than a rule: a finding never alleges illegality and never goes the path that records no sender", () => {
    for (const ground of ["illegal", "csam", "order", "law", ""]) expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ground }).success, ground).toBe(false);
    const { ground: _ground, ...withoutGround } = finding;
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse(withoutGround).success).toBe(false);
    // The members of the other grounds are refused, never ignored.
    for (const extra of [{ explanation: "words" }, { bonaFide: true }, { citedLaw: "a law" }, { keyword: "csam" }, { name: "A" }, { email: "a@b.example" }, { turnstileToken: "t" }]) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ...extra }).success, Object.keys(extra)[0]).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: "R7" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, ruleId: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("its category is one of the Transparency Database's, but not the one that says a notifier was not sure", () => {
    for (const category of TDB_CATEGORIES) {
      expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success, category).toBe(category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE");
    }
    expect(FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the categories a finding may carry are exported as a list, in the Transparency Database's order, for the console's form: exactly those the request takes", () => {
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toEqual(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => category !== "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE"));
    expect(FINDING_CATEGORIES).toHaveLength(TDB_CATEGORIES.length - 1);
    expect(TDB_CATEGORIES.filter((category) => FindingRequest.safeParse({ ...finding, category }).success)).toEqual(FINDING_CATEGORIES);
  });

  test("the answer names the case the finding opened or joined", () => {
    expect(FindingResponse.parse({ caseId: CASE })).toEqual({ caseId: CASE });
    expect(FindingResponse.safeParse({ caseId: "x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("a saved text", () => {
  const save = { kind: "note", text: "Art. 18 check: no suspicion", salt: HEX, digest: HEX };

  test("is of one of the seven kinds, the recorded choice not to seal among them, with a 32-byte salt and a digest in lower-case hex", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_KINDS).toEqual(["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason", "reveal_reason", "note", "seal_declined"]);
    for (const kind of STAFF_TEXT_KINDS) expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind }).success, kind).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, kind: "statement" }).success).toBe(false);
    for (const bad of [HEX.toUpperCase(), HEX.slice(2), `${HEX}00`, "", "g".repeat(64)]) {
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, salt: bad }).success, `salt ${bad}`).toBe(false);
      expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, digest: bad }).success, `digest ${bad}`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, caseId: CASE }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the request's schema lets any text through: what a text must be is the route's to refuse, with a code of its own", () => {
    // A text that is too long or holds a control character is answered text_invalid, not invalid_request.
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: "x".repeat(STAFF_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: `a${String.fromCharCode(7)}b` }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StaffTextSaveRequest.safeParse({ ...save, text: 5 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("staffTextProblem: a well-formed text of at most 5000 UTF-16 units, with no control character but the line feed and no invisible direction or zero-width character", () => {
    expect(STAFF_TEXT_MAX).toBe(5000);
    const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
    expect(staffTextProblem(`two${LF}lines`)).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("")).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5000))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem("x".repeat(5001))).toBe("too_long");
    // An emoji is two units: 2500 of them fit, and one more unit does not.
    const emoji = String.fromCodePoint(0x1f600);
    expect(staffTextProblem(emoji.repeat(2500))).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`${emoji.repeat(2500)}x`)).toBe("too_long");
    // Half of a surrogate pair has no UTF-8 bytes.
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xd83d)}b`)).toBe("malformed");
    expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(0xde00)}`)).toBe("malformed");
    // NUL and every other C0 control but the line feed.
    for (let code = 0; code < 32; code++) {
      expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe(code === 10 ? null : "control");
    }
    // The invisible direction and spacing characters the notice texts refuse too; the joiners scripts and emoji need stay.
    for (const code of [0x202a, 0x202e, 0x2066, 0x2069, 0x200b, 0x2060, 0xfeff]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBe("format");
    for (const code of [0x200c, 0x200d]) expect(staffTextProblem(`a${String.fromCharCode(code)}b`), `U+${code.toString(16)}`).toBeNull();
    expect(staffTextProblem(`r${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}sum${String.fromCharCode(0xe9)}`)).toBeNull();
  });

  test("the answers: the stored text's id and digest, the person's own drafts with their salts, and a snapshot's id and digest, never content", () => {
    expect(StaffTextSaved.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX })).toEqual({ id: CASE, digest: HEX });
    const draft = { id: CASE, kind: "facts", text: "The post names a home address.", salt: HEX, digest: HEX, createdAt: TIME };
    expect(StaffTextsResponse.parse({ texts: [draft] }).texts).toEqual([draft]);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffSnapshotTaken.parse({ id: CASE, digest: HEX, body: "content", media: [] }))).toEqual(["id", "digest"]);
  });
});

  test("parses a case with its target, suspicion, snapshots, items, decisions, appeals, texts and history", () => {
    const parsed = CaseView.parse(view);
    expect(parsed.snapshots).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(parsed.items[0]!.source.kind).toBe("anonymous");
    expect(parsed.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!.sealed?.list).toEqual([{ postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 }]);
    // An account's case: its live fields, no suspicion, and never an image.
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [] };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(account).success).toBe(true);
    // A target whose row is gone is still an answer: staff see what is.
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, target: { type: "post", id: POST, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${POST}`, authorHandle: null, state: null, level: null } }).success).toBe(true);
  });


  test("3e: a post case carries whether a strike is due and the author's standing in bands; an account case the account's standing", () => {
    for (const why of ["due", "already_struck", "before_last_strike"] as const) expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: why === "due", why } }).success, why).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, strikeDue: { due: true, why: "maybe" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3", suspensionsInYear: "0", now: "none" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, authorStanding: { activeStrikes: "3_or_more", suspensionsInYear: "2_or_more", now: "terminated" } }).success).toBe(true);
    const standing = {
      activeStrikes: 3,
      strikes: [{ decisionId: OTHER, caseId: CASE, ruleId: "R3", decidedAt: TIME, countsUntil: TIME }],
      ladderRule: "R3",
      suspensionsInYear: 0,
      lastSuspendedOn: null,
      maxDays: 3,
      mayTerminate: false,
      live: false,
      openReports: true,
      atOnce: ["threat"],
      flood: { posts: 2, from: TIME, to: TIME },
      seal: { decidedOn: "2026-10-01" },
      snapshotHandleRetired: false,
      // 3e Task 3: the decision each ground of a suspension at once would rest on now, by its time.
      basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME, terrorist: null, protective: TIME },
      // 3e Task 5: the account's record of reporting, in reports.
      reporting: { reports: 0, unfounded: 0, warnedOn: null, warnedAt: null, marksSince: null, mayWarn: false, mayRestrict: false, restrictedUntil: null, marked: [] },
    };
    const account = { ...view, target: { type: "account", id: POST, handle: "now_named", displayName: "A name", bio: "A bio", deleted: false }, suspicion: null, snapshots: [], items: [], decisions: [], strikeDue: null, authorStanding: null, standing };
    expect(CaseView.parse(account).standing).toEqual(standing);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, maxDays: 31 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, atOnce: ["ladder"] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...account, standing: { ...standing, basisDecidedAt: { threat: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
    // A decision says which standing measures rest on it, when any does; older answers carry no such member.
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) {
      expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "suspend", basis: "threat" }]);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "suspend", basis: "spam" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    }
    // Each member is always there: on the other kind of case it is null.
    const { standing: _standing, ...without } = account;
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(without).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e: a ledger row carries its days, whether it is announced, its basis, what it rests on, its earliest start, its end of counting and its period", () => {
    const action = view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!;
    const strike = { ...action, kind: "strike", sealed: null, countsUntil: TIME };
    const suspend = { ...action, kind: "suspend", sealed: null, days: 3, announced: true, basis: "strikes", restsOn: [OTHER], earliestStart: TIME, period: { startsAt: null, endsAt: null, state: "unfixed" } };
    for (const row of [strike, suspend]) expect(CaseDecisionAction.parse(row)).toEqual(row);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, basis: "ladder" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, period: { ...suspend.period, state: "paused" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse({ ...suspend, days: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    const { period: _period, ...withoutPeriod } = suspend;
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.safeParse(withoutPeriod).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("3e Task 5: each item says whether it can be marked and whether its mark counts or was withdrawn; an account case carries its record of reporting in reports, by reference and never by person", () => {
    const item = view.items[0]!;
    for (const member of ["markable", "unfounded", "markWithdrawn"] as const) {
      const { [member]: _gone, ...without } = item;
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [without] }).success, member).toBe(false);
      expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, [member]: null }] }).success, member).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, items: [{ ...item, markable: true, unfounded: true }] }).items[0]).toMatchObject({ markable: true, unfounded: true, markWithdrawn: false });
    const reporting = {
      reports: 8,
      unfounded: 5,
      warnedOn: "2026-09-01",
      warnedAt: TIME,
      marksSince: 2,
      mayWarn: false,
      mayRestrict: false,
      restrictedUntil: null,
      marked: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGHIJ", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-08-30", markedOn: "2026-08-31", sinceWarning: false }],
    };
    const parsed = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting.parse(reporting);
    expect(parsed).toEqual(reporting);
    const Reporting = CaseView.shape.standing.unwrap().shape.reporting;
    // A marked report is named by its reference and the item's place in it, never by who sent it.
    expect(Object.keys(Reporting.shape.marked.element.shape).sort()).toEqual(["markedOn", "position", "ref", "sentOn", "sinceWarning"]);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, marked: [{ ...reporting.marked[0], ref: "someone" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, unfounded: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(Reporting.safeParse({ ...reporting, restrictedUntil: "2026-10-01" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A restriction of reporting rests on its warning: the warning's decision says so, for [review.warning].
    const decision = CaseView.parse(view).decisions[0];
    if (decision) expect(CaseView.parse({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...decision, standingOn: [{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }] }] }).decisions[0]!.standingOn).toEqual([{ kind: "restrict_reporting", basis: "reports" }]);
  });

  test("a withheld snapshot carries its id, time and digest and no content, whatever the answer held", () => {
    const withheld = CaseSnapshot.parse({ ...shown, withheld: true });
    expect(Object.keys(withheld).sort()).toEqual(["digest", "id", "takenAt", "withheld"]);
  });

  test("a snapshot that is shown carries everything its digest covers: the console recomputes the digest from the answer", async () => {
    const parsed = CaseSnapshot.parse(shown);
    if (parsed.withheld) throw new Error("the snapshot is shown");
    const expected = await snapshotDigest({ ...shown, targetType: "post", postState: "visible" });
    expect(await snapshotDigest(parsed)).toBe(expected);
    const { salt: _salt, ...withoutSalt } = shown;
    expect(CaseSnapshot.safeParse(withoutSalt).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a seal's list holds at most the 500 rows the case answer carries", () => {
    const row = { postId: POST, createdAt: TIME, images: 1 };
    const withList = (rows: number) => ({ ...view, decisions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!, actions: [{ ...view.decisions[0]!.actions[0]!, sealed: { posts: rows, images: rows, deletedPosts: 0, list: Array.from({ length: rows }, () => row) } }] }] });
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(500)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(withList(501)).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("suspicion holds counts and days only", () => {
    const bad = { ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, earlier: { target: { count: 0, lastOn: TIME, imagesOpenedOn: null }, author: { count: 0, lastOn: null } } } };
    expect(CaseView.safeParse(bad).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseView.safeParse({ ...view, suspicion: { ...view.suspicion, reach: { ...view.suspicion.reach, newestPostOn: TIME } } }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the queue and the overview", () => {
  const row = { id: CASE, lane: 0, targetType: "post", openedAt: TIME, oldestOpenAt: TIME, openItems: 2, rules: ["R5"], categories: ["STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE"], allegesIllegal: true, suspect: false, reexamination: false, deferred: false };

  test("a page of the queue holds at most 50 cases and the cursor of the next", () => {

    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [row], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 50 }, () => row), nextCursor: "abc_-123", replies: [] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: Array.from({ length: 51 }, () => row), nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [{ ...row, lane: 3 }], nextCursor: null, replies: [] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the queue's cursor is an opaque word: letters, digits, dashes and underscores", () => {
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "eyJhIjoxfQ_-" }).success).toBe(true);
    for (const cursor of ["", "a b", "a/b", "a=b", "x".repeat(401)]) expect(QueueQuery.safeParse({ cursor }).success, cursor).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the overview holds counts, times, staff handles and cases", () => {
    const overview = {
      lanes: [
        { lane: 0, open: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
        { lane: 1, open: 0, oldestAt: null },
        { lane: 2, open: 5, oldestAt: TIME },
      ],
      appealsWaiting: 3,
      appealsYouMayReview: 1,
      appealsWithoutReviewer: 2,
      reveals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE }] },
      imagesToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 4 }],
      findingsToday: [{ handle: "mod_anna", count: 1 }],
      mailsWaiting: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 1, outcomes: 0 },
      mailsFailed: { receipts: 0, authorMails: 0, outcomes: 2 },
      releaseOverdue: 0,
      erasureOverdue: { caseEvidence: 0, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 0, redactions: 0, images: 0, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 0 },
      deferUnproven: false,
      protectionLifted: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, kind: "dismissed" }] },
      sealsDeclined: { total: 0, items: [] },
      interimSeals: { total: 1, items: [{ at: TIME, handle: "mod_anna", caseId: CASE, posts: 2, images: 5 }] },
      repliesWaiting: { count: 2, oldestAt: TIME },
      strikeAccounts: 1,
    };
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse(overview).success).toBe(true);
    // Each of the three lists holds at most as many rows as the reveals' list does.
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, interimSeals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.interimSeals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, lanes: overview.lanes.slice(0, 2) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, reveals: { total: 101, items: Array.from({ length: 101 }, () => overview.reveals.items[0]) } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(StaffOverview.safeParse({ ...overview, releaseOverdue: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("erasureOverdue is one count for each due rule of retention: all eight, each a whole number from 0", () => {
    const counts = { caseEvidence: 2, intakeRecords: 0, statements: 1, redactions: 0, images: 60, drafts: 0, accessLog: 0, contacts: 3 };
    expect(ErasureOverdue.parse(counts)).toEqual(counts);
    expect(Object.keys(ErasureOverdue.shape).sort()).toEqual(["accessLog", "caseEvidence", "contacts", "drafts", "images", "intakeRecords", "redactions", "statements"]);
    for (const key of Object.keys(counts)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...missing } = counts as Record<string, number>;
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse(missing).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: -1 }).success, key).toBe(false);
      expect(ErasureOverdue.safeParse({ ...counts, [key]: 1.5 }).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    // The overview carries it: an answer without it is refused, so a console never reads "nothing is late" from a missing member.
    const parsed = StaffOverview.safeParse({ lanes: [], erasureOverdue: counts });
    expect(parsed.success).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(StaffOverview.shape)).toContain("erasureOverdue");
  });
});
```

```ts
describe("STANDING_RULES", () => {
  test("holds the cautious defaults of the design, each one line to change", () => {

      ladderMemoryDays: 365,

    const longest = Math.max(...STANDING_RULES.ladderDays, STANDING_RULES.threatDays, STANDING_RULES.terroristDays, STANDING_RULES.floodDays, STANDING_RULES.protectiveDays, STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictDays);
    expect(longest).toBeLessThanOrEqual(STANDING_DAYS.max);
    expect(STANDING_DAYS).toEqual({ min: 1, max: 30 });

});

    expect(PERIOD_STATES).toEqual(["unfixed", "announced", "held", "running", "ended", "never", "lifted", "basis_ended"]);
  });

  test("the composer's drafts are W.5's ten texts, each placeholder one the case answer fills", () => {
    const texts = [...Object.values(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts), ...Object.values(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason)];
    expect(texts).toHaveLength(10);
    expect(Object.keys(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts)).toEqual(["strikes", "ladder_end", "threat", "terrorist", "threat_repeat", "flood", "protective", "warn", "restrict"]);
    expect(Object.keys(STANDING_DRAFTS.reason)).toEqual(["protective"]);
    const known = new Set(["activeStrikes", "n", "ladderMemoryDays", "day", "posts", "from", "to", "sealedOn", "frameDays", "readDay", "reports", "unfounded", "marked", "warnedOn", "marksSince"]);
    for (const text of texts) {

    expect(STANDING_DRAFTS.facts.protective).toContain("korbat has not assessed them");

  });

    expect(NoticeItemStatus.shape.scope.unwrap().options).toEqual(["account", "quote", "account_suspect", "account_retired", "account_measure"]);

    expect(words("restricted_legal", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.restricted_legal}. ${ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired}`);
    // A reversal's phrase stands alone: the handle given back is never followed by "korbat retired the handle".
    expect(words("reversed", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", "account_retired")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, "account_retired"), outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE);
      expect(words(outcome, "account_retired"), outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
      for (const scope of ["account", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, scope), `${outcome} ${scope}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_MEASURE_SCOPE.retired);
    }
  });

  test("a statement's retirement carries its handle and placeholder, a standing measure whether it was announced, and the handle given back its handle; all optional, so older data parses", () => {
    const retire = { kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, handle: "ada_l", placeholder: "retired_0a1b2c3d4e5f" };
    expect(StatementMeasure.parse(retire)).toEqual(retire);
    expect(StatementMeasure.parse({ kind: "suspend", mediaId: null, noEffect: null, sealed: null, announced: false }).announced).toBe(false);
    expect(StatementMeasure.parse({ kind: "retire_handle", mediaId: null, noEffect: "already", sealed: null, handle: "ada_l", placeholder: null }).placeholder).toBeNull();
    const back = { kind: "unretire_handle", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null, handle: "ada_l" };
    expect(StatementReversal.parse(back)).toEqual(back);
    expect(StatementReversal.parse({ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null })).not.toHaveProperty("handle");
  });

  test("the case answer says whether the newest snapshot's handle is retired, and a retirement's row names the handle it retired", () => {
    expect(CaseStanding.shape.snapshotHandleRetired.parse(true)).toBe(true);
    expect(CaseStanding.shape.snapshotHandleRetired.safeParse(null).success).toBe(false);
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.shape.handle.parse("ada_l")).toBe("ada_l");
    expect(CaseDecisionAction.shape.handle.parse(undefined)).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

    expect(AccountStanding.safeParse({ ...running, measure: { ...running.measure, kind: "strike" } }).success).toBe(false);

    expect(StatementMeasure.safeParse({ ...atOnce, basis: "spam" }).success).toBe(false);

describe("announced measures, replies and termination (3e design, sections 10.1 to 10.3, Task 4)", () => {
  const T = "2026-10-12T10:00:00.000Z";
  const ID = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

  test("a reply carries at most REPLY_TEXT_MAX characters and nothing else; its answer says when it was filed and whether before the start; replies are answered within REPLY_AIM_HOURS", () => {
    expect(REPLY_AIM_HOURS).toBe(24);
    expect(ReplyRequest.safeParse({}).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReplyRequest.safeParse({ statement: "I quoted a film." }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReplyRequest.safeParse({ statement: "x".repeat(REPLY_TEXT_MAX + 1) }).success).toBe(false);
    // The time of filing and whether it came on time are the database's: a request that sets either is refused.
    expect(ReplyRequest.safeParse({ statement: "x", onTime: true }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReplyRequest.safeParse({ filedAt: T }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReplyResponse.parse({ filedAt: T, onTime: true })).toEqual({ filedAt: T, onTime: true });
  });

  test("the queue's first page carries the unanswered replies without their text; a decision's standing carries the reply with its text for its author", () => {

    expect(QueueReply.parse(reply)).toEqual(reply);

    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [], nextCursor: null, replies: [reply] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(QueuePage.safeParse({ cases: [], nextCursor: null }).success).toBe(false);
    const standing = {
      state: "held",
      earliestStart: T,
      startsAt: null,
      endsAt: null,
      endedAt: null,
      endedBy: null,
      replaced: false,
      restsOn: [{ decisionId: ID, ruleId: "R1", decidedAt: T, countsUntil: T, state: "counts", overruledAt: null }],
      reply: { filedAt: T, onTime: true, text: "I quoted a film.", erasedAt: null, answeredAt: null, answeredBy: null },
      replyOpen: false,
    };
    expect(DecisionStanding.parse(standing)).toEqual(standing);
    expect(DecisionStanding.safeParse({ ...standing, state: "paused" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A measure taken at once rests on a decision, not a strike: no rule's count, no state.
    expect(DecisionStanding.safeParse({ ...standing, restsOn: [{ decisionId: ID, ruleId: null, decidedAt: T, countsUntil: null, state: null, overruledAt: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a statement that answered a reply carries the reply's time, the measure and the start and end it fixed; optional, so older data parses", () => {
    const repliedTo = { filedAt: T, onTime: true, kind: "suspend", days: 3, periodThen: { state: "not_started", startedAt: null, endedAt: null }, startsAt: T, endsAt: T, appealUntil: T };
    expect(StatementRepliedTo.parse(repliedTo)).toEqual(repliedTo);
    expect(StatementRepliedTo.safeParse({ ...repliedTo, days: 31 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DecisionStatement.shape.repliedTo.safeParse(undefined).success).toBe(true);
    expect(StatementReversal.shape.replyFiledAt.safeParse(undefined).success).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the Standing screen's four lists: people by handle, each row's case, the numbers the ladder reads", () => {
    const lists = {
      atThreeStrikes: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "someone", caseId: null, activeStrikes: 3, ruleId: "R1", newestOn: "2026-10-04", maxDays: 3, mayTerminate: false }] },
      reportingRecords: { total: 0, items: [] },
      noticesUndelivered: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "someone", caseId: ID, decidedOn: "2026-10-01", startsAt: T }] },
      terminationsWaiting: { total: 1, items: [{ handle: "someone", caseId: ID, decidedOn: "2026-09-01", finalOn: null, heldBy: "reply", replyOnTime: true }] },
    };
    expect(StandingLists.parse(lists)).toEqual(lists);
    expect(StandingLists.safeParse({ ...lists, terminationsWaiting: { total: 1, items: [{ ...lists.terminationsWaiting.items[0], heldBy: "admin" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    // No row carries an account's id or address.
    for (const list of Object.values(StandingLists.shape)) {
      const row = (list.shape.items.element as unknown as { shape: Record<string, unknown> }).shape;
      for (const member of Object.keys(row)) expect(member, member).not.toMatch(/accountId|email|address/i);
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";

import { REDRESS_TEXTS, RULEBOOKS, STATEMENT_WORDS, getRule, retireEnd, statementParagraphs, type StatementInput } from "../src/index";

/**
 * The statement of reasons (3c design, section 10): one pure function renders it for the author's screen, the console's
 * preview and the mail, from the decision's data and the versions it was made under. These tests hold it to the six
 * elements of Article 17(3) of the Digital Services Act for every kind of decision, and to the design's sentences word
 * for word.
 */
const POST = { id: "7e2d9a10-6c3b-4f5e-8a21-0d4c7b9e1f36", createdAt: "2026-10-01T12:00:00.000Z" };

const RESET_DECISION = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";
const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

const measure = (kind: MeasureKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["measures"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["measures"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  noEffect: null,
  sealed: kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: 1, images: 2, deletedImages: 0 } : null,
  ...more,
});
const reversal = (kind: ReversalKind, more: Partial<DecisionStatement["reversals"][number]> = {}): DecisionStatement["reversals"][number] => ({
  kind,
  mediaId: MEASURES[kind].target === "image" ? IMAGE : null,
  ...NO_RESET,
  ...more,
});

/** A final removal of a post under R1, following a report: the plainest restricting decision. */
function statement(more: Partial<StatementInput> = {}): StatementInput {
  return {
    kind: "final",
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: "R1",
    rulesVersion: 2,

    reversals: [],
    endedMeasures: [],
    reviewed: null,
    ...more,
  };
}

const W = STATEMENT_WORDS;
const text = (input: StatementInput) => statementParagraphs(input).join("\n");
const appeal = (decidedAt: string) => REDRESS_TEXTS[1].appeal.replace("{deadline}", `${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(0, 10)} ${appealDeadline(new Date(decidedAt)).toISOString().slice(11, 16)} UTC`);

describe("statementParagraphs", () => {
  test("a final removal under a rule, paragraph by paragraph: what was done, where and how long, how it came to korbat, no automation, the rule as its version words it, the facts, the reason and the appeal", () => {
    expect(statementParagraphs(statement())).toEqual([
      `korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`,
      "This applies everywhere korbat is available and has no end date.",
      "korbat decided this following a report by another user.",
      "No automated means were used to find this or to decide it.",
      `It breaks korbat rule R1, "No sexual or pornographic content": ${getRule("R1", 2)!.text}`,
      "The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.",
      "korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.",
      appeal(DECIDED),
    ]);
    // The deadline is the appeal's own: six months after the decision, to the minute, in UTC.

    for (const version of [1, 2, 3] as const) {

        const out = text(statement({ ruleId: rule.id as StatementInput["ruleId"], rulesVersion: version }));
        expect(out, `${rule.id} v${version}`).toContain(`It breaks korbat rule ${rule.id}, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
      }

    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: 2 }))).toContain('"No spam, scams, impersonation or coordinated manipulation"');
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 1 }))).toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    expect(text(statement({ ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: 2 }))).not.toContain("Images that score high on the automated check");
    // A version the package does not hold cannot be rendered as another one.

      const others: StatementInput[] = [

        statement({ outcome: "not_evident", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, reason: null, measures: [] }),
        statement({ kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),

        statement({ kind: "review", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, facts: null, measures: [], reversals: [reversal("restore")], reviewed }),
      ];
      for (const input of others) expect(statementParagraphs(input).at(-1), `${input.kind} ${input.outcome}`).toBe(REDRESS_TEXTS[1].notAppealable);
    });
  });

  test("every restricting decision carries the six elements of Article 17(3): each measure, kind, ground and rulebook version", () => {
    const grounds = [
      { ground: "incompatible" as const, ruleId: "R3" as const, legalReference: null },
      { ground: "illegal" as const, ruleId: null, legalReference: "Section 130 of the criminal code." },
    ];
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final"] as const) {
      // 3c's seven measures; 3e's are held to their own sentences below and in later tasks.
      for (const measureKind of MEASURE_KINDS.slice(0, 7)) {
        if (!MEASURES[measureKind][kind]) continue;
        for (const ground of grounds) {
          for (const rulesVersion of [1, 2]) {
            const account = MEASURES[measureKind].target === "display_name" || MEASURES[measureKind].target === "bio";
            const input = statement({ kind, ...ground, rulesVersion, post: account ? null : POST, measures: [measure(measureKind)] });
            const out = statementParagraphs(input);
            const label = `${kind} ${measureKind} ${ground.ground} v${rulesVersion}`;
            // (a) the restriction, where it applies and for how long.
            expect(out[0], label).toMatch(/^korbat (hid|removed|sealed|reset) /);
            expect(out, label).toContain(kind === "interim" ? W.scope.interim : W.scope.final);
            // (b) the facts, and whether the decision followed a notice or korbat's own finding.
            expect(out, label).toContain("The facts: The post shows explicit sexual acts.");
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat decided this following a report by another user.");
            // (c) the use of automated means.
            expect(out, label).toContain(W.automation);
            // (d) and (e) the legal ground, or the rule, with its explanation: as a finding only for a final restriction
            // that seals nothing; while deciding, as what korbat is checking; for a seal, as what the step rests on.
            const rule = getRule("R3", rulesVersion)!;
            const seals = measureKind === "seal_media";
            if (ground.ground === "illegal") {
              expect(out, label).toContain(seals ? "This step rests on the law: Section 130 of the criminal code." : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking whether this is illegal. The law in question: Section 130 of the criminal code." : "korbat found it illegal. The law it rests on: Section 130 of the criminal code.");
            } else {
              expect(out, label).toContain(`${seals ? "This step rests on" : kind === "interim" ? "korbat is checking this against" : "It breaks"} korbat rule R3, "${rule.title}": ${rule.text}`);
            }
            if (seals || kind === "interim") expect(out.join(" "), label).not.toMatch(/It breaks korbat rule|korbat found it illegal/);
            expect(out, label).toContain("korbat's reasons: That is content whose primary purpose is sexual arousal.");
            // (f) redress.
            expect(out.at(-1)!.startsWith(kind === "interim" ? REDRESS_TEXTS[1].interim : "You can appeal this decision once"), label).toBe(true);
            // One paragraph is one line, but for a staff text that holds line feeds of its own, and none is empty.
            for (const paragraph of out) expect(paragraph.trim().length, label).toBeGreaterThan(0);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });

  describe("what was done, for each measure", () => {
    test("a post and an image, while deciding and for good", () => {
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", measures: [measure("withhold_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat hid one image of your post of ${POST_TIME} from other people while it decides.`);
      expect(statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove_media")] }))[0]).toBe(`korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`);
      // Several measures in one decision: one paragraph each, in the decision's order.
      const both = statementParagraphs(statement({ measures: [measure("remove"), measure("remove_media")] }));
      expect(both.slice(0, 2)).toEqual([`korbat removed your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`, `korbat removed one image of your post of ${POST_TIME}: other people can no longer see it.`]);
    });

    test("a field reset says that the placeholder was written once and that the old value does not come back", () => {
      const name = statementParagraphs(statement({ post: null, measures: [measure("reset_display_name")] }));
      expect(name[0]).toBe(
        "korbat reset your display name. korbat wrote this placeholder once. You may set your display name again; what you set is judged on its own if someone reports it, and korbat does not put the old value back when this measure ends or is lifted.",
      );
      const bio = statementParagraphs(statement({ kind: "interim", post: null, measures: [measure("reset_bio")] }));
      expect(bio[0]).toBe(
```
