  return { appeal, measures: decision.actions.filter((action) => liftsOneByOne(action) && action.inForce) };
}

/** The draft of a review of one decision's appeal: the decision kept, nothing lifted, and no reason written. */
export function reviewDraft(caseId: CaseId, view: CaseView, decision: CaseDecision, role: StaffRole): CaseDraft {
  return { ...newDraft(caseId, view, role), kind: "review", reviewsDecisionId: decision.id, review: "kept", category: decision.category, actions: [] };
}

/** A review as "Review this appeal" opens it: with the review reason its person saved on this case before. */
export function openReview(caseId: CaseId, view: CaseView, decision: CaseDecision, role: StaffRole): Promise<CaseDraft> {
  return withSavedTexts(reviewDraft(caseId, view, decision, role), view.drafts);
}

/**
 * The reversals a review's draft may hold: one for each measure of the reviewed decision that is still in force. A seal
 * is lifted by an admin only, so to anyone else it is not among them, and nothing is offered at all once the appeal is
 * answered or is not this person's to review.
 */
export function reviewChoices(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, role: StaffRole): { measure: CaseDecisionAction; reversal: DecisionActionParams }[] {
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  return (offered?.measures ?? []).filter((measure) => role === "admin" || measure.kind !== "seal_media").map((measure) => ({ measure, reversal: reversalOf(measure) }));
}

/** The answer a review's draft gives. */
export const reviewOutcomeOf = (_view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"] => draft.review ?? "kept";

/**
 * Whether a review's draft lifts what its answer says: nothing when it keeps the decision, every measure still in force
 * when it reverses it, and some but not all of them when it reverses part. The database holds the same at commit.
 */
function reviewConsistent(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): boolean {
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  if (!offered) return false;
  const all = offered.measures.map(reversalOf);
  const lifted = draft.actions.filter((action) => all.some((reversal) => sameAction(reversal, action)));
  if (lifted.length !== draft.actions.length) return false;
  const outcome = reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft);
  if (outcome === "kept") return lifted.length === 0;
  if (outcome === "reversed") return all.length > 0 && lifted.length === all.length;
  return lifted.length > 0 && lifted.length < all.length;
}

/** The digests a review's params carry: the shown snapshot's, and that of the review reason the console saved. */
export interface ReviewDigests {
  snapshot: string;
  reason: string | null;
}

/**
 * The params the key confirms for a review, built from what the page shows (3c design, section 7.7): the case's version,
 * the decision's pending appeal, the newest snapshot by its id with the digest the console computed, the answer, the
 * reviewed decision's category and rules version, the redress texts' version, the reversals in their one order and the
 * digest of the saved reason. The contracts' schema refuses what cannot stand before any key is asked.
 */
export function reviewParamsOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, digests: ReviewDigests): AppealsReviewedParams {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest) throw new Error("a review names a snapshot of its case: the case holds none");
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const offered = decision ? reviewable(view, decision) : null;
  if (!decision || !offered) throw new Error("a review's draft names a decision of the case whose appeal this person may review");
  return AppealsReviewedParams.parse({
    stateVersion: view.stateVersion,
    appealId: offered.appeal.id,
    snapshotId: newest.id,
    snapshotDigest: digests.snapshot,
    outcome: reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft),
    // A review carries the rulebook version and the category of the decision it reviews.
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
    category: decision.category,
    // 3e: a review that reverses the decision whole overrules the strike it gave, which the person never chooses.
    actions: [...draft.actions, ...overruleOf(decision, reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft) === "reversed")].sort(compareDecisionActions),
    reasonDigest: digests.reason,
  });
}

/** Whether a draft holds an action. */
export const holds = (draft: CaseDraft, action: DecisionActionParams): boolean => draft.actions.some((held) => sameAction(held, action));

/** The draft's actions with one added or taken away. */
export function toggled(draft: CaseDraft, action: DecisionActionParams, on: boolean): DecisionActionParams[] {
  const without = draft.actions.filter((held) => !sameAction(held, action));
  return on ? [...without, action] : without;
}

/**
 * The case's saved texts put into a draft that has none written yet (a reload, or a sign-in in another tab): for each
 * kind the newest of the person's own unconfirmed texts whose digest the console recomputes from its salt and text. One
 * that does not recompute is dropped, and so is one the rules for a staff text refuse: the console would never have
 * saved it, so an answer cannot put it into a draft.
 */
export async function withSavedTexts(draft: CaseDraft, saved: readonly StaffTextDraft[]): Promise<CaseDraft> {
  const next: CaseDraft = { ...draft, written: { ...draft.written }, texts: { ...draft.texts } };
  for (const kind of DRAFT_TEXT_KINDS) {
    if (next.written[kind] !== "") continue;
    const newest = saved.filter((text) => text.kind === kind).at(-1);
    if (!newest) continue;
    if (staffTextProblem(newest.text) !== null) continue;
    const digest = await textDigest(newest.salt, newest.text).catch(() => null);
    if (digest !== newest.digest) continue;
    next.written[kind] = newest.text;
    next.texts[kind] = { id: newest.id, text: newest.text, salt: newest.salt, digest };
  }
  return next;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the statement the preview shows

/** The source the database will record for a decision made now: a notice, a report, or the moderator's own finding, from the items it considers. */
export function predictedSource(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): StatementInput["source"] {
  const fromUsers = considered(view, kind).filter((item) => item.source.kind !== "staff");
  if (fromUsers.some((item) => item.allegesIllegal)) return "notice";
  return fromUsers.length > 0 ? "report" : "own_initiative";
}

/** Whether korbat still keeps what a decision's snapshot copied: the page shows that snapshot's content. */
const snapshotShown = (view: CaseView, snapshotId: string): boolean => view.snapshots.some((snapshot) => snapshot.id === snapshotId && !snapshot.withheld);

const NO_RESET = { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } as const;

/** What a statement says of a field reset that ends or is lifted: the decision that holds it, and whether its old value is still kept. */
function resetFacts(view: CaseView, decision: CaseDecision, action: CaseDecisionAction) {
  const target = MEASURES[action.kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return NO_RESET;
  return { resetDecisionId: decision.id, oldValueKept: action.noEffect === null && snapshotShown(view, decision.snapshotId), resetRuleId: decision.ruleId };
}

/** The measures taken while deciding that a final decision made now would end: every one when it closes the case, and a seal with the answer to the suspect items. */
function endedBy(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): StatementInput["endedMeasures"] {
  if (draft.kind !== "final") return [];
  const closes = leftOpen(view).length === 0;
  const answersSuspect = suspectOpen(view).length > 0;
  const seals = draft.actions.some((action) => action.kind === "seal_media");
  return interimInForce(view)
    .filter(({ action }) => (action.kind === "seal_media" ? answersSuspect && !seals : closes) && !holds(draft, reversalOf(action)))
    .map(({ decision, action }) => ({ kind: action.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, ...resetFacts(view, decision, action) }));
}

/** The newest snapshot the page can show that holds the post's creation time. */
const datedSnapshot = (view: CaseView) => view.snapshots.find((snapshot): snapshot is Extract<CaseSnapshot, { withheld: false }> => !snapshot.withheld && snapshot.postCreatedAt !== null);

/**
 * Whether the page can draw a statement for the case at all. A post's statement names the post by its creation time,
 * which only a snapshot holds: without one the page can show there is no preview, and no time is made up.
 */
export const previewable = (view: CaseView): boolean => view.target.type !== "post" || datedSnapshot(view) !== undefined;

/** The post a post case's statement names: its id and the creation time the shown snapshot copied. */
function postOf(view: CaseView): StatementInput["post"] {
  if (view.target.type !== "post") return null;
  const shown = datedSnapshot(view);
  if (!shown || shown.postCreatedAt === null) throw new Error("a post's statement names the post's creation time: the page shows no snapshot that holds it");
  return { id: view.target.id, createdAt: shown.postCreatedAt };
}

/** Whether the decision a statement was drawn for sends its author anything: one that restricts nothing, lifts nothing and ends nothing is recorded without a mail. */
export const statementSent = (input: StatementInput): boolean => input.kind === "review" || input.kind === "correction" || input.measures.length + input.reversals.length + input.endedMeasures.length > 0;

/** Whether a correction that lifts these leaves nothing of its decision in force: then it reverses the decision, else part of it. */
function reversesAll(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): boolean {
  const decision = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
  const inForce = (decision?.actions ?? []).filter((action) => liftsOneByOne(action) && action.inForce);
  return inForce.every((action) => holds(draft, reversalOf(action)));
}

/**
 * The statement as its author will receive it, from the draft: the data statementParagraphs renders for the preview. What
 * only the database knows when the decision is recorded (a seal's list, whether a measure changes anything) is the
 * page's reading of the case as it showed it. It throws for a post case without a snapshot the page can show
 * (previewable says so first).
 */
export function previewOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, now: Date): StatementInput {
  const text = (kind: DraftTextKind): string | null => (normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "" ? null : normalised(draft.written[kind]));
  const base = { redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, decidedAt: now.toISOString(), post: postOf(view) };
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review") {
    const corrected = view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId);
    if (!corrected || (corrected.kind !== "interim" && corrected.kind !== "final")) throw new Error("a correction's or a review's draft names a decision of the case that restricts");
    return {
      ...base,
      kind: draft.kind,
      outcome: draft.kind === "review" ? reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft) : draft.answer === "kept" ? "kept" : reversesAll(view, draft) ? "reversed" : "partly_reversed",
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion,
      legalReference: null,
      facts: null,
      reason: text("review_reason"),
      source: corrected.source,
      measures: [],
      // 3e: a full reversal also overrules the decision's strike, as the params will carry it.
      reversals: [...draft.actions, ...overruleOf(corrected, draft.kind === "review" ? reviewOutcomeOf(view, draft) === "reversed" : reversesAll(view, draft))].map((reversal) => {
        const lifted = corrected.actions.find((action) => liftsOneByOne(action) && sameAction(reversalOf(action), reversal));
        // 3e: the handle a retirement's reversal gives back, which the case answer names on the retirement's row.
        const handle = reversal.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: lifted?.handle ?? null } : {};
        // 3e Task 3: what a lift of a suspension lifts, and where its period stands now, which is the lift's time.
        const lift =
          reversal.kind === "lift_suspension" && lifted
            ? {
                liftedKind: lifted.kind === "terminate" ? ("terminate" as const) : ("suspend" as const),
                liftedDecidedAt: corrected.decidedAt,
                periodThen: periodNow(lifted),
                // Task 4: a withdrawal for another measure, and whether the person had replied to what it withdraws.
                replaced: draft.replaced === true,
                replyFiledAt: lifted.reply?.filedAt ?? null,
              }
            : {};
        // 3e Task 5: what a lift of a reporting measure lifts, and whether a restriction's days still ran.
        const reporting = reversal.kind === "lift_reporting" && lifted ? reportingLiftOf(corrected, lifted, now) : {};
        return { kind: reversal.kind as ReversalKind, mediaId: reversal.mediaId, ...(lifted ? resetFacts(view, corrected, lifted) : NO_RESET), ...handle, ...lift, ...reporting };
      }),
      endedMeasures: [],
      reviewed: { kind: corrected.kind, ground: corrected.ground, ruleId: corrected.ruleId, rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion, legalReference: corrected.legalReference, decidedAt: corrected.decidedAt },
      // Task 4: what an answer to the reply fixes, as far as the page can tell now.
      ...(draft.kind === "correction" ? { repliedTo: repliedToPreview(corrected, draft, now) } : {}),
    };
  }
  const restricts = draft.outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  const reach = view.suspicion?.reach ?? { posts: 0, images: 0 };
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that holds a measure. Those of a decision without one are the
  // case's record, for staff: the statement's data holds neither, here as in the API's own reading of the decision.
  const told = draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  return {
    ...base,
    kind: draft.kind,
    outcome: draft.outcome,
    ground: restricts ? draft.ground : null,
    ruleId: restricts && !law ? draft.ruleId : null,
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    legalReference: law ? text("legal_reference") : null,
    facts: told ? text("facts") : null,
    reason: told ? text("reason") : null,
    source: predictedSource(view, draft.kind),
    measures: draft.actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => {
        const noEffect = noEffectOf(view, action, draft.kind === "final" ? "final" : "interim");
        // 3e Task 4: an announced suspension or termination, or a termination at once.
        if ((action.kind === "suspend" && action.announced === true) || action.kind === "terminate") return previewStanding(view, action, noEffect, now);
        // 3e Task 3: a suspension at once, with its basis, its end and the decision it rests on, as the database will fix them.
        if (action.kind === "suspend") return previewSuspension(view, draft, action, noEffect, now);
        // 3e Task 5: a warning about reporting or a restriction of it, with its end and the warning a restriction follows.
        if (action.kind === "warn_reporting" || action.kind === "restrict_reporting") return previewReporting(view, action, noEffect, now);
        const measure = { kind: action.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, noEffect, sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: reach.posts, images: reach.images, deletedImages: 0 } : null };
        // 3e: a retirement names the snapshot's handle, and the placeholder's form when it changes the profile.
        if (action.kind !== "retire_handle") return measure;
        return { ...measure, handle: snapshotHandle(view) ?? (view.target.type === "account" ? (view.target.handle?.toLowerCase() ?? null) : null), placeholder: noEffect === null ? PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER : null };
      })
      // 3e: the strike the params will carry, until when it counts (decided now) and the strikes that count with it.
      .concat(
        strikeOf(view, draft).map(() => ({
          kind: "strike" as MeasureKind,
          mediaId: null,
          noEffect: null,
          sealed: null,
          endsAt: new Date(now.getTime() + STANDING_RULES.strikeDays * DAY_MS).toISOString(),
          activeThen: ACTIVE_THEN[view.authorStanding?.activeStrikes ?? "0"],
        })),
      ),
    reversals: draft.actions.filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null).map((action) => ({ kind: action.kind as ReversalKind, mediaId: action.mediaId, ...NO_RESET })),
    endedMeasures: endedBy(view, draft),
    reviewed: null,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the params and the confirmation

/** The digest of a snapshot, computed here from the members the page displayed: never the digest the answer carried. */
export function shownSnapshotDigest(snapshot: Extract<CaseSnapshot, { withheld: false }>): Promise<string> {
  return snapshotDigest({
    salt: snapshot.salt,
    targetType: snapshot.targetType,
    targetId: snapshot.targetId,
    takenAt: snapshot.takenAt,
    authorHandle: snapshot.authorHandle,
    postState: snapshot.postState,
    postCreatedAt: snapshot.postCreatedAt,
    replyToId: snapshot.replyToId,
    quoteOfId: snapshot.quoteOfId,
    body: snapshot.body,
    media: snapshot.media,
    displayName: snapshot.displayName,
    bio: snapshot.bio,
    handle: snapshot.handle,
  });
}

/** The digests a decision's params carry: the shown snapshot's, and those of the texts the console saved. */
export interface DecisionDigests {
  snapshot: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
}

/**
 * The params the key confirms, built from what the page shows (3c design, section 7.5, step 1): the case's version, the
 * range a final decision answers, the newest snapshot by its id with the digest the console computed, the digests of the
 * saved texts and the actions in their one order. The contracts' schema refuses what cannot stand before any key is asked.
 */
export function decisionParamsOf(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft, digests: DecisionDigests): CaseDecidedParams {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest) throw new Error("a decision names a snapshot of its case: the case holds none");
  const corrected = draft.kind === "correction" ? view.decisions.find((decided) => decided.id === draft.reviewsDecisionId) : undefined;
  if (draft.kind === "correction" && !corrected) throw new Error("a correction's draft names a decision of the case");
  // 3e: the strike the case answer says is due, and the overruling of a full correction, are the console's to add: the
  // person never chooses either. A kept answer to a reply, and a kept correction that withdraws a decision's marks, lift
  // nothing and overrule nothing. Task 5: a final "No breach" decision signs the marks its person ticked on the items it
  // answers; any other signs none, and a withdrawal of marks signs no list either (the database withdraws them all).
  const kept = draft.answer === "kept" || draft.withdrawMarks === true;
  const added = draft.kind === "correction" ? (kept ? [] : overruleOf(corrected, reversesAll(view, draft))) : strikeOf(view, draft);
  const actions = [...draft.actions, ...added].sort(compareDecisionActions);
  const unfounded = draft.kind === "correction" ? [] : marksOf(view, draft);
  const shared = { stateVersion: view.stateVersion, snapshotId: newest.id, snapshotDigest: digests.snapshot, redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION, actions, unfounded, replaced: draft.kind === "correction" && draft.replaced === true };
  if (draft.kind === "correction" && corrected) {
    return CaseDecidedParams.parse({
      ...shared,
      kind: "correction",
      throughSeq: 0,
      reviewsDecisionId: corrected.id,
      outcome: kept ? "kept" : reversesAll(view, draft) ? "reversed" : "partly_reversed",
      ground: null,
      ruleId: null,
      // A correction carries the rulebook version and the category of the decision it corrects.
      rulesVersion: corrected.rulesVersion,
      category: corrected.category,
      categoryKeyword: null,
      factsDigest: null,
      reasonDigest: digests.reason,
      legalReferenceDigest: null,
    });
  }
  const restricts = draft.outcome === "restricted";
  const law = restricts && draft.ground === "illegal";
  return CaseDecidedParams.parse({
    ...shared,
    kind: draft.kind,
    throughSeq: draft.kind === "final" ? throughSeqOf(view) : 0,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    outcome: draft.outcome,
    ground: restricts ? draft.ground : null,
    ruleId: restricts && !law ? draft.ruleId : null,
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    category: draft.category,
    categoryKeyword: law && draft.terrorist ? "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT" : null,
    // A restriction carries both; a decision without a measure carries each when it was written.
    factsDigest: digests.facts,
    reasonDigest: digests.reason,
    legalReferenceDigest: law ? digests.legalReference : null,
  });
}

/** The texts whose fields a draft's decision has on the page, in the order they are saved. */
export function textsOffered(draft: CaseDraft): DraftTextKind[] {
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review") return ["review_reason"];
  return draft.outcome === "restricted" && draft.ground === "illegal" ? ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference"] : ["facts", "reason"];
}

/**
 * The texts a draft's decision cannot do without. A restriction needs its facts and its reason, and on the law its legal
 * reference; a correction its reason. A decision without a measure may leave both of its texts empty, except an answer to
 * a report or finding of child sexual abuse material: an admin decides it without seeing the images, and says in the
 * facts what the answer rested on.
 */
export function textsRequired(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): DraftTextKind[] {
  if (draft.kind === "correction" || draft.kind === "review" || draft.outcome === "restricted") return textsOffered(draft);
  return suspectOpen(view).length > 0 ? ["facts"] : [];
}

/** Whether a draft holds what its decision needs before anything is sent: something to do, and each text it cannot do without. */
export function complete(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): boolean {
  if (textsRequired(view, draft).some((kind) => normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "")) return false;
  // 3e: a kept answer to a reply lifts nothing; every other correction lifts something.
  if (draft.kind === "correction") return draft.answer === "kept" ? draft.actions.length === 0 : draft.actions.length > 0;
  if (draft.kind === "review") return reviewConsistent(view, draft);
  return draft.outcome !== "restricted" || draft.actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
}

/** What saving one text of a draft came to: the saved text, the console's words for a refusal with its code, or null when there was nothing to save. */
export type TextSaveOutcome = { saved: SavedText } | { error: string; code: string } | null;

/**
 * Saves one text of a draft, without the key (3c design, section 7.4): when its field loses focus, and again at Confirm
 * for a text that is not saved yet. Nothing is sent for an empty text, or for one whose normalised form is the one saved
 * already. A refusal comes back in the console's words; nothing is thrown, and the draft is not touched: what was
 * written stays with the caller, which saves it again at the next occasion.
 */
export async function saveDraftText(deps: { api: StaffApi; random?: RandomBytes }, caseId: CaseId, draft: CaseDraft, kind: DraftTextKind): Promise<TextSaveOutcome> {
  const text = normalised(draft.written[kind]);
  if (text === "" || draft.texts[kind]?.text === text) return null;
  try {
    const saved = await saveStaffText(deps, caseId, kind, draft.written[kind]);
    return { saved: { id: saved.id, text: saved.text, salt: saved.salt, digest: saved.digest } };
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS), code: codeOf(err) ?? "internal" };
  }
}

/** The codes after which the case, or its snapshot, is no longer what the page shows: the refusal's words say to read or to take a snapshot again. */
const STALE_CODES: readonly string[] = ["case_changed", "profile_changed", "snapshot_erased", "snapshot_mismatch"];

/**
 * What the page does about a refused confirmation, beside wording it in place with the draft kept: it reads the case
 * again when the refusal says that the case or its snapshot changed, so that "take a fresh snapshot and decide again" can
 * be followed on the spot; and it forgets which texts it saved when one of them is gone or was used, so that the next
 * Confirm saves them again.
 */
export function afterRefusal(code: string): { readAgain: boolean; saveAgain: boolean } {
  return { readAgain: STALE_CODES.includes(code), saveAgain: code === "text_not_found" };
}

/**
 * The page's words after a decision was recorded: on a final decision, which reports the range left open for later, and
 * how many items arrived since the page read the case, which stay open too.
 */
export function decidedNotice(before: CaseView, now: CaseView, wasFinal: boolean): string {
  const words: string[] = [COMPOSER.recorded];
  if (!wasFinal) return words.join(" ");
  const left = leftOpen(before).length;
  const open = now.items.filter((item) => item.outcome === null).length;
  if (left > 0) words.push(COMPOSER.leftForLater(left));
  if (open > left) words.push(COMPOSER.arrivedSince(open - left));
  // The page showed a decision that closes the case and ends what was done while deciding; an item that arrived meanwhile
  // kept the case open, and with it those measures.
  const staying = left === 0 && open > 0 && now.closedAt === null ? interimInForce(now).map(({ action }) => MEASURES[action.kind].label) : [];
  if (staying.length > 0) words.push(COMPOSER.interimStays(staying.join(", ")));
  return words.join(" ");
}

/** What a confirmation needs of the page that runs it: whether it is still open, what it shows and holds now, the saves of texts on their way, and its busy flag. */
export interface ConfirmingPage {
  alive(): boolean;
  /** The case the page shows, or null when it shows none (a read failed for good). */
  shown(): CaseView | null;
  draft(): CaseDraft | null;
  saving(): readonly Promise<unknown>[];
  setBusy(busy: boolean): void;
}

/**
 * One confirmation with the page's busy flag around it. The flag goes up before anything is awaited and comes down on
 * every way out while the page is still open: when `run` has ended, when it threw, and when the page shows no case or
 * holds no draft any more after the wait, so that the composer is never left switched off. The click that confirms also
 * takes the focus from a text's field: that save ends first, so that its text is not saved twice, and `run` gets the
 * case and the draft as they stand after it.
 */
export async function confirmWhileBusy(page: ConfirmingPage, run: (view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  if (page.shown() === null || page.draft() === null) return;
  page.setBusy(true);
  try {
    await Promise.allSettled(page.saving());
    const [view, draft] = [page.shown(), page.draft()];
    if (!page.alive() || view === null || draft === null) return;
    await run(view, draft);
  } finally {
    if (page.alive()) page.setBusy(false);
  }
}

/**
 * What "Confirm with your staff key" comes to: the case as it now stands; or a fresh snapshot that the page must show
 * before anything is confirmed; or the console's words for the step that failed, with its code, the draft kept.
 */
export type ConfirmOutcome = { view: CaseView } | { fresh: CaseView; notice: string } | { error: string; code: string };

/**
 * The decision as the page runs it (3c design, section 7.5, step 1). `caseId` is the case of the page's address: the
 * texts are saved on it and the key confirms a decision on it, never on whatever case an answer named. In this order:
 *   1. a view of another case than the page's, or a draft that lacks a measure or a text it needs, is not sent at all;
 *   2. when the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown (withheld, erased, or none), a fresh one is taken and the case
 *      read again, and nothing is confirmed: the page shows it first, so no decision names a snapshot nobody was shown;
 *   3. each text that is written is saved, without the key, unless the same text was saved before (when its field lost
 *      focus, or at an earlier try); the digest is the one computed here (saveStaffText refuses an answer that carries
 *      another), and `remember` is told of each save;
 *   4. the snapshot's digest is computed from what the page displayed;
 *   5. the params are built and checked, and the key confirms exactly them; the answer is the case as it now stands. A
 *      review is confirmed as its own action, on the decision whose appeal it answers.
 * Nothing is thrown: a refusal comes back as the console's words for its code.
 */
export async function confirmDecision(
  deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; random?: RandomBytes },
  caseId: CaseId,
  view: CaseView,
  draft: CaseDraft,
  remember: (kind: DraftTextKind, saved: SavedText) => void = () => undefined,
): Promise<ConfirmOutcome> {
  const refusal = (err: unknown): ConfirmOutcome => ({ error: describeError(err), code: codeOf(err) ?? "internal" });
  if (view.id !== caseId) return { error: messageFor("invalid_answer"), code: "invalid_answer" };
  if (!complete(view, draft)) return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };

  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest || newest.withheld) {
    try {
      await deps.api.takeSnapshot(caseId, { activity: true });
      return { fresh: await deps.api.caseView(caseId, { activity: true }), notice: COMPOSER.freshSnapshot };
    } catch (err) {
      return refusal(err);
    }
  }

  const digests: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, string>> = {};
  for (const kind of textsOffered(draft)) {
    const outcome = await saveDraftText(deps, caseId, draft, kind);
    if (outcome !== null && "error" in outcome) return outcome;
    if (outcome !== null) remember(kind, outcome.saved);
    // Saved just now, saved before, or left empty: an empty text has no digest.
    const digest = outcome?.saved.digest ?? (normalised(draft.written[kind]) === "" ? undefined : draft.texts[kind]?.digest);
    if (digest !== undefined) digests[kind] = digest;
  }

  if (draft.kind === "review") {
    // A review is confirmed as the action of its own: on the decision it reviews, with its appeal among the params.
    let reviewed: AppealsReviewedParams;
    try {
      reviewed = reviewParamsOf(view, draft, { snapshot: await shownSnapshotDigest(newest), reason: digests.review_reason ?? null });
    } catch {
      return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };
    }
    try {
      return { view: await reviewWithKey(deps, caseId, draft.reviewsDecisionId ?? "", reviewed) };
    } catch (err) {
      return refusal(err);
    }
  }

  let params: CaseDecidedParams;
  try {
    params = decisionParamsOf(view, draft, {
      snapshot: await shownSnapshotDigest(newest),
      facts: digests.facts ?? null,
      reason: draft.kind === "correction" ? (digests.review_reason ?? null) : (digests.reason ?? null),
      legalReference: digests.legal_reference ?? null,
    });
  } catch {
    return { error: COMPOSER.incomplete, code: "incomplete" };
  }
  try {
    return { view: await decideWithKey(deps, caseId, params) };
  } catch (err) {
    return refusal(err);
  }
}

import { REPLY_AIM_HOURS, RETENTION, STANDING_RULES, type AppealsReviewedParams, type AuthorStanding, type CaseDecision, type ItemOutcome, type ModerationErrorCode, type ReviewerState, type StaffErrorCode } from "@korbat/contracts";

/**
 * The console's own words for every code it can receive (3a design, section 10) and for every outcome it shows (3c
 * design, section 8), one table each. The server's message is never shown: the console words each code from these
 * tables, so a changed or hostile API answer cannot put its own text on the page, and no staff screen ever shows the
 * text of a passkey code, whose remedies are the app's.
 */

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): the two sentences that also word a code of the moderation table, the standing measure that

 */
const STANDING_CONFLICT =
  'Not open: a suspension or termination of this account already stands and has not ended. To change it, lift it first with a correction of its decision. If it is announced and has not started, and an admin must take a measure at once, use "Withdraw it for another measure" on that decision: the person is then told that korbat withdrew it for another measure, not that their reply succeeded.';

 */
export const STANDING_WORDS = {

    suspensionsInYear: {
      "0": `Suspensions decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days: none`,
      "1": `Suspensions decided in the last ${STANDING_RULES.ladderMemoryDays} days: 1`,

/**
 * The moderation codes the console can meet (3c design, sections 8 and 10): those of the case routes, of a decision, of
 * a review, of a finding's link and of a reveal. The codes of the app's own report form, appeal and re-examination never
 * reach the console.
 */
export const CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES = [
  "notice_link_invalid",
  "notice_link_offsite",
  "case_changed",
  "case_closed",
  "staff_recused",
  "staff_target",
  "admin_required",
  "reviewer_conflict",
  "decision_cap",
  "profile_changed",
  "snapshot_mismatch",
  "snapshot_erased",
  "text_invalid",
  "text_quotes_user",
  "text_not_found",
  "invalid_decision",
  "image_refused",
  "reveal_refused",
  // 3e (design, section 8.9): the first three are the ones the composer meets; the other two cannot reach the console
  // today and are worded so that the table has an entry for each code of the type.
  "strike_mismatch",
  "standing_conflict",
  "ground_not_established",
  "reply_not_open",
  "reporting_restricted",
] as const satisfies readonly ModerationErrorCode[];
export type ConsoleModerationCode = (typeof CONSOLE_MODERATION_CODES)[number];

/** The console's words for each of them. A recusal reads the same whether the conflict concerns the author or a reporter. */
export const MODERATION_MESSAGES: Record<ConsoleModerationCode, string> = {
  notice_link_invalid: "That link does not name a post or a profile on korbat.",
  notice_link_offsite: "That link leads to another site. A case is opened only on a post or a profile of this korbat.",
  case_changed: "The case changed since this page read it. Read it again, check it and decide again.",
  case_closed: "The case changed at that moment. Try again.",
  staff_recused:
    "You cannot open or decide this case: an account linked to you takes part in it, or follows, blocks, mutes or replied to someone who does, or the post replies to or quotes a post of an account linked to you. Another staff member must handle it.",
  staff_target: "A final decision cannot restrict a staff account: staff are disciplined by demotion. A measure taken while deciding can.",
  admin_required: "Only an admin can take this decision.",
  reviewer_conflict: "You cannot review this appeal: you made a decision in its case, or opened a finding in it. Another staff member must review it.",
  decision_cap: "You have reached the limit on decisions one staff account may confirm for now. Try again later.",
  profile_changed: "The profile changed since the snapshot was taken. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  snapshot_mismatch: "The snapshot is not the one this case holds. Read the case again.",
  snapshot_erased: "That snapshot was erased under korbat's retention rules. Take a fresh snapshot and decide again.",
  text_invalid: "This text cannot be saved as it is: it is longer than 5000 characters, or holds a control character or an invisible direction or spacing character.",
  text_quotes_user: "This text quotes what someone wrote about this case. Describe it in your own words, never copy it.",
  text_not_found: "A text of this action is not saved any more, or was used already. Save it again.",
  invalid_decision: "This decision cannot stand as it is.",
  image_refused: "That image is not shown.",
  reveal_refused: "Nobody can be revealed for this item: it names no sender, or its sender's name is no longer kept.",
  strike_mismatch: "The strike rule changed for this post since this page read it. Read the case again and decide again.",
  standing_conflict: STANDING_CONFLICT,
  ground_not_established: STANDING_TERMINATE_R2,
  reply_not_open: "This measure takes no reply: it has ended or was lifted.",
  reporting_restricted: "That account's reports under the rules are restricted.",
};

/**
 * Where one code means more on a screen than the shared words say, that screen's words for it, one table for each place
 * (describeError takes the table): which daily limit was reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it
 * was typed into. They stand here with every other word for a refusal, so that no screen keeps a table of its own.
 */

/** The case page's own read: the day's limit on different cases, and an address that names no case. */
export const CASE_WORDS = {
  rate_limited: "You have opened as many different cases as one staff account may in a day. You can open others after midnight UTC; every staff account has been told.",
  not_found: "No case has this address.",
};

/** The reveal, once the key confirmed it: the day's limit on reveals. */
export const REVEAL_WORDS = { rate_limited: "You have revealed as many sources as one staff account may in a day. You can reveal others after midnight UTC." };

/** Saving a text, a note or a reveal's reason alike: the limit of saves a minute. */
export const NOTE_WORDS = { rate_limited: "Too many texts were saved in a minute. Wait a moment and save again." };

/** "Open a case" on the queue screen: a link that names nothing live, the day's limit on findings, and a link that is none. */
export const FINDING_WORDS = {
  not_found: "That link names nothing live on korbat: the post or the account does not exist or was deleted.",
  rate_limited: "You have opened as many findings as one staff account may in a day. You can open others after midnight UTC.",
  invalid_request: "Give a link to a post or a profile on korbat.",
};

/** An item's outcome, as the case page words it once the item is answered. */
export const OUTCOME_WORDS: Record<ItemOutcome, string> = {
  restricted_rule: "restricted under a rule",
  restricted_legal: "restricted as illegal",
  no_violation: "no breach found",
  not_evident: "illegality not evident",
  not_available: "nothing live at the link",
  partly_reversed: "restriction reversed in part",
  reversed: "restriction reversed",
};

/** The four kinds of decision, as the case page and its history name them. */
export const DECISION_KINDS: Record<CaseDecision["kind"], string> = {

  final: "Final decision",
  review: "Review of an appeal",

/** A decision's outcome, as the case page and its history word it. */

/** The three answers a review gives, as the review composer names them. */

  kept: "Keep",
  partly_reversed: "Reverse in part",
  reversed: "Reverse",
};

/**
 * The words beside an appeal, on the appeals screen and on the case page (3c design, section 7.7): whether the reading
 * person may review it, whether its review is an admin's, and whether anyone at korbat may review it now. None of them
 * says who took part in the case or who reported in it.
 */
export const APPEAL_WORDS = {
  mayReview: "You may review it.",
  mayNotReview: "You may not review it: a reviewer made none of the case's decisions, opened no finding in it, and is not close to anyone in it.",
  needsAdmin: "Its review is an admin's.",
  reviewer: {
    available: "A reviewer is available.",
    none_single_staff: "It has no possible reviewer now: korbat has one staff account that could review it, and that one took part in the case.",
    none_eligible: "It has no possible reviewer now: every staff account that could review it took part in the case or is close to someone in it.",
  } satisfies Record<ReviewerState, string>,
  statementOnCase: "What the appellant wrote is read on the case's page.",
  reviewerRule: "Appeals need a reviewer who made none of the case's decisions and opened no finding in it.",
  reviewLabel: "Review this appeal",
  notYours: "This appeal is answered, or is not yours to review.",
} as const;

/** What a decision that lifted the protection of reported images did, as the home screen's list words it. */
export const PROTECTION_LIFTED_WORDS: Record<"unsealed" | "dismissed", string> = {
  unsealed: "Lifted a seal",
  dismissed: "Answered a report of child sexual abuse material without a seal",
};

/** The two kinds of decision the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_KINDS: Record<"interim" | "final", string> = {
  interim: "While deciding",
  final: "Decide the case",
};

/** The three outcomes the composer offers, as it names them. */
export const COMPOSER_OUTCOMES: Record<"restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident", string> = {
  restricted: "Restrict",
  no_violation: "No breach",
  not_evident: "Illegality not evident",
};

/**
 * The composer's sentences beside its texts and its preview. The rule on personal data is the design's sentence in three
 * parts, so that each part is written once: the rule itself, and where the text goes, which differs for a decision
 * without a measure: its author never receives its texts, whether the decision is told to them (it ended what korbat did
 * while deciding) or to nobody. The other three say what the preview cannot show yet, or will not.
 */
export const COMPOSER_WORDS = {
  personalDataRule: 'Write only about the author\'s content and conduct. Never copy another person\'s name, handle, address or other personal data here: describe it (for example "the home address of another person").',
  toAuthor: "The author receives this text by email and keeps it while their account exists.",
  staysInRecord: "The author never receives this text: a decision without a measure tells them at most that what korbat did while deciding has ended. It stays in the case's record, for staff.",
  noStatement: "No statement is sent: this decision restricts nothing and ends nothing that was done while deciding.",
  previewAfterSnapshot: "The preview follows the fresh snapshot: the case's newest snapshot cannot be shown, so Confirm takes a fresh one, shows it, and asks you to confirm again.",
  sealSettled: "The numbers, the sentence about posts their author had deleted, and whether the seal changes anything are settled when the seal is recorded: the statement its author gets holds them as they are then.",
} as const;

/**
 * The shared codes a staff route may also answer, and the console's own: a network failure, an answer its schemas refuse,
 * a browser prompt that did not finish, step-up options that bind something other than the action the person chose, and
 * sign-in or enrolment options whose challenge is not one of that ceremony's.
 */
const OTHER_MESSAGES: Record<string, string> = {
  challenge_expired: "That took too long. Try again.",
  rate_limited: "Too many attempts. Wait a while, then try again.",
  invalid_request: "Some details are missing or invalid.",
  not_found: "That no longer exists.",
  csrf_failed: "This request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.",
  service_unavailable: "That could not be done right now. Try again in a moment.",
  internal: "Something went wrong on the server. Try again.",
  network: "The staff console's server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.",
  invalid_answer: "The server's answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.",
  ceremony_cancelled: "Nothing was signed: the browser's prompt was closed or timed out. Try again.",
  key_already_registered: "This key is already registered for your staff account. Use another key.",
  ceremony_refused: "The browser refused to use a key here. Open the console at exactly the address in CONSOLE_ORIGIN, never at 127.0.0.1, and try again.",
  step_up_mismatch:
    "The confirmation could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than this action, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  signin_mismatch:
    "The sign-in could not be checked: the server asked your key to sign something other than a sign-in, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
  enroll_mismatch:
    "The registration could not be checked: the server asked your key for something other than a staff key's registration, so your key was not asked. Reload the page and try again; if it happens again, tell the operator.",
};

const FALLBACK = "Something went wrong. Try again.";

/** The console's words for a code; a code it does not know, a passkey code included, gets the plain fallback. */
export function messageFor(code: string): string {
  if (Object.hasOwn(STAFF_MESSAGES, code)) return STAFF_MESSAGES[code as StaffErrorCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(MODERATION_MESSAGES, code)) return MODERATION_MESSAGES[code as ConsoleModerationCode];
  if (Object.hasOwn(OTHER_MESSAGES, code)) return OTHER_MESSAGES[code]!;
  return FALLBACK;
}

/** The code of anything a screen's action threw, or null: the console's errors carry one. */
export function codeOf(err: unknown): string | null {
  return err instanceof Error && "code" in err && typeof err.code === "string" ? err.code : null;
}

/**
 * The words for anything a screen's action threw: the console's errors carry a code, anything else is the fallback.
 * `words` gives a screen's own words for a code where the shared ones would say too little: which daily limit was
 * reached, or what a link that names nothing means on the form it was typed into.
 */
export function describeError(err: unknown, words: Record<string, string> = {}): string {
  const code = codeOf(err);
  if (code === null) return FALLBACK;
  return Object.hasOwn(words, code) ? words[code]! : messageFor(code);
}

import {

import { CaseLink } from "../nav";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "../router";
import { revealWithKey } from "../step-up";
import type { DraftSlots } from "../store";
import { normalised, saveStaffText, type RandomBytes } from "../texts";
import { dateTime, Loaded, UserText, type Loadable } from "../ui";
import { categoryLabel, COLLAPSED_RULES, counted, LANE_NAMES, revealable, sourceWords, writtenBy } from "../words";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "../webauthn";
import { AnswerControl, ComposerView, CorrectControl, ReviewControl, WithdrawControl, WithdrawMarksControl, type ComposerViewProps } from "./Composer";

/**
 * The case page (3c design, sections 7.3 and 8): the header, the banners, the evidence with its images, the items with
 * their sources, the decisions with what can still be lifted or corrected, the history, the notes, the reveal of a
 * source, and the decision composer. Every string someone wrote is drawn as text inside a frame that says who wrote it;
 * every address is text, since the console holds no link into the app; and an image is asked of the API only when its
 * person asks to see it.
 */

/** The Art. 18 check, shown above the evidence of every case in the urgent lane, to everyone who opens it. */
export const ART_18_BANNER = `Art. 18: decide now, as soon as you have read this case, whether it suggests a crime that threatens someone's life or safety. If it does, or you are unsure, wake the operator at once, at any hour. Record your check in a note ("Art. 18 check: no suspicion" or "Art. 18 check: operator told at <time>"). Nobody gives this case its final decision before that note exists.`;

/** The sentences of the banner of a case that holds an unanswered suspect item. */
export const SUSPECT_BANNER = {
  nobody: "Nobody opens the images this report concerns, here or in the app.",
  reach: (reach: { images: number; posts: number; sealed: number; served: number }) =>
    `This case reaches ${reach.images} images on ${reach.posts} posts; ${reach.sealed} are sealed and ${reach.served} are still shown to someone. Seal them now, while an admin decides: they are then shown to nobody, their author included.`,
  noImage: "This case reaches no image, so there is nothing to seal.",
  post: "Do not open this post in the app while a report of this kind about it is unanswered or its images are sealed: its page also shows the post it replies to and its replies, whose images this case neither freezes nor seals.",
  account:
    "Do not open this account's profile in the app while a report of this kind about it is unanswered or its images are sealed: the profile also shows posts of other accounts that it reposted or quoted, whose images this case neither freezes nor seals, and images posted since the seal. When this page shows images that are not sealed, seal again.",
  quotes: "This post quotes another, whose images its card shows; korbat opened a case on that post too:",
  added: "korbat added this item: a reported post quotes this one, and its card shows this post's images.",
  earlierTarget: (count: number, lastOn: string) => `An admin answered ${count} earlier reports of this kind about this target without a seal in the last ${SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS} months, the last on ${lastOn}.`,
  opened: (day: string) => `Staff last opened an image of this post in the console on ${day}.`,
  earlierAuthor: (count: number, lastOn: string) => `An admin answered ${count} such reports about this author's profile or posts without a seal in the last ${SUSPECT_EARLIER_MONTHS} months, the last on ${lastOn}.`,
  newest: (day: string) => `The newest post with images this case reaches is of ${day}.`,
};

/** In place of every image of a post whose images cannot be opened now. */
export const IMAGES_NOT_SHOWN =
  "Images of this post are not shown: a report or finding of child sexual abuse material about it or about its author's account is open, or its images are sealed. Decide what turns on an image on the text alone, or wait until an admin has answered that report.";

/** The reveal dialog's four reasons, as its list words them. */
const REVEAL_REASONS: Record<RevealReasonCategory, string> = {
  impersonation_claim: "A claim of impersonation",
  abuse_of_reporting: "Abuse of reporting",
  legal_requirement: "A legal requirement",
  other: "Another reason",
};

/** The frame a revealed name is shown in. */
const REVEALED_LABEL = "Revealed to you; recorded and shown to every staff member";

/** What "Confirm with your staff key" in the reveal dialog comes to: the answer, or the console's words for the step that failed. */
export type RevealOutcome = { answer: RevealResponse } | { error: string };

/**
 * The reveal as the page runs it. The reason is saved first, without the key; the key then confirms the reveal under the
 * digest the console computed from what its person wrote (saveStaffText answers no other), never the text and never a
 * digest an answer carried. The two steps fail apart: a save refused for the minute's limit on saved texts is worded as
 * that, never as the day's limit on reveals.
 */
export async function revealSource(
  deps: { api: StaffApi; credentials: CredentialsLike; random?: RandomBytes },
  caseId: CaseId,
  itemId: string,
  category: RevealReasonCategory,
  reason: string,
): Promise<RevealOutcome> {
  let reasonDigest: string;
  try {
    reasonDigest = (await saveStaffText(deps, caseId, "reveal_reason", reason)).digest;
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, NOTE_WORDS) };
  }
  try {
    return { answer: await revealWithKey(deps, itemId, { reasonCategory: category, reasonDigest }) };
  } catch (err) {
    return { error: describeError(err, REVEAL_WORDS) };
  }
}

/**
 * What a read of the case that failed leaves on the page. Only the first read may put the page into its failed state:
 * there is no case to show then. Once the case was read, a later read that fails (after a snapshot, a note, a reveal or a
 * refused image) keeps the page as it is, the name a reveal has just shown with it, and says why on the page's error
 * line. Either way the words are the console's own for the code.
 */
export function afterFailedRead(current: Loadable<CaseView>, err: unknown): { view: Loadable<CaseView>; error: string | null } {
  const message = describeError(err, CASE_WORDS);
  return current.state === "ready" ? { view: current, error: message } : { view: { state: "failed", message }, error: null };
}

/**
 * The reveal dialog's state: which item, the category once one is chosen (the dialog opens with none: the reason on the
 * record is the person's own choice, never a default), the reason as typed, and the answer once the key confirmed.
 */
export interface RevealState {
  itemId: string;
  category: RevealReasonCategory | null;
  reason: string;
  busy: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  answer: RevealResponse | null;
}

/** Whether the dialog holds what a reveal needs: a chosen category and a reason that says something. The API refuses an empty reason too. */
const revealReady = (reveal: RevealState): boolean => reveal.category !== null && reveal.reason.trim() !== "";

/** The one image the person asked to see: whether clearly, and whether it failed to load (the API refused it, or the request failed). */
export interface ShownImage {
  id: ImageId;
  clear: boolean;
  failed: boolean;
}

export interface CaseScreenViewProps {
  caseId: CaseId;
  view: CaseView;
  /** The one image the person asked to see; null while none is shown. */
  shownImage: ShownImage | null;
  busy: "snapshot" | "note" | null;
  notice: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  note: string;
  reveal: RevealState | null;
  onOpenCase(id: CaseId): void;
  onShowImage(id: ImageId): void;
  onShowClearly(): void;
  onHideImage(): void;
  /** The shown image did not load. */
  onImageError(): void;
  onSnapshot(): void;
  onNoteChange(text: string): void;
  onNoteSave(): void;
  onRevealOpen(itemId: string): void;
  onRevealChange(change: Partial<Pick<RevealState, "category" | "reason">>): void;
  onRevealConfirm(): void;
  onRevealClose(): void;
  /**
   * The decision composer, for the person's role, with "Lift what was done while deciding" and "Correct this decision"
   * beside the decisions. Without it the page shows the case and decides nothing.
   */
  compose?: Omit<ComposerViewProps, "view"> & {
    onCorrect(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onReview(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onAnswer(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    onWithdraw(decision: CaseDecision): void;
    /** 3e Task 5: "Withdraw this decision's marks" beside a "No breach" decision whose marks stand. */
    onWithdrawMarks(decision: CaseDecision): void;
  };
}

/** Whether the target as it stands differs from the case's newest snapshot: then the moderator takes a fresh one before deciding. */
export function targetDiffers(view: CaseView): boolean {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  if (!newest || newest.withheld) return true;
  if (view.target.type === "post") return newest.postState !== view.target.state;
  return newest.handle !== view.target.handle || newest.displayName !== view.target.displayName || newest.bio !== view.target.bio;
}

/**
 * The rule whose texts open collapsed, when an item of the case cites one: its words for the button. Everything the
 * target's author wrote takes it, as copied in a snapshot and as it reads now: the post's text, the alt texts, the

function collapsedLabel(view: CaseView): string | undefined {
  const rule = (["R5", "R3"] as const).find((id) => view.items.some((item) => item.ruleId === id));
  return rule === undefined ? undefined : `Show text (${rule}: ${COLLAPSED_RULES[rule]})`;
}

function SuspectBanner({ view, onOpenCase }: Pick<CaseScreenViewProps, "view" | "onOpenCase">) {
  const { suspicion } = view;
  if (!suspicion?.open) return null;
  const { reach, earlier } = suspicion;
  const quotedCases = [...new Set(view.items.flatMap((item) => (item.quotedCaseId === null ? [] : [item.quotedCaseId])))].flatMap((id) => {
    const checked = parseCaseId(id);
    return checked ? [checked] : [];
  });
  const earlierAny = earlier.target.count > 0 || earlier.author.count > 0;
  return (
    <section className="banner suspect" aria-label="Report of child sexual abuse material">
      <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.nobody}</p>
      <p>{reach.images === 0 ? SUSPECT_BANNER.noImage : SUSPECT_BANNER.reach(reach)}</p>
      <p>{view.target.type === "post" ? SUSPECT_BANNER.post : SUSPECT_BANNER.account}</p>
      {quotedCases.map((id) => (

      {earlier.target.count > 0 && earlier.target.lastOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.earlierTarget(earlier.target.count, earlier.target.lastOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlier.target.count > 0 && earlier.target.imagesOpenedOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.opened(earlier.target.imagesOpenedOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlier.author.count > 0 && earlier.author.lastOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.earlierAuthor(earlier.author.count, earlier.author.lastOn)}</p> : null}
      {earlierAny && reach.newestPostOn !== null ? <p>{SUSPECT_BANNER.newest(reach.newestPostOn)}</p> : null}
    </section>
  );
}

                    <button type="button" onClick={onHideImage}>

        </ul>
      )}

}

function Snapshot({ snapshot, newest, props }: { snapshot: CaseSnapshot; newest: boolean; props: CaseScreenViewProps }) {
  const collapsed = collapsedLabel(props.view);
  return (
    <article className="panel snapshot">
      <h4>
        {newest ? "Newest snapshot, taken " : "Earlier snapshot, taken "}

      ) : snapshot.targetType === "post" ? (
        <>

            {snapshot.postState === null ? "" : `, then ${snapshot.postState.split("_").join(" ")}`}
          </p>
          {snapshot.body === null || snapshot.body === "" ? <p className="quiet">The snapshot holds no text.</p> : <Frame by="Written by the author" text={snapshot.body} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
          {snapshot.replyToId === null ? null : (

              Replies to post <code>{snapshot.replyToId}</code>
            </p>
          )}
          {snapshot.quoteOfId === null ? null : (
            <p>
              Quotes post <code>{snapshot.quoteOfId}</code>
            </p>

          {newest ? (

              collapsed={collapsed}
              shownImage={props.shownImage}

              onShowClearly={props.onShowClearly}
              onHideImage={props.onHideImage}

            />

      ) : (

          </p>
          {snapshot.displayName === null || snapshot.displayName === "" ? <p className="quiet">No display name.</p> : <Frame by="Display name. Written by the author" text={snapshot.displayName} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
          {snapshot.bio === null || snapshot.bio === "" ? <p className="quiet">No bio.</p> : <Frame by="Bio. Written by the author" text={snapshot.bio} collapsedLabel={collapsed} />}
        </>
