```ts
import {
  OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX,
  STANDING_RULES,
  isRetiredPlaceholder,
  type AccountStanding,
  type AtOnceGround,
  type AuthorStanding,
  type CaseStanding,
  type DecisionStanding,
  type ReplyRequest,
  type ReportingStanding,
  type ReplyResponse,
  type StandingLists,
  type StrikeDue,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { isDeadlock, isLockNotAvailable } from "../lib/lock-bounds";
import { ModerationError, isModerationErrorCode, type ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { saltedStatement } from "./intake";
import {
  accountStandingRow,
  boundWaits,
  decisionStanding,
  imagesSealed,
  insertReply,
  finalSettled,
  lockTerminatingDecision,
  noticesUndelivered,
  openReportsIn,
  replyMeasureOf,
  reportingFacts,
  reportingRecords,
  reportingStanding,
  snapshotHandleRetired,
  standingFacts,
  strikeAccounts,
  strikeDueOf,
  terminationsDue,
  terminationsWaiting,
  type StandingFacts,
} from "./standing-repo";
import { raisedMessage, violatedUniqueConstraint, type Runner } from "./repo";

/**
 * Account sanctions as the console reads them on a case (3e design, sections 7.4 and 10.3): on a post case whether a
 * final restriction gives a strike and the author's standing in bands, on an account case the account's standing with
 * what the database would accept now. Every member is an aid that lets a control say why it is greyed before the key is
 * asked; the database decides at the commit.
 */

/**
 * strikeDue of a post case: the database's strike_due for a final restriction on a korbat rule other than R2 that rests
 * on no suspect item, and why it answers false: the post already carries a strike that stands, or it was made before its
 * author was told of their newest strike (strike_due's third and fourth rules).
 */
export async function strikeDue(q: Runner, caseId: string): Promise<StrikeDue> {
  const answer = await strikeDueOf(q, caseId);
  if (answer.due) return { due: true, why: "due" };
  return { due: false, why: answer.struck ? "already_struck" : "before_last_strike" };
}

/** A count as the bands of the author's standing print it. */
const strikesBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["activeStrikes"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : n === 2 ? "2" : "3_or_more");
const suspensionsBand = (n: number): AuthorStanding["suspensionsInYear"] => (n <= 0 ? "0" : n === 1 ? "1" : "2_or_more");

/** What the live standing measure of an account is now, in the words of the bands. */
function nowOf(facts: StandingFacts): AuthorStanding["now"] {
  if (facts.live === null) return "none";
  if (!facts.live.running) return "announced";
  return facts.live.kind === "terminate" ? "terminated" : "suspended";
}

/** authorStanding of a post case: the author's standing in bands, so that the moderator knows what a strike here leads to. */
export async function authorStanding(q: Runner, authorId: string): Promise<AuthorStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, authorId);
  return { activeStrikes: strikesBand(facts.strikes.length), suspensionsInYear: suspensionsBand(facts.suspensionsInYear), now: nowOf(facts) };
}

/**
 * standing of an account case, read as decision_actions_check reads it. The ladder holds with at least ladderStrikes
 * active strikes of which one is newer than the account's newest measure of the ladder that stands; an announced
 * suspension then takes the rung of the suspensions of the ladder decided in the year, and a termination can be announced
 * after as many of them as there are rungs. While a standing measure is live nothing more can be taken (standing_conflict).
 */
export async function caseStanding(q: Runner, caseId: string, accountId: string): Promise<CaseStanding> {
  const facts = await standingFacts(q, accountId);
  const live = facts.live !== null;
  const rungs = STANDING_RULES.ladderDays;
  const ladder = !live && facts.strikes.length >= STANDING_RULES.ladderStrikes && facts.newStrikeSinceLadder;
  const atOnce: AtOnceGround[] = [];
  if (!live) {
    if (facts.threat) atOnce.push("threat");
    if (facts.terrorist) atOnce.push("terrorist");
    if (facts.flood.posts >= STANDING_RULES.floodPosts) atOnce.push("flood");
    if (facts.sealOn !== null) atOnce.push("protective");
    if (facts.threatRepeat) atOnce.push("threat_repeat");
  }
  return {
    activeStrikes: facts.strikes.length,
    strikes: facts.strikes.map((strike) => ({ ...strike, ruleId: strike.ruleId as CaseStanding["strikes"][number]["ruleId"] })),
    ladderRule: facts.ladderRule as CaseStanding["ladderRule"],
    suspensionsInYear: facts.suspensionsInYear,
    lastSuspendedOn: facts.lastSuspendedOn,
    maxDays: ladder ? rungs[Math.min(facts.suspensionsInYear, rungs.length - 1)]! : null,
    mayTerminate: ladder && facts.suspensionsInYear >= rungs.length,
    live,
    openReports: await openReportsIn(q, caseId),
    atOnce,
    flood: facts.flood,
    seal: facts.sealOn === null ? null : { decidedOn: facts.sealOn },
    // Task 2: whether a retirement now would change nothing, the newest snapshot's handle being retired already.
    snapshotHandleRetired: await snapshotHandleRetired(q, caseId),
    // Task 3: the decisions a suspension at once would rest on now, by their times, for the preview's basis sentence.
    basisDecidedAt: facts.basisDecidedAt,
    // Task 5: the account's record of reporting, read as decision_actions_check reads it.
    reporting: await caseReporting(q, accountId),
  };
}

/**
 * standing.reporting of an account case (3e design, sections 7.9, 8.1 and 10.3): the account's counts in reports, its
 * warning that still counts with the marked reports sent since, whether the database would accept a warning or a
 * restriction now, the restriction that runs, and the marks that count for the drafts of W.5. A warning needs at least
 * reportWarnMarks marked reports that are at least reportWarnShare of the reports, and no warning that still counts; a
 * restriction needs that warning, at least reportRestrictMarks marked reports sent since korbat told the account of it,
 * and no restriction running. The case's own open reports, which refuse both (open_reports), are `openReports`.
 */
async function caseReporting(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<CaseStanding["reporting"]> {
  const facts = await reportingFacts(q, accountId, { marked: true });
  const atThreshold = facts.unfounded >= STANDING_RULES.reportWarnMarks && facts.unfounded >= STANDING_RULES.reportWarnShare * facts.reports;
  return {
    reports: facts.reports,
    unfounded: facts.unfounded,
    warnedOn: facts.warning === null ? null : facts.warning.decidedAt.slice(0, 10),
    warnedAt: facts.warning?.decidedAt ?? null,
    marksSince: facts.marksSince,
    mayWarn: atThreshold && facts.warning === null,
    mayRestrict: facts.warning !== null && (facts.marksSince ?? 0) >= STANDING_RULES.reportRestrictMarks && facts.restriction === null,
    restrictedUntil: facts.restriction?.until ?? null,
    marked: facts.marked,
  };
}

/**
 * /api/me's standing (3e design, sections 7.12 and 10.2), read fresh at the request and never kept in a session or a
 * cache, so the banner and a refusal's sentence are true of the row: the active strikes; the account's one standing
 * measure with its state now (running from its start; announced once a start is fixed and ahead; held while a reply sent
 * in time waits for its answer; unfixed while the notice mail's outcome is unknown), its times, its reply and its appeal;
 * the reporting measures (Task 5: the warning that still counts and the restriction that runs, null when neither
 * stands); whether the profile holds a retired handle's placeholder. Null for an account without a live profile. Not
 * auth.account_standing, the boolean grant-role asks.
 */
export async function standingFor(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<AccountStanding | null> {
  const row = await accountStandingRow(q, accountId);
  if (row === null) return null;
  const m = row.measure;
  return {
    activeStrikes: row.activeStrikes,
    measure:
      m === null
        ? null
        : {
            decisionId: m.decisionId,
            kind: m.kind,
            days: m.kind === "terminate" ? null : m.days,
            state: m.running ? "running" : m.startsAt !== null ? "announced" : m.reply?.onTime && !m.replyAnswered ? "held" : "unfixed",
            earliestStart: m.earliestStart,
            startsAt: m.startsAt,
            endsAt: m.kind === "terminate" ? null : m.endsAt,
            reply: m.reply,
            // One reply a measure (POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/reply); a measure in standing_live takes one.
            replyOpen: m.reply === null,
            // Open while no appeal was filed and its six months run; one filed (pending or answered) closes it.
            appealUntil: !m.appealed && m.appealOpen ? m.appealDeadline : null,
            appealPending: m.appealPending,
          },
    reporting: await accountReporting(q, accountId),
    handleRetired: isRetiredPlaceholder(row.handle.toLowerCase()),
  };
}

/** /api/me's reporting member: the warning that still counts and the restriction that runs, or null when neither stands. */
async function accountReporting(q: Runner, accountId: string): Promise<AccountStanding["reporting"]> {
  const facts = await reportingFacts(q, accountId, { marked: false });
  if (facts.warning === null && facts.restriction === null) return null;
  return {
    warning: facts.warning === null ? null : { decisionId: facts.warning.decisionId, countsUntil: facts.warning.countsUntil },
    restriction: facts.restriction,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3e Task 4: the reply, the lists and the take-down

/** The longest the reply's transaction waits for a lock: its own profile row, which a decision about the account may hold. */
const REPLY_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;
/** How often the reply's transaction is run again after a deadlock or a lock timeout: in each nothing was written. */
const REPLY_RETRIES = 2;

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/reply (3e design, section 7.6 step 9): the person's one reply to the suspension or
 * termination the decision holds, announced or taken at once. Not found unless the viewer is the measure's subject and
 * was told of the decision, as for the decision's read. One transaction: the account's own profile row FOR UPDATE, its
 * first lock (every writer of a start holds that row, so from there only the clock can bring the start), then the reply's
 * row, whose trigger refuses a reply that is not open and forces the time of filing by the clock, read last, and whether
 * it came before the start, which it then holds until a decision answers it. A second reply is reply_not_open, whether
 * the trigger or the primary key finds it. A deadlock or a lock timeout runs the transaction again; when the last run
 * fails the same way the answer is service_unavailable. No mail goes for the reply itself.
 */
export async function fileReply(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "social">, viewer: string, decisionId: string, request: ReplyRequest): Promise<ReplyResponse> {
  const actionId = await replyMeasureOf(deps.apiDb, viewer, decisionId);
  if (actionId === null) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  const statement = await saltedStatement(request.statement);
  for (let attempt = 0; ; attempt++) {
    try {
      return await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await boundWaits(tx, REPLY_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS);
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [viewer], "update");
        return insertReply(tx, { actionId, accountId: viewer, statement });
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
      if (refusal !== null && isModerationErrorCode(refusal)) throw new ModerationError(refusal);
      if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) !== null) throw new ModerationError("reply_not_open");
      if (!isDeadlock(err) && !isLockNotAvailable(err)) throw err;
      if (attempt >= REPLY_RETRIES) throw new ModerationError("service_unavailable", 503, undefined, 30);
    }
  }
}

/** The states in which a standing measure takes a reply: it stands, its basis holds, and it has not ended. */
const OPEN_STATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(["unfixed", "announced", "held", "running"]);

/**
 * DecisionView.standing (3e design, sections 9.2 and 10.2): where the decision's suspension or termination stands now,
 * read fresh; null for a decision without one. A reply can still be sent while none was and the measure takes one.
 */
export async function decisionStandingView(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<DecisionStanding | null> {
  const row = await decisionStanding(q, decisionId);
  if (row === null) return null;
  return {
    state: row.state as DecisionStanding["state"],
    earliestStart: row.earliestStart,
    startsAt: row.startsAt,
    endsAt: row.endsAt,
    endedAt: row.endedAt,
    endedBy: row.endedBy,
    replaced: row.replaced,
    restsOn: row.restsOn.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, ruleId: entry.ruleId as DecisionStanding["restsOn"][number]["ruleId"] })),
    reply: row.reply,
    replyOpen: row.reply === null && OPEN_STATES.has(row.state),
  };
}

/**
 * GET /api/staff/standing (3e design, sections 7.5, 7.12 and 8.6): the Standing screen's four lists. The accounts at the
 * ladder's number of strikes, each with the rung an announced suspension would take now (the ladder's suspensions of the
 * year, read as decision_actions_check reads them) and whether a termination could be announced; the reporting records
 * (Task 5: the accounts at the warning's threshold and the warned ones, in reports); the notices korbat could not send;
 * and the terminations that wait. People are handles; no row names a reporter.
 */
export async function standingLists(q: Runner): Promise<StandingLists> {
  const rungs = STANDING_RULES.ladderDays;
  const atThree = await strikeAccounts(q, OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX);
  return {
    atThreeStrikes: {
      total: atThree.total,
      items: atThree.items.map((row) => ({
        handle: row.handle,
        caseId: row.caseId,
        activeStrikes: row.activeStrikes,
        ruleId: row.ruleId as StandingLists["atThreeStrikes"]["items"][number]["ruleId"],
        newestOn: row.newestOn,
        maxDays: rungs[Math.min(row.inYear, rungs.length - 1)]!,
        mayTerminate: row.inYear >= rungs.length,
      })),
    },
    reportingRecords: await reportingRecords(q, OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX),
    noticesUndelivered: await noticesUndelivered(q, OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX),
    terminationsWaiting: await terminationsWaiting(q, OVERVIEW_LIST_MAX),
  };
}

/**
 * DecisionView.reportingStanding (3e design, sections 9.2 and 10.2): where the decision's restriction of reporting stands
 * now, read fresh; null for a decision without one.
 */
export async function reportingStandingView(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<ReportingStanding | null> {
  return reportingStanding(q, decisionId);
}

/** The longest the take-down's transaction waits for a lock: the account's profile, then its terminating decision. */
const TAKE_DOWN_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** How long a decision must have been final before its account is taken down: an appeal in flight at the deadline has settled by then. */
export const TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS = 60_000;

/** The take-down the account module hands over: the auth module's system take-down, true only for one it made. */
export type TakeDown = (account: string, facts: { decidedAt: Date; imagesSealed: boolean }) => Promise<boolean>;

/**
 * ModerationForAccount.takeDownDue (3e design, section 5, the lock order, item 5, and section 7.8 step 3): the take-down of
 * every account whose termination is final for its author. It reads terminations_due() once, unlocked, for the candidates.
 * Then for each, in a transaction of its own on the API's pool and in a try of its own: the account's profile FOR UPDATE
 * (lockAccounts); then the terminating decision's row FOR UPDATE (lockTerminatingDecision says why the decision's row and
 * not its case: an appeal being filed takes no profile, and meets this lock through its foreign key, so it commits first
 * and is read below, or waits until the take-down has committed); terminations_due() again for that account, in a
 * statement of its own, and that its decision became final at least TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS ago, so that an appeal whose
 * deadline check passed an instant before the deadline has settled; and only when it is still due, whether a seal of its
 * images is in force, and then the callback, awaited while the transaction is open, so the profile is held until the
 * take-down has committed on the auth pool. A lift, a reply or a kept answer waits at the profile, or committed first and
 * took the account out of the list.
 *
 * A failure for one account (a lock wait past its bound, the auth pool down) is caught, logged with the terminating
 * decision's case and never the account, and counted in `failed`; it never stops the next account. `terminated` counts
 * the take-downs the callback made: one already made (a round whose purge failed after it) answers false.
 */
export async function takeDownDue(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "social" | "log">, takeDown: TakeDown): Promise<{ terminated: number; failed: number }> {
  const report = { terminated: 0, failed: 0 };
  for (const candidate of await terminationsDue(deps.apiDb)) {
    try {
      const made = await deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await boundWaits(tx, TAKE_DOWN_LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS);
        await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [candidate.accountId], "update");
        const decisionId = await lockTerminatingDecision(tx, candidate.accountId, candidate.caseId);
        if (decisionId === null) return false;
        const [still] = await terminationsDue(tx, candidate.accountId);
        if (!still || !(await finalSettled(tx, decisionId, TAKE_DOWN_SETTLE_MS))) return false;
        const sealed = await imagesSealed(tx, candidate.accountId);
        return takeDown(candidate.accountId, { decidedAt: new Date(still.decidedAt), imagesSealed: sealed });
      });
      if (made) report.terminated++;
    } catch (err) {
      report.failed++;
      deps.log.error({ err, caseId: candidate.caseId }, "moderation: a terminated account could not be taken down; it is tried again next round");
    }
  }
  return report;
}
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ActionKind } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { iso, rows, type Runner, type TargetType } from "./repo";

/** An instant as JavaScript writes it, or null for an infinite one (a termination's end). The expression is written here, never input. */
const finite = (expression: string) => sql`case when isfinite(${sql.raw(expression)}) then ${iso(expression)} end`;

/**
 * The queries a statement of reasons is read from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10): the decision with its texts and the
 * decision it is about, its ledger rows, and the measures taken while deciding that ended with it. Every surface an
 * author reads a statement on (the decision's screen, the mail, the export, the answer to an appeal) is rendered from
 * these, so they are kept apart from the module's other queries: a test refuses the names of the tables of reports and
 * notices in this file, but for one pinned read in endedMeasures, which answers true or false of the case's own items.
 */

/** A decision as its statement is rendered from it, with what the mail and the staff alerts need beside it. */
export interface StatementDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  caseId: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  ground: string | null;
  ruleId: string | null;
  rulesVersion: number;
  redressVersion: number;
  source: string;
  decidedAt: string;
  suspect: boolean;
  authorMail: string;
  decidedBy: string;
  facts: string | null;
  reason: string | null;
  legalReference: string | null;
  targetType: TargetType;
  targetId: string;
  /** The post's creation time, which survives its deletion; null for an account case. */
  postCreatedAt: string | null;
  /** The account the decision is about: the post's author, or the account itself. */
  subjectId: string | null;
  /** The decision a review or a correction is about. */
  reviewed: { kind: "interim" | "final"; ground: string | null; ruleId: string | null; rulesVersion: number; legalReference: string | null; decidedAt: string } | null;
}

export async function statementDecision(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementDecisionRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.case_id, d.kind, d.outcome, d.ground, d.rule_id, d.rules_version, d.redress_version, d.source, ${iso("d.decided_at")} as decided_at, d.suspect, d.author_mail, d.decided_by,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal_reference,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               case when c.target_type = 'post' then (select p.author_id from posts p where p.id = c.target_id) else c.target_id end as subject_id,
               r.kind as reviewed_kind, r.ground as reviewed_ground, r.rule_id as reviewed_rule, r.rules_version as reviewed_rules_version, ${iso("r.decided_at")} as reviewed_at,
               (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = r.legal_reference_digest) as reviewed_legal
          from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id left join decisions r on r.id = d.reviews_decision_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    id: row.id as string,
    caseId: row.case_id as string,
    kind: row.kind as StatementDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    ground: row.ground as string | null,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    rulesVersion: row.rules_version as number,
    redressVersion: row.redress_version as number,
    source: row.source as string,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at as string,
    suspect: row.suspect as boolean,
    authorMail: row.author_mail as string,
    decidedBy: row.decided_by as string,
    facts: row.facts as string | null,
    reason: row.reason as string | null,
    legalReference: row.legal_reference as string | null,
    targetType: row.target_type as TargetType,
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at as string | null,
    subjectId: row.subject_id as string | null,
    reviewed:
      row.reviewed_kind === null
        ? null
        : { kind: row.reviewed_kind as "interim" | "final", ground: row.reviewed_ground as string | null, ruleId: row.reviewed_rule as string | null, rulesVersion: row.reviewed_rules_version as number, legalReference: row.reviewed_legal as string | null, decidedAt: row.reviewed_at as string },
  };
}

/** One ledger row of a decision as its statement tells of it: for a reversal the measure it lifts, for a seal what its list held. */
export interface StatementActionRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  noEffect: "already" | "deleted" | null;
  /** For a reversal: the decision that holds the lifted measure, its rule, whether that measure changed anything, and whether korbat still kept that decision's snapshot when this one was made. */
  lifted: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean } | null;
  sealedPosts: number;
  sealedImages: number;
  /** The seal's images on posts their author had deleted by the time it was recorded: nothing later is read. */
  sealedDeletedImages: number;
  /** A strike's end of counting, and the strikes of its account that stood and counted at its decision's time, this one included. */
  endsAt: string | null;
  activeThen: number | null;
  /** On a suspension or a termination: whether it was announced; null on every other kind. */
  announced: boolean | null;
  /**
   * On a retirement, the handle of its decision's snapshot in lower case, as the database retires it; on a reversal of one,
   * the same of the lifted decision. A snapshot keeps its handle through an erasure (3e design, section 6.7). Null otherwise.
   */
  handle: string | null;
  /** On a retirement that changed the profile, the placeholder it gave, made from the measure's id as the database makes it. */
  placeholder: string | null;
  /**
   * 3e (design, section 10.2), on a standing measure: its days, its basis, its earliest start (the row's starts_at), and
   * one entry for each decision it rests on (its time, its rule and the time of its post; for a protective suspension
   * the sealing decision's time alone). A measure taken at once also ends: `endsAt` is its created_at plus its days.
   */
  days: number | null;
  basis: string | null;
  earliestStart: string | null;
  restsOn: { decidedAt: string; ruleId: string | null; postCreatedAt: string | null }[] | null;
  /**
   * 3e, on the lift of a suspension or a termination: the lifted measure's kind and decision's time, where its period
   * stood at this decision's time (by suspension_periods, whose end a lift cuts to the lift's time), and whether the lift
   * was signed `replaced`.
   */
  liftedKind: "suspend" | "terminate" | "warn_reporting" | "restrict_reporting" | null;
  liftedDecidedAt: string | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null } | null;
  replaced: boolean | null;
  /** 3e Task 4, on such a lift: when the person had replied to the lifted measure, or null when they had not. */
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
  /** 3e Task 5, on a restriction of reporting: the time of the warning it follows (its decision's). */
  warnedAt: string | null;
}

/** A decision's measures and reversals, in the ledger's order of kinds. */
export async function statementActions(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<StatementActionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, a.no_effect, l.decision_id as lifted_decision, ld.rule_id as lifted_rule, l.no_effect as lifted_no_effect,
               (ls.erased_at is null or ls.erased_at > d.decided_at) as lifted_snapshot_kept,
               (select count(*)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_posts,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s where s.action_id = a.id) as sealed_images,
               (select coalesce(sum(s.images), 0)::int from seal_posts s join posts p on p.id = s.post_id
                 where s.action_id = a.id and p.state = 'deleted_by_author' and p.deleted_at <= a.created_at) as sealed_deleted,
               case when a.kind in ('strike', 'warn_reporting') then ${iso("a.ends_at")}
                    when a.kind = 'suspend' and a.announced is false then ${iso("(a.created_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")}
                    when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then ${iso("(a.starts_at + make_interval(days => a.days))")} end as ends_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') then a.days end as days,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'warn_reporting', 'restrict_reporting') then a.basis end as basis,
               -- 3e Task 5: the warning a restriction of reporting follows, by its decision's time (the one entry of rests_on).
               case when a.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then (select ${iso("x.decided_at")} from decisions x where x.id = a.rests_on[1]) end as warned_at,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then ${iso("a.starts_at")} end as earliest_start,
               -- The decisions a standing measure rests on, in the ledger's order: what korbat fixed for good about each.
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') and a.rests_on is not null then (
                 select json_agg(json_build_object('decidedAt', ${iso("x.decided_at")},
                                                   'ruleId', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else x.rule_id end,
                                                   'postCreatedAt', case when a.basis = 'protective' then null else ${iso("xp.created_at")} end) order by u.ord)
                   from unnest(a.rests_on) with ordinality as u(id, ord)
                   join decisions x on x.id = u.id
                   join cases xc on xc.id = x.case_id
                   left join posts xp on xc.target_type = 'post' and xp.id = xc.target_id) end as rests_on,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then l.kind::text end as lifted_kind,
               case when a.kind in ('lift_suspension', 'lift_reporting') then ${iso("ld.decided_at")} end as lifted_decided_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then a.replaced end as replaced,
               -- Whether the person had replied to the lifted measure before this lift: a withdrawal then says it is no answer to it.
               case when a.kind = 'lift_suspension' then (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = l.id and r.filed_at <= a.created_at) end as reply_filed_at,
               -- Where the lifted measure's period stood at this lift's time: the lift cuts its end to that time, so a period
               -- that ends before it had already ended, and one with no start, or a start not before it, never started.
               ${iso("lp.starts_at")} as lifted_started_at, ${finite("lp.ends_at")} as lifted_ended_at,
               case when a.kind = 'lift_reporting' and l.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                      then case when l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days) <= a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                    when a.kind <> 'lift_suspension' then null
                    when lp.starts_at is null or lp.starts_at >= a.created_at then 'not_started'
                    when lp.ends_at < a.created_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as lifted_state,
               -- 3e Task 5: a lifted restriction of reporting started with its decision and ran its days, unless lifted first.
               ${iso("l.starts_at")} as lifted_restriction_started_at, ${iso("(l.starts_at + make_interval(days => l.days))")} as lifted_restriction_ends_at,
               -- What the ledger held at the decision's time, never later: a strike that counted then, and was not overruled by then.
               case when a.kind = 'strike' then (select count(*)::int from decision_actions s
                     where s.subject_account_id = a.subject_account_id and s.kind = 'strike' and s.created_at <= a.created_at and s.ends_at > a.created_at
                       and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = s.id and r.created_at <= a.created_at)) end as active_then,
               case when a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate') then a.announced end as announced,
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' then (select lower(s.handle) from evidence_snapshots s where s.id = d.snapshot_id)
                    when a.kind = 'unretire_handle' then lower(ls.handle) end as handle,
               -- The placeholder exactly as decision_actions_apply computes it, for a retirement that wrote it.
               case when a.kind = 'retire_handle' and a.no_effect is null
                    then 'retired_' || substr(encode(sha256(convert_to(a.id::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1, 12) end as placeholder
          from decision_actions a join decisions d on d.id = a.decision_id
          left join decision_actions l on l.id = a.reverses_action_id
          left join decisions ld on ld.id = l.decision_id
          left join evidence_snapshots ls on ls.id = ld.snapshot_id
          left join suspension_periods lp on a.kind = 'lift_suspension' and lp.action_id = l.id
         where a.decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid order by a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind as ActionKind,
    mediaId: row.media_id as string | null,
    noEffect: row.no_effect as StatementActionRow["noEffect"],
    lifted: row.lifted_decision === null ? null : { decisionId: row.lifted_decision as string, ruleId: row.lifted_rule as string | null, noEffect: row.lifted_no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.lifted_snapshot_kept as boolean },
    sealedPosts: row.sealed_posts as number,
    sealedImages: row.sealed_images as number,
    sealedDeletedImages: row.sealed_deleted as number,
    endsAt: row.ends_at as string | null,
    activeThen: row.active_then as number | null,
    announced: row.announced as boolean | null,
    handle: row.handle as string | null,
    placeholder: row.placeholder as string | null,
    days: row.days as number | null,
    basis: row.basis as string | null,
    earliestStart: row.earliest_start as string | null,
    restsOn: row.rests_on as StatementActionRow["restsOn"],
    liftedKind: row.lifted_kind as StatementActionRow["liftedKind"],
    liftedDecidedAt: row.lifted_decided_at as string | null,
    periodThen:
      row.lifted_state === null
        ? null
        : row.kind === "lift_reporting"
          ? {
              // A restriction of reporting starts with its decision: it ran, or had run its days, when it was lifted.
              state: row.lifted_state as "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_restriction_started_at as string | null,
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_restriction_ends_at as string | null) : null,
            }
          : {
              state: row.lifted_state as "not_started" | "running" | "ended",
              startedAt: row.lifted_state === "not_started" ? null : (row.lifted_started_at as string | null),
              endedAt: row.lifted_state === "ended" ? (row.lifted_ended_at as string | null) : null,
            },
    replaced: row.replaced as boolean | null,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at as string | null,
    warnedAt: row.warned_at as string | null,
  }));
}

/** A measure taken while deciding that ended with a final decision, without a reversal. */
export interface EndedMeasureRow {
  kind: ActionKind;
  mediaId: string | null;
  decisionId: string;
  ruleId: string | null;
  noEffect: string | null;
  snapshotKept: boolean;
}

/**
 * The measures taken while deciding that ended with this final decision, of those their author was told of: every one
 * that was still in force when the decision closed its case, and a seal taken while deciding whose suspect items the
 * decision answered, unless the decision itself seals (the images then stay sealed). It reads only what stood when the
 * decision was made: a reversal recorded later, or an item that arrived later, changes nothing here.
 */
export async function endedMeasures(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedMeasureRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select a.kind, a.media_id, i.id as decision_id, i.rule_id, a.no_effect, (s.erased_at is null or s.erased_at > d.decided_at) as snapshot_kept
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join decisions i on i.case_id = d.case_id and i.kind = 'interim' and i.decided_at < d.decided_at and i.author_mail <> 'none'
          join decision_actions a on a.decision_id = i.id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = i.snapshot_id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind = 'final'
           and a.kind in ('withhold', 'seal_media', 'withhold_media', 'reset_display_name', 'reset_bio')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id and r.created_at <= d.decided_at)
           and case when a.kind = 'seal_media'
                 then exists (select 1 from intake_items x where x.case_id = d.case_id and x.suspect and x.answered_by = d.id and x.created_at <= i.decided_at)
                      and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions own where own.decision_id = d.id and own.kind = 'seal_media')
                 else c.closed_at = d.decided_at end
         order by i.decided_at, a.kind, a.media_id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind as ActionKind, mediaId: row.media_id as string | null, decisionId: row.decision_id as string, ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null, noEffect: row.no_effect as string | null, snapshotKept: row.snapshot_kept as boolean }));
}

/** A standing measure, or a restriction of reporting, whose basis a reversal of a decision broke (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.2). */
export interface EndedStandingRow {
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate" | "restrict_reporting";
  decidedAt: string;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  seal: boolean;
  replyFiledAt: string | null;
}

/**
 * The suspensions and terminations whose basis this review or correction broke: those that name the reviewed decision in
 * rests_on and whose basis broke at this decision's time (standing_basis_broken_at answers the time of the reversal that
 * broke it, which is this decision's own). For each, where its period stood at this decision's time (the break cut its
 * end to that time), whether the basis was a seal, and the time of its reply when this decision answered it. Task 5:
 * the restrictions of reporting whose warning this decision lifted, unless a lift of their own came first; a restriction
 * starts with its decision, so it was running, or had run its days (ended), at this decision's time.
 */
export async function endedStanding(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<EndedStandingRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ kind: EndedStandingRow["kind"]; decided_at: string; state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; started_at: string | null; ended_at: string | null; seal: boolean; reply_filed_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select m.kind::text as kind, ${iso("md.decided_at")} as decided_at, t.state,
               ${iso("t.started_at")} as started_at, ${finite("t.ended_at")} as ended_at,
               m.basis = 'protective' as seal,
               (select ${iso("r.filed_at")} from suspension_replies r where r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id) as reply_filed_at
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') and d.reviews_decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
          join decisions md on md.id = m.decision_id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting'
                        then case when m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) <= d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end
                        when p.starts_at is null or p.starts_at >= d.decided_at then 'not_started'
                        when p.ends_at < d.decided_at then 'ended' else 'running' end as state,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at else p.starts_at end as started_at,
                   case when m.kind = 'restrict_reporting' then m.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days) else p.ends_at end as ended_at
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) = d.decided_at
           and (m.kind <> 'restrict_reporting' or not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id and x.created_at < d.decided_at))
         order by md.decided_at, m.id`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    kind: row.kind,
    decidedAt: row.decided_at,
    periodThen: { state: row.state, startedAt: row.state === "not_started" ? null : row.started_at, endedAt: row.state === "ended" ? row.ended_at : null },
    seal: row.seal,
    replyFiledAt: row.reply_filed_at,
  }));
}

/** The reply a correction or a review answered by keeping or reversing its measure (3e design, section 10.2). */
export interface RepliedToRow {
  filedAt: string;
  onTime: boolean;
  kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
  days: number | null;
  periodThen: { state: "not_started" | "running" | "ended"; startedAt: string | null; endedAt: string | null };
  startsAt: string | null;
  endsAt: string | null;
  appealUntil: string;
}

/**
 * The reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing the measure of the decision it is about: a reply
 * to a suspension or a termination of that decision whose answering decision is this one. Never a withdrawal signed
 * `replaced` (it is no answer on the reply's merits), and never the end of a broken basis (that measure is not the
 * reviewed decision's: its reply is the reversal's endedStanding). Null when there is none.
 *
 * Each member is what the ledger fixed by this answer's time, so the statement reads as it was sent. The start: after a
 * kept answer to a reply before the start, the later of the answer and the earliest start, which nothing later moves; for
 * any other answer the period's own start, already fixed before the reply (a late reply) or never (a reversed one before
 * the start, which has no row). The end: a kept suspension's start plus its days; a reversed one's period end, which this
 * lift cut; null for a termination and for a measure that never starts. Where the period stood at this answer's time, by
 * those two. And the last moment of the announcing decision's appeal after this answer (appeal_informed_at).
 */
export async function repliedTo(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<RepliedToRow | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{
    filed_at: string;
    on_time: boolean;
    kind: "suspend" | "terminate";
    days: number | null;
    kept: boolean;
    starts_at: string | null;
    ends_at: string | null;
    started: boolean;
    ended: boolean;
    appeal_until: string;
  }>(
    q,
    sql`select ${iso("r.filed_at")} as filed_at, r.on_time, m.kind::text as kind, m.days, t.kept,
               ${iso("t.starts_at")} as starts_at, ${finite("t.ends_at")} as ends_at,
               coalesce(t.starts_at <= d.decided_at, false) as started, coalesce(t.ends_at <= d.decided_at, false) as ended,
               ${iso("public.appeal_deadline(public.appeal_informed_at(m.decision_id))")} as appeal_until
          from decisions d
          join decision_actions m on m.decision_id = d.reviews_decision_id and m.kind::text in ('suspend', 'terminate')
          join suspension_replies r on r.action_id = m.id and r.answered_by = d.id
          left join suspension_periods p on p.action_id = m.id
          cross join lateral (
            select x.kept,
                   case when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) else p.starts_at end as starts_at,
                   case when m.kind::text = 'terminate' then null
                        when x.kept and r.on_time then greatest(m.starts_at, r.answered_at) + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        when x.kept then p.starts_at + make_interval(days => m.days)
                        else p.ends_at end as ends_at
              from (select not exists (select 1 from decision_actions l where l.decision_id = d.id and l.reverses_action_id = m.id) as kept) x
          ) t
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and d.kind in ('review', 'correction')
           and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions w where w.decision_id = d.id and w.kind = 'lift_suspension' and w.replaced)`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  const state: RepliedToRow["periodThen"]["state"] = !row.started ? "not_started" : row.ended ? "ended" : "running";
  return {
    filedAt: row.filed_at,
    onTime: row.on_time,
    kind: row.kind,
    days: row.kind === "terminate" ? null : row.days,
    periodThen: { state, startedAt: state === "not_started" ? null : row.starts_at, endedAt: state === "ended" ? row.ends_at : null },
    startsAt: row.starts_at,
    endsAt: row.ends_at,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until,
  };
}
```

```ts
import { MEASURES, type DecisionStatement, type MeasureKind, type ReversalKind, type RuleId, type StandingBasis } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { statementParagraphs } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { DecisionMessage } from "../auth";
import type { ModerationDeps } from "./context";
import { beginMailRecord, lockPendingAuthorMail, recordAuthorMail, type MailState } from "./repo";
import { endedMeasures, endedStanding, repliedTo, statementActions, statementDecision, type StatementDecisionRow } from "./statement-repo";

/**
 * The data a statement of reasons and its mail are rendered from (3c design, sections 7.5 and 10). A decision is the
 * statement: every element is a column, a ledger row or a saved text, read here into the one shape that @korbat/rules
 * renders for the mail, the author's screen and the console's preview. Nothing read here is changed by a later event, so
 * a statement reads as it was sent whenever it is rendered.
 */

/** A decision's statement with what mailing it needs: whom it is about, and whether its mail is still owed. */
export interface StatementFound {
  statement: DecisionStatement;
  decision: StatementDecisionRow;
}

/** Whether a field reset's old value was still kept when the decision that ends or lifts it was made, and where it can be read. */
function resetFacts(kind: MeasureKind | ReversalKind, held: { decisionId: string; ruleId: string | null; noEffect: string | null; snapshotKept: boolean }) {
  const target = MEASURES[kind].target;
  if (target !== "display_name" && target !== "bio") return { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null };
  // The reset's own snapshot holds the old value, by its compare-and-set; a reset that changed nothing removed none.
  return { resetDecisionId: held.decisionId, oldValueKept: held.noEffect === null && held.snapshotKept, resetRuleId: held.ruleId as RuleId | null };
}

/** The statement's data of one decision, or null when no decision has the id. */
export async function decisionStatement(q: ModerationDeps["apiDb"], decisionId: string): Promise<StatementFound | null> {
  const decision = await statementDecision(q, decisionId);
  if (!decision) return null;
  const actions = await statementActions(q, decisionId);
  const ended = decision.kind === "final" ? await endedMeasures(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e: the standing measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke; absent from a statement that holds none.
  const brokenBasis = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await endedStanding(q, decisionId) : [];
  // 3e Task 4: the reply this correction or review answered by keeping or reversing its measure; absent when none.
  const replied = decision.kind === "review" || decision.kind === "correction" ? await repliedTo(q, decisionId) : null;
  // The facts and the reason are told with a decision that restricts (it holds a measure), with a correction and with a
  // review. Those of a decision without a measure are the case's record, for staff: such a decision tells its author at
  // most that what korbat did while deciding has ended, so the statement's data holds neither, and no mail, screen or
  // export that is rendered from it can carry them.
  const told = decision.kind === "correction" || decision.kind === "review" || actions.some((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null);
  const statement: DecisionStatement = {
    kind: decision.kind,
    outcome: decision.outcome as DecisionStatement["outcome"],
    ground: decision.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
    ruleId: decision.ruleId as RuleId | null,
    rulesVersion: decision.rulesVersion,
    redressVersion: decision.redressVersion,
    legalReference: decision.legalReference,
    facts: told ? decision.facts : null,
    reason: told ? decision.reason : null,
    source: decision.source as DecisionStatement["source"],
    decidedAt: decision.decidedAt,
    post: decision.targetType === "post" && decision.postCreatedAt !== null ? { id: decision.targetId, createdAt: decision.postCreatedAt } : null,
    measures: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as MeasureKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        noEffect: action.noEffect,
        sealed: action.kind === "seal_media" ? { posts: action.sealedPosts, images: action.sealedImages, deletedImages: action.sealedDeletedImages } : null,
        // 3e: what the ledger fixed for good about a strike, a standing measure and a retirement, so its statement reads as
        // it was sent (a retirement's sentence reads its end from whether the decision suspends or terminates at once).
        ...(action.kind === "strike" ? { endsAt: action.endsAt, activeThen: action.activeThen } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "suspend" || action.kind === "terminate"
          ? {
              announced: action.announced,
              days: action.days,
              basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null,
              earliestStart: action.earliestStart,
              endsAt: action.endsAt,
              restsOn: action.restsOn === null ? null : action.restsOn.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, ruleId: entry.ruleId as RuleId | null })),
            }
          : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "retire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle, placeholder: action.placeholder } : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: a warning's end of counting; a restriction's days, its end and the warning it follows.
        ...(action.kind === "warn_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, endsAt: action.endsAt } : {}),
        ...(action.kind === "restrict_reporting" ? { basis: action.basis as StandingBasis | null, days: action.days, endsAt: action.endsAt, warnedAt: action.warnedAt } : {}),
      })),
    reversals: actions
      .filter((action) => MEASURES[action.kind].lifts !== null)
      .map((action) => ({
        kind: action.kind as ReversalKind,
        mediaId: action.mediaId,
        ...(action.lifted === null ? { resetDecisionId: null, oldValueKept: false, resetRuleId: null } : resetFacts(action.kind, action.lifted)),
        // 3e: the handle a reversal of a retirement gives back.
        ...(action.kind === "unretire_handle" ? { handle: action.handle } : {}),
        // 3e: what a lift of a suspension lifted, where its period stood then, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_suspension"
          ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen, replaced: action.replaced, replyFiledAt: action.replyFiledAt }
          : {}),
        // 3e Task 5: what a lift of a reporting measure lifted, and for a restriction whether its days still ran.
        ...(action.kind === "lift_reporting" ? { liftedKind: action.liftedKind, liftedDecidedAt: action.liftedDecidedAt, periodThen: action.periodThen } : {}),
      })),
    endedMeasures: ended.map((measure) => ({ kind: measure.kind as MeasureKind, mediaId: measure.mediaId, ...resetFacts(measure.kind, measure) })),
    ...(brokenBasis.length > 0 ? { endedStanding: brokenBasis } : {}),
    ...(replied !== null ? { repliedTo: replied } : {}),
    reviewed:
      decision.reviewed === null
        ? null
        : {
            kind: decision.reviewed.kind,
            ground: decision.reviewed.ground as DecisionStatement["ground"],
            ruleId: decision.reviewed.ruleId as RuleId | null,
            // The reviewed decision's own rulebook version: its rule is rendered as it was worded when that decision was made.
            rulesVersion: decision.reviewed.rulesVersion,
            legalReference: decision.reviewed.legalReference,
            decidedAt: decision.reviewed.decidedAt,
          },
  };
  return { statement, decision };
}

/**
 * The subject of the statement's mail, by the decision's kind and outcome (3c design, section 7.15), as a key of the mail
 * template's own table: a seal first, whatever else the decision holds; then a decision taken while deciding, on a post
 * or on an account; a final restriction; a final decision that restricts nothing but ends or lifts what was done while
 * deciding, and a correction of a decision taken while deciding; a reversal of a final decision; and a kept appeal.
 */
export function mailSubjectOf(statement: DecisionStatement): Extract<DecisionMessage, { template: "moderation_decision" }>["subject"] {
  const seals = statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media");
  const post = statement.post !== null;
  if (statement.kind === "interim") return seals ? "seal_deciding" : post ? "post_deciding" : "profile_deciding";
  if (statement.kind === "final") {
    if (seals) return "seal_final";
    if (statement.outcome === "restricted") return post ? "post_restricted" : "profile_restricted";
    return "lifted_deciding";
  }
  if (statement.kind === "correction") return statement.reviewed?.kind === "interim" ? "lifted_deciding" : "reversed";
  return statement.outcome === "kept" ? "appeal_kept" : "reversed";
}

/**
 * The template a decision's statement is mailed under (3e design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6): the first row of 7.15's
 * table that fits, and moderation_decision otherwise, so that a strike, a retirement and their reversals ride on 3c's
 * mail. In order: an announced suspension or termination; one taken at once; the answer to a reply (a statement with
 * `repliedTo`); a lift of one (a withdrawal signed `replaced` under its own lead), or a decision whose reversal ended one by
 * breaking its basis; a final warning about reporting; a final restriction of reporting. A lift of a reporting measure,
 * also one that ends a restriction with its warning, rides on moderation_decision.
 */
export function mailTemplateOf(statement: DecisionStatement, paragraphs: readonly string[]): DecisionMessage {
  const standing = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === true) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    if (standing.earliestStart === undefined || standing.earliestStart === null) throw new Error("an announced measure's mail names its earliest start: the statement's data holds none");
    // The window is the row's own: its earliest start less its decision's time, in hours.
    const window = Math.round((Date.parse(standing.earliestStart) - Date.parse(statement.decidedAt)) / 3_600_000);
    return { template: "suspension_announced", measure, days: measure === "terminate" ? null : (standing.days ?? null), window, earliestStart: standing.earliestStart, paragraphs };
  }
  if (statement.kind === "final" && standing !== undefined && standing.announced === false) {
    const measure = standing.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend";
    return { template: "suspension_started_at_once", measure, days: standing.days ?? null, endsAt: standing.endsAt ?? null, paragraphs };
  }
  const lift = statement.reversals.find((reversal) => reversal.kind === "lift_suspension");
  if (statement.repliedTo !== undefined) {
    // A review that reverses part but leaves the measure in force answers the reply as a kept answer does.
    const lifted = lift !== undefined && lift.replaced !== true;
    return { template: "reply_answered", outcome: lifted ? "reversed" : "kept", paragraphs };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.replaced === true && lift.liftedDecidedAt) {
    return {
      template: "suspension_lifted",
      measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend",
      why: "replaced",
      decidedAt: lift.liftedDecidedAt,
      replied: lift.replyFiledAt !== undefined && lift.replyFiledAt !== null,
      paragraphs,
    };
  }
  if ((statement.kind === "review" || statement.kind === "correction") && lift !== undefined && lift.periodThen) {
    return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: lift.liftedKind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "lifted", period: lift.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  }
  const broken = (statement.endedStanding ?? []).find((entry) => entry.kind === "suspend" || entry.kind === "terminate");
  if (broken !== undefined) return { template: "suspension_lifted", measure: broken.kind === "terminate" ? "terminate" : "suspend", why: "basis", period: broken.periodThen.state, paragraphs };
  if (statement.kind === "final" && statement.measures.some((measure) => measure.kind === "warn_reporting")) return { template: "reporting_warned", paragraphs };
  const restriction = statement.measures.find((measure) => measure.kind === "restrict_reporting");
  if (statement.kind === "final" && restriction !== undefined) {
    if (typeof restriction.days !== "number" || typeof restriction.endsAt !== "string") throw new Error("a restriction of reporting's mail names its days and its end: the statement's data holds neither");
    return { template: "reporting_restricted", days: restriction.days, endsAt: restriction.endsAt, paragraphs };
  }
  return { template: "moderation_decision", subject: mailSubjectOf(statement), paragraphs };
}

/**
 * Mails a decision's statement to its author when that mail is still owed, and records what became of it: `sent`,
 * `no_address` for an account that is gone, `failed` when the relay refused the address for good. A failure of the relay
 * is thrown, and the mail stays pending for the dispatch job. Answers what was recorded, or "none" when nothing was owed.
 *
 * The decision's row is taken before the mail is sent, in the transaction that records the result (beginMailRecord): a
 * database that cannot write refuses that, and nothing is sent, so a mail is never sent again and again for want of a
 * record. Two senders of one statement (the decision's own request and the dispatch job) then send it once: the second
 * waits for the row and finds the mail recorded.
 *
 * 3e (design, section 5, the lock order, item 4): for a decision that holds an announced suspension or termination, the
 * outcome fixes the measure's start (the database's decisions_mail_standing derives the profile's columns), so the
 * transaction takes the subject's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE first and the decision's row after it, as a deciding
 * transaction takes the profile before it touches decisions.
 */
export async function sendStatement(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb" | "auth" | "social">, decisionId: string): Promise<MailState | "none"> {
  const found = await decisionStatement(deps.apiDb, decisionId);
  if (!found || found.decision.authorMail !== "pending") return "none";
  const subject = found.decision.subjectId;
  // The statement is rendered before anything is sent: one that cannot be rendered is no mail, and stays pending.
  const message = mailTemplateOf(found.statement, statementParagraphs(found.statement));
  const announced = found.statement.kind === "final" && found.statement.measures.some((measure) => (measure.kind === "suspend" || measure.kind === "terminate") && measure.announced === true);
  return deps.apiDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await beginMailRecord(tx);
    if (announced && subject !== null) await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [subject], "no key update");
    if (!(await lockPendingAuthorMail(tx, decisionId))) return "none";
    const result = subject === null ? "no_address" : await deps.auth.mailAccount(subject, message);
    // A stop of the address never holds a statement back, so "suppressed" is never answered for it.
    const state: MailState = result === "sent" ? "sent" : result === "refused" ? "failed" : "no_address";
    await recordAuthorMail(tx, decisionId, state);
    return state;
  });
}
```

```tsx
import { Pressable, Text, View } from "react-native";
import { Link } from "expo-router";
import { MEASURES, type AccountStanding, type AuthorCaseRow, type ReportItem, type ReportsPage } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Button, ErrorText } from "@/components/ui";
import { utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { CASES_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { CASE_ROW_WORDS, reportingLine, rowStrike, runningMeasure, STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";
import { ItemLines } from "./ItemLines";

/** 3e: the kinds whose words in a row are the row's own (9.4), not the measure's label. */
const ROW_KINDS: Partial<Record<AuthorCaseRow["actions"][number], string>> = {
  overrule: CASE_ROW_WORDS.overrule,
  retire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.retired,
  unretire_handle: CASE_ROW_WORDS.unretired,
  suspend: CASE_ROW_WORDS.suspended,
  lift_suspension: CASE_ROW_WORDS.lifted,
  // Task 5: a warning about the account's reports, and the lift of either reporting measure.
  warn_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.warned,
  lift_reporting: CASE_ROW_WORDS.reportingLifted,
};

/**
 * What a decision did, in the measures' own labels; a decision without a measure ended what was done while deciding, or
 * took no action. A review that kept the decision is worded by its outcome first: it lifts nothing, and the restriction
 * it answered stands.
 */
function done(row: AuthorCaseRow, now: Date): string {
  if (row.kind === "review" && row.outcome === "kept") return CASES_WORDS.keptDecision;
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): a strike is named with where it stands, its overruling, a retirement and its reversal in
  // the row's own words.
  const labels: string[] = row.actions.map((kind) =>
    kind === "strike" && row.strike
      ? rowStrike(row.strike, now)
      : kind === "restrict_reporting" && row.reportingDays !== undefined
        ? CASE_ROW_WORDS.restricted(row.reportingDays)
        : (ROW_KINDS[kind] ?? MEASURES[kind].label),
  );
  // Task 5: a reversal that ended a restriction of reporting resting on the decision it reversed says so.
  if ((row.endedStanding ?? []).includes("restrict_reporting")) labels.push(CASE_ROW_WORDS.restrictionEnded);
  if (row.endedInterim) labels.push(CASES_WORDS.ended);
  return labels.length > 0 ? labels.join(", ") : CASES_WORDS.noAction;
}

/** Which kind of decision it is, where that is not plain from what it did. */
function kindWords(row: AuthorCaseRow): string | null {
  if (row.kind === "interim") return CASES_WORDS.whileDeciding;
  if (row.kind === "review") return CASES_WORDS.review;
  if (row.kind === "correction") return CASES_WORDS.correction;
  return null;
}

 * "About you" (3c design, section 9): the decisions about the account that its holder was told of, newest first. Each
 * row is a link to the decision's screen and says what it is about (the post, by its creation time, or the profile), the
 * decision's day, what was done, the rule or the law, and where its appeal stands.
 */
export function DecisionsList({ decisions, now = new Date() }: { decisions: readonly AuthorCaseRow[]; now?: Date }) {
  if (decisions.length === 0) return <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noDecisions}</Text>;
  return (
    <View>
      {decisions.map((row) => {
        const kind = kindWords(row);
        return (
          <Link key={row.id} href={`/settings/cases/${row.id}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
              <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{row.post ? CASES_WORDS.post(utcMinute(row.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-400">
                {CASES_WORDS.decidedOn(row.decidedOn)}
                {kind ? ` (${kind})` : ""}
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{done(row, now)}</Text>
              {row.ruleId || row.legal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{row.ruleId ? CASES_WORDS.rule(row.ruleId) : CASES_WORDS.law}</Text> : null}
              {row.appealUntil ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealOpen(utcMinute(row.appealUntil))}</Text> : null}
              {row.appeal ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.appealState[row.appeal]}</Text> : null}
              {row.reversedOn ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-300">{CASES_WORDS.reversed(row.reversedOn)}</Text> : null}
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * "Your standing" (3e design, section 9.4), above "About you": how many of the account's strikes count now, and what that
 * many leads to; then (Task 3) the line of a suspension that runs, in the banner's words, from /me's standing; and (Task 5)
 * [cases.reporting]: a restriction of the account's reports that runs, or a warning about them that counts. The line of
 * an announced or held measure comes with the task that builds it.
 */
export function StandingBlock({ activeStrikes, standing = null }: { activeStrikes: number; standing?: AccountStanding | null }) {
  const running = runningMeasure(standing);
  const reporting = reportingLine(standing);
  return (
    <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
      <Text accessibilityRole="header" aria-level={2} className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">
        {STANDING_TEXTS.cases.title}
      </Text>
      <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{activeStrikes > 0 ? STANDING_TEXTS.cases.strikes(activeStrikes) : STANDING_TEXTS.cases.none}</Text>
      {running !== null && running.kind === "suspend" && running.endsAt !== null ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{STANDING_TEXTS.banner.running(running.endsAt)}</Text> : null}
      {reporting !== null ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{reporting}</Text> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * "Your reports" (3c design, section 9): the account's reports with each item as the status page words it. When the
 * account's address stopped korbat's report mails (someone who holds it asked for that on a status page), the tab says so
 * above the list, with the button that resumes them: the outcomes are listed here either way. With `onReexamine` each
 * item whose answer can still be examined again carries "Ask for a re-examination", asked by the item's id.
 */
export function ReportsList({
  page,
  onResume,
  onReexamine,
  busy = false,
  error = null,
}: {
  page: Pick<ReportsPage, "reports" | "reportMailStopped">;
  onResume?: () => void;
  onReexamine?: (item: ReportItem, statement: string) => Promise<void>;
  busy?: boolean;
  error?: string | null;
}) {
  return (
    <View>
      {page.reportMailStopped ? (
        <View className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          <Text className="text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">{CASES_WORDS.mailStopped}</Text>
          <Button label={CASES_WORDS.resume} onPress={() => onResume?.()} busy={busy} tone="secondary" />
          <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.resumeHint}</Text>
          <ErrorText message={error} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      {page.reports.length === 0 ? <Text className="px-4 py-8 text-base text-zinc-400">{CASES_WORDS.noReports}</Text> : null}
      {page.reports.map((report) => (
        <View key={report.ref} className="border-b border-zinc-800 px-4 pb-4 pt-3">
          <Text className="text-base font-semibold text-zinc-50">{CASES_WORDS.report(report.ref, utcMinute(report.receivedAt))}</Text>
          <ItemLines items={report.items} onReexamine={onReexamine} />
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
        {DECISION_WORDS.title}

      <Text className="mt-1 text-base text-zinc-300">{view.post ? DECISION_WORDS.post(utcMinute(view.post.createdAt)) : CASES_WORDS.profile}</Text>

      <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.statement}>
        {paragraphs ? paragraphs.map((paragraph, index) => <Line key={index}>{paragraph}</Line>) : <Note>{DECISION_WORDS.cannotRender}</Note>}
        {/* 3e (design, section 9.2): where the strike this decision gave stands now, read fresh. */}
        {view.strike ? <Line strong>{strikeLine(view.strike)}</Line> : null}
        {resets.map((decisionId) => (
          <Link key={decisionId} href={`/settings/cases/${decisionId}`} asChild>
            <Pressable className="mt-3 self-start">
              <Text className="text-sm text-sky-400 underline">{DECISION_WORDS.resetDecision}</Text>
            </Pressable>
          </Link>
        ))}
      </Section>

      <StandingNow view={view} />
      <ReportingNow view={view} />

      <Section title={DECISION_WORDS.content}>
        <Content content={view.content} />

          <StandingAppealNotes view={view} />
          <Appeal view={view} onAppeal={onAppeal} />

    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { useState } from "react";
import { Text, View } from "react-native";
import { STATEMENT_MAX, itemOutcomeWords, type NoticeItemStatus } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { Button, ErrorText, Field } from "@/components/ui";
import { externalLink } from "@/lib/links";
import { dailyLimitFailure, itemRedress, quotedExaminedToo, utcMinute } from "@/lib/moderation";
import { STATUS_WORDS } from "@/lib/moderation-words";
import { STANDING_TEXTS } from "@/lib/standing";

/**
 * "Ask for a re-examination" (3c design, section 9): an optional statement, free of form, and the button. The request
 * is a POST its caller sends; a refusal is worded under the button, and what was typed stays. Once it is taken the list
 * is read again, and the item no longer offers the control.
 */
function ReexamineControl({ both, onAsk }: { both: boolean; onAsk: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const [statement, setStatement] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function ask() {
    if (busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onAsk(statement);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(dailyLimitFailure(err, "reexaminations"));
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <View>
      {/* A report of child sexual abuse material about a post that quotes another: korbat examines both posts again. */}
      {both ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.reexamineBoth}</Text> : null}
      <Field label={STATUS_WORDS.reexamineStatement} value={statement} onChangeText={setStatement} multiline maxLength={STATEMENT_MAX} />
      <Button label={STATUS_WORDS.reexamine} onPress={() => void ask()} busy={busy} tone="secondary" />
      <ErrorText message={error} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * One item of a report as its sender reads it, on the notice status page and in Your reports alike (3c design, section
 * 9). Its link is the address the report named, an account's under the handle as named. Once its outcome is released it
 * reads the words the mail reads (the contracts' one composition, from the item's own facts), and beside them what the
 * sender can still do: ask for a re-examination while that is open, with the control when the screen can send one, or go
 * to court; a changed outcome and a re-examination's answer are final within korbat. Until then it says only that it is
 * not decided. 3e Task 5 (design, section 9.4): on the sender's own list, an item a moderator marked "manifestly
 * unfounded" says so while the mark counts, once its outcome is released; the status page's items carry no mark.
 */
function ItemLine({ item, both, onAsk }: { item: NoticeItemStatus & { unfounded?: boolean }; both: boolean; onAsk?: (statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  const words = itemOutcomeWords(item);
  const redress = itemRedress(item);
  return (
    <View className="mt-4 rounded-lg border border-zinc-800 px-4 py-3">
      {item.quotedBy !== null ? (
        // An item korbat added for the post a named post quotes: its heading says so, with the quoted post's address.
        <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-100">{STATUS_WORDS.added(item.quotedBy, item.link)}</Text>
      ) : (
        <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-zinc-100">
          {STATUS_WORDS.item(item.position)}
          {item.reexamines ? ` (${STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationLabel})` : ""}:{" "}
          <Text {...externalLink(item.link)} className="font-normal text-sky-400 underline">
            {item.link}
          </Text>
        </Text>
      )}
      {words === null || item.decidedOn === null ? (
        <Text className="mt-2 text-sm text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.waiting}</Text>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-200">
            {STATUS_WORDS.decided(item.decidedOn)} {words}
          </Text>
          {item.unfounded === true ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-amber-300">{STANDING_TEXTS.reports.marked}</Text> : null}
          {redress === "reexamination" && item.reexamination ? (
            <>
              <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.reexaminationOpen(utcMinute(item.reexamination.until))}</Text>
              {onAsk ? <ReexamineControl both={both} onAsk={onAsk} /> : null}
            </>
          ) : null}
          {redress === "final" ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.final}</Text> : null}
          {redress === "courts" ? <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{STATUS_WORDS.courts}</Text> : null}
        </>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * A report's items in the order the API lists them: by position, an added item directly after the item it was added for.
 * With `onReexamine` each item whose answer can still be examined again carries the control; the caller sends the
 * request for the item it is handed (by its position on the status page, by its id in Your reports).
 */
export function ItemLines<T extends NoticeItemStatus>({ items, onReexamine }: { items: readonly T[]; onReexamine?: (item: T, statement: string) => Promise<void> }) {
  return (
    <View>
      {items.map((item, index) => (
        // A re-examination shares its item's position, so the place in the list is the key.
        <ItemLine key={index} item={item} both={quotedExaminedToo(items, index)} onAsk={onReexamine ? (statement) => onReexamine(item, statement) : undefined} />
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
type ChoiceEntry<T extends string> = { value: T; label: string; hint?: string; disabled?: string } | { note: string };

/**
 * One question with its answers, of which one is chosen: a radio group, each answer a radio that says whether it is
 * checked. Every answer has the same weight on the page; a note among them is plain text and no control.
 */
function Choice<T extends string>({ label, entries, value, onChange }: { label: string; entries: ChoiceEntry<T>[]; value: T | null; onChange: (value: T) => void }) {
  return (
    <View accessibilityRole="radiogroup" aria-label={label} className="mt-6">
      <Text className="text-sm font-medium text-zinc-300">{label}</Text>
      {entries.map((entry) =>
        "note" in entry ? (
          <Text key={entry.note} className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-dashed border-zinc-700 px-4 py-3 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">
            {entry.note}
          </Text>
        ) : (
          <Pressable
            key={entry.value}
            accessibilityRole="radio"
            aria-checked={value === entry.value}
            aria-disabled={entry.disabled !== undefined}
            disabled={entry.disabled !== undefined}
            onPress={() => onChange(entry.value)}
            className={`mt-2 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 ${value === entry.value ? "border-zinc-50 bg-zinc-900" : "border-zinc-700"}`}
          >
            <Text className={`text-base ${entry.disabled !== undefined ? "text-zinc-500" : value === entry.value ? "font-semibold text-zinc-50" : "text-zinc-200"}`}>{entry.label}</Text>
            {entry.hint ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{entry.hint}</Text> : null}
            {/* A disabled choice keeps its reason as text beside it (9.8). */}
            {entry.disabled !== undefined ? <Text className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-amber-300">{entry.disabled}</Text> : null}
          </Pressable>
        ),
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

/** A statement the person may tick: a checkbox that says whether it is checked. */
function Check({ label, checked, onChange }: { label: string; checked: boolean; onChange: (checked: boolean) => void }) {
  return (
    <Pressable accessibilityRole="checkbox" aria-checked={checked} onPress={() => onChange(!checked)} className="mt-6 flex-row items-start gap-3">
      <View className={`mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded border ${checked ? "border-zinc-50 bg-zinc-50" : "border-zinc-500"}`}>
        {checked ? <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-zinc-950">x</Text> : null}
      </View>

}

const Hint = ({ children }: { children: string }) => <Text className="mt-2 text-sm leading-5 text-zinc-400">{children}</Text>;

/** The rules a report may cite, each with its title and one line; R2 is no choice: in its place stands the pointer to the anonymous path. */
function ruleEntries(withPointer: boolean): ChoiceEntry<ReportRuleId>[] {
  const reportable: readonly string[] = REPORT_RULE_IDS;
  return RULES.flatMap((rule): ChoiceEntry<ReportRuleId>[] => {
    if (reportable.includes(rule.id)) return [{ value: rule.id as ReportRuleId, label: `${rule.id}: ${rule.title}`, hint: ruleLine(rule) }];
    return withPointer ? [{ note: REPORT_WORDS.r2Instead }] : [];

/**
```
